title: Procurement Manager, Transportation Procurement Brazil
descriptionHtml:
Transportation Procurement Leader — Last Mile / EDSP (AMZL Brazil)

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us redefine the future of last mile delivery in one of the fastest-growing e-commerce markets in the world, this is your chance to make history.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a senior leader with deep transportation procurement and last mile operations experience to own the end-to-end strategy and execution of Amazon's largest AMZL program in Brazil: EDSP (External Delivery Service Partner). This role sits at the intersection of procurement, supply chain, and network operations — leading the scaling of a carrier ecosystem that delivers millions of packages across 300+ nodes nationwide.

The person in this role will be the single-threaded owner of the EDSP program, managing a portfolio of delivery service providers while driving aggressive network expansion, operational excellence, and delivery performance. You will partner with Operations, Finance, Network Planning, and Carrier Management teams to unlock capacity, negotiate at scale, and continuously improve delivery quality while maintaining 98%+ delivery execution accuracy (DEA).

The ideal candidate is a proven operator who thrives in ambiguity — someone who has scaled programs from zero to hundreds of nodes, built carrier ecosystems from the ground up, and delivered step-function improvements while expanding coverage. You must combine strategic thinking with executional rigor, influence without authority across senior stakeholders, and lead high-performing teams in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment.


KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS

Share growth: increase EDSP program share of eligible volume while maintaining or improving delivery quality.
Operational efficiency: continuously improve cost-per-package through network design, route density optimization, and supplier performance management.
Network expansion: successfully launch and stabilize new nodes on schedule, expanding coverage to underserved regions.
Supplier performance: maintain 98%+ DEA across the carrier portfolio with clear performance management cadence and consequence management.
Stakeholder trust: earn and maintain the trust of Operations, Finance, and senior leadership as the definitive voice on last mile transportation procurement in Brazil.
Team development: promote talent from within, close capability gaps, and build organizational readiness for next-phase growth.





Key job responsibilities
Own the EDSP category strategy end-to-end: develop and execute sourcing strategies that balance capacity, coverage, and service quality across Brazil's last mile network.
Scale the carrier ecosystem: identify, onboard, develop, and performance-manage delivery service providers to support network growth from current state toward full national coverage.
Drive operational efficiency and network optimization: improve route density, reduce cost-per-package through network design, and identify structural levers that enhance program economics without compromising service quality.
Lead cross-functional alignment: partner with Operations, Network Planning, Finance, and Tech teams to ensure procurement strategy is synchronized with AMZL capacity planning, node launches, and share allocation decisions.
Manage supplier performance with operational rigor: establish SLAs, track DEA/DPMO/speed metrics, drive root-cause analysis on underperformance, and create continuous improvement mechanisms with carriers.
Act as the market intelligence authority: monitor competitive dynamics, capacity constraints, regulatory changes, and emerging delivery models to inform strategic decisions and keep VP-level stakeholders informed.
Negotiate and execute complex contracts: lead high-stakes negotiations with strategic suppliers, structuring agreements that incentivize performance, mitigate risk, and protect Amazon's long-term competitive position.
Build and develop a high-performing team: lead, mentor, and grow a team of procurement specialists and supply chain managers, fostering a culture of ownership, data-driven decision-making, and operational excellence.

Basic qualifications

- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Experience in procurement, supply chain, or transportation management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
- Track record of scaling programs or supplier ecosystems in high-growth, ambiguous environments.
- Experience with last mile delivery, logistics networks, or transportation operations.
- Fluency in Portuguese and English.

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
- Experience influencing senior leaders/stakeholders
- Experience in emerging markets or rapidly scaling logistics operations.
- Knowledge of Brazilian transportation regulations, carrier landscape, and e-commerce logistics.
- Experience with last mile delivery programs.

title: Data Center Controls Technician, Data Center Capacity Delivery
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own

The Data Center Global Services team is looking for exceptional individuals to join our Controls organization as a Controls Technician for Service & Construction of the Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) within Amazon data centers. If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act globally and have the ability to contribute to major new innovations in the area of building controls and automation this is the challenge you are looking for!

The ideal candidate will possess technical background and experience in installation, troubleshooting and maintenance of field sensors, controllers, wiring, networking and programming associated with the industrial controls systems. Controls Technicians shall be responsible for participating in the installation, testing, troubleshooting and startup of equipment and controls system associated with the BMS and EPMS system deployment in the data centers. They will verify, configure, and troubleshoot field devices including Air Handler Unit (AHU) controllers, Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Temperature and Pressure Sensors, and Third Party Network or Serial Devices, controllers and network equipment.

Key job responsibilities
Primarily work in and support multiple data centers by deploying, servicing, and upgrading BMS and EPMS systems.

Mentor and train Facilities team members on the operation and control of BMS and EPMS systems.

Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.

Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.

Perform first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of programming code and hardware associated with BMS and EPMS in data centers.

Execute provisioning processes for servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and network configurations, including communication testing between third-party devices and controllers or servers.

Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.

Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings with a basic understanding of closed-loop controls, field sensor scaling, and functions typically performed by industrial controllers.

Supervise low-voltage electrical contractors performing wiring and installation of field devices in compliance with AWS requirements.

Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support.

Create red-lined drawings and documentation of systems.

Follow change management processes to generate work requests and methods of procedures.

Participate in factory witness tests at vendor or panel builder facilities.

Perform root cause analysis during testing and commissioning.

Ensure personnel on site utilize proper safety methodology.

Perform service activities including monitoring and reviewing ticketing systems, conducting root cause analysis, and prioritizing tasks.

Actively manage service agreements including vendor labor scheduling, quality assurance, and financial invoice review.

Participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying, or moving up to 50 lbs of equipment, and utilize OSHA-standard safety equipment including limited weight-bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools, and personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety harnesses.

Perform other tasks as assigned by manager.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams. Your internal stakeholders include your Controls Engineer, Controls Manager, partner teams (Field Engineering, Critical Project Implementation, DCEO), and the vendors you oversee.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control : This position requires that the candidate selected be a U.S. Citizen in order to comply with U.S. government-imposed requirements related to the nature of the work and/or where it will be performed.

Manufacturing Software Systems (MSS) is seeking a Software Development Engineer who will help solve a variety of technical challenges related to manufacturing the satellites, ground equipment and associated ASICs. You will play an active role in translating business and functional requirements into concrete deliverables and build quick prototypes or proofs of concept in partnership with other technology leaders within the team. You will tackle challenging, novel situations and will have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams spanning a variety of domains: software, hardware, networks, RF, embedded, real-time, distributed as well as industrial automation systems.

You will design and develop the manufacturing software used to drive the assembly, calibration and test of satellite and ground systems as well as perform high-throughput ASIC/chip level provisioning and testing. You will collaborate with teams from manufacturing engineering, product engineering, and security engineering to identify requirements and design manufacturing software. You will design and develop the end-to-end system capabilities required for manufacturing orchestration across factory production lines.

Along the way, we guarantee that you’ll learn a ton, have fun and make a positive impact on millions of people.

Key job responsibilities
- Build the manufacturing software systems used by production operations to manufacture the Leo's satellite fleet, supporting ground systems and associated ASICs
- Build the end-to-end system capabilities required for the orchestration of manufacturing across factory production lines
- Architect and design a secure manufacturing software system that protects Leo's intellectual property and manufacturing assets via a secure chain of custody/trust
- Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market

A day in the life
In this role as a Software Development Engineer, you will be developing Leo's secure manufacturing software systems and orchestration software capabilities. These products enable industrial automation for the manufacturing of the Leo satellite fleet and supporting ground equipment. You will engage with an experienced cross-disciplinary team to develop, qualify, produce, and deploy solutions and products enabling Leo’s global network.

About the team
The Leo Manufacturing Software team is responsible for the architecture, design, build, and installation of the software used to manufacture the Leo satellite fleet, ground equipment and ASICs. We partner with hardware, software, test engineering, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure efficient and secure manufacturing operations.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

title: Infrastructure TPM, Infra Capacity Delivery
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We’re seeking an experienced Infrastructure Technical Program Manager in Herndon or Arlington, VA to oversee data center build projects in the Northern Virginia region. You will lead cross-functional and technical teams from conceptual design feasibility through requirements, budget, completed design, implementation, testing, and deployment. Along the way, you will use your judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence without authority, analytical talent, technical aptitude, and leadership to collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery.

The candidate must be comfortable managing remote project delivery teams, and possess the ability to facilitate technical whiteboard sessions to troubleshoot project implementation issues, and remove barriers to project success. Being able to stand up cross-functional teams, establish trust with a variety of stakeholders across multiple time zones, manage capital budgets, eliminate non-value-add activity, design solutions, remove blockers, and find creative ways to accelerate project delivery is a must.

The ideal candidate will be an exceptionally strong communicator, both written and verbally, and possess experience in tactical project management of highly technical initiatives, as well as strategic program management. They will be able to apply a variety of project management tools, methodologies and techniques for all phases of the project lifecycle and exhibit demonstrated experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality and risk management, reporting and metric development/tracking. Experience with MS Project, Asana, Tableau, and systems integration a plus.

The candidate will work through ambiguity, competing priorities, and be capable of understanding mechanical/electrical engineering concepts. Experience in managing data center infrastructure deployments is a plus. Candidates possessing a background in architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering, data center infrastructure/operations, and/or construction, who have transitioned to a program management discipline will have a distinct advantage.

title: Global Financial Services, Senior Solutions Architect , AWSi GFS EMEA + APJ Solutions Architecture
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and technically deep Senior Solutions Architect to join our Global Financial Services (GFS) team. In this role, you will partner with some of the world's largest banking, insurance, and capital markets companies, alongside AWS Sales and cross-functional teams, to design highly scalable, resilient, and secure cloud architectures that solve real business problems and accelerate AWS adoption.

You will serve as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, helping organizations understand best practices for cloud migration, cloud-native development, and AI adoption. You will also contribute to the broader SA community through mentorship, reusable content, and thought leadership.

We are looking for someone who:
- Brings deep Financial Services domain expertise and a point of view on how cloud and AI are transforming the industry
- Thrives in a collaborative, customer-obsessed environment and enjoys working with large, global enterprise customers
- Is passionate about educating, designing, and building cloud solutions for complex and diverse challenges
- Keeps their technical skills sharp and contributes meaningfully to architectural discussions and design reviews
- Actively develops others and contributes to a culture of learning and inclusion

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with customers to architect, build, and migrate applications, software, and services on the AWS platform
- Work with sales teams to develop and execute strategies that drive AWS adoption and exceed revenue objectives
- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior technical leaders at Financial Services customers, influencing their long-term technology strategy
- Lead architectural discussions and design reviews, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, cost-optimized, and operationally excellent
- Develop and contribute reusable reference architectures, patterns, and best-practice content for the SA community
- Mentor and develop fellow Solutions Architects, actively contributing to team capability growth
- Act as a Financial Services thought leader through public speaking, written content, and industry engagement on cloud and AI adoption
- Conduct training sessions (one-to-few and one-to-many) to transfer knowledge to customers evaluating or already using AWS
- Provide structured feedback to AWS service and product teams based on customer needs and gaps identified in the field
- Contribute to organizational strategic planning, recruiting, and the development of team-wide initiatives

This role may require travel of up to 30% to meet with customers and attend industry events. Travel expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Sr. Electrical Engineer, Data Center Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. You will be relied on as a subject matter expert in the electrical engineering field. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. Travel should be up to 20% of your time and in-person collaboration efforts in your assigned office location.


Key job responsibilities
- Data center electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
- Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
- Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
- Review and approval of equipment submittals.
- Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
- Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
- Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
- Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

A day in the life
You'll start your day connecting with global team members to review ongoing projects. You might analyze energy efficiency data, collaborate on innovative cooling solutions, or mentor fellow engineers. You'll participate in design reviews, engage with vendors, and contribute to sustainability initiatives that shape our environmental footprint.

About the team
We are a diverse group of engineers committed to revolutionizing data center design. Our team values creativity, sustainability, and continuous learning. We support each other's growth while working on projects that impact millions of customers worldwide. Our inclusive environment encourages sharing ideas and celebrating collective achievements.

*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Manager, Technical Infrastructure Program Management, Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation
descriptionHtml:
Join our Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation International team, where we transform complex automation technologies into efficiently deployable solutions on a global scale. Amazon is seeking an experienced Manager to lead a team of Single-Threaded Leaders (STLs) who own end-to-end program planning, cross-functional orchestration, and delivery governance for complex automation infrastructure deployments across our international fulfillment network.

You will lead and develop a team of program managers who each own full lifecycle delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream — from capital approval and planning through deployment execution and steady-state handover. You will design the governance mechanisms, operating cadences, and scalable frameworks that enable your team to drive predictable delivery outcomes across multiple concurrent programs, countries, and stakeholder organizations.

You will influence within a VP organization, advise Senior Managers and Directors on deployment strategy, prioritization trade-offs, and program health, and actively grow the next generation of program leaders.

Amazon's culture encourages an entrepreneurial approach and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems in a fast-paced environment.

The role could be based in Berlin, Munich, Barcelona, or London with ~50% travel across Europe during deployment season, with occasional international travel.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and develop a team of program managers operating as Single-Threaded Leaders, each owning end-to-end delivery of a technology program or cross-functional workstream across planning, funding, deployment, and handover.
- Own the team's operating model, governance cadences, and delivery mechanisms, designing scalable frameworks that drive predictable outcomes across multiple concurrent programs and geographies.
- Drive cross-functional alignment across diverse stakeholder organizations including finance, operations, supply chain, site selection, and engineering to remove blockers and accelerate delivery.
- Own capital governance and program prioritization for the team's portfolio, ensuring CARs, plans of record, and financial commitments are on track and aligned to organizational goals.
- Build scalable planning mechanisms, launch readiness frameworks, and standard work that convert first-time program complexity into repeatable, predictable delivery paths adopted organization-wide.
- Advise Senior Managers and Directors on program strategy, prioritization trade-offs, resource allocation, and risk mitigation, influencing within a VP organization on cross-functional program decisions.
- Make trade-offs between short-term delivery needs and long-term sustainability using data-driven decision-making, metrics review, and clear RAG-based program health reporting.
- Set the standard for program management excellence across the team, defining best practices for stakeholder management, executive communication, cross-functional coordination, and delivery rigor.
- Grow and develop program managers through development planning, coaching, and strategic program assignment;
- Identify and develop future program leaders through talent reviews and succession planning.
- Author narratives, operational plans, and strategic documentation that frame the team's delivery impact and organizational value and present to sr. leadership.
- Drive cost efficiencies and proactive risk mitigation across multiple concurrent programs before issues become roadblocks, escalating appropriately and ensuring the team delivers sustainably.

A day in the life
You will set the strategic direction for your team's program portfolio, making prioritization trade-offs and ensuring cross-functional alignment across diverse organizations. You will design governance mechanisms and operating cadences that give your team clear swim lanes and your leadership clear visibility into program health. During deployment seasons, you will coach your program managers through complex stakeholder negotiations and escalation decisions, capturing learnings into team-wide standards.

You will interact daily with diverse functional teams across multiple time zones and organizations - finance, operations, supply chain, engineering, and site selection. You will write effective narratives and present to Senior Managers and Directors, conducting regular meetings with internal teams, stakeholders, and vendors. You will build consensus on contentious prioritization decisions, communicate across an increasing diversity of areas (legal, regulatory, finance, operations), and provide the long-term perspective behind business and program choices. You will grow your program managers, run talent reviews, and ensure your team delivers results sustainably. No two days will be the same in our fast-paced environment, offering opportunities for professional growth as part of a collaborative, focused team.

About the team
Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation is a diverse and multi-talented team with a proven track record of overcoming challenging technical problems to deliver Amazon's leading-edge robotics technologies in its fulfillment, transportation, and delivery network across the world. Our high-performing team blends engineering know-how, problem solving, curiosity, innovation, leadership, and effective communication to deliver positive results for our customers.

- Experience in program or engagement management, leading other project managers to deliver a program with multiple and concurrent projects
- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field
- Experience managing program managers or technical program managers in a deployment, infrastructure, or operations environment
- Experience owning cross-functional program delivery end-to-end, from planning and capital approval through execution and handover
- Experience designing governance mechanisms, operating cadences, and delivery frameworks for multiple concurrent programs
- Experience driving cross-functional alignment across organizations such as finance, operations, supply chain, and engineering
- Experience influencing within a VP organization, advising Senior Managers and Directors on program strategy, prioritization, and trade-offs
- Experience managing program portfolios with capital governance, plan of record management, and financial accountability

- Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
- Experience with automation or robotics program delivery in warehouse or fulfillment environments across multiple countries
- Experience with Amazon Robotics or similar warehouse automation platforms
- Experience with program delivery across multiple Countries, adapting processes across regulatory and operational environments
- Experience contributing to Operational Plan narratives and organizational goal ownership

title: Business Analyst, Buyer Abuse Data Science
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com’s Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Amazon runs one of the most dynamic e-commerce marketplaces in the world, with nearly 2 million sellers worldwide selling hundreds of millions of items in ten countries. BRP safeguards every financial transaction across all Amazon sites. As such, BRP designs and builds the software systems, risk models and operational processes that minimize risk and maximize trust in Amazon.com. BRP organization is looking for a Business Analyst for its Operations Analytics team. The team is being grown to provide insights about its BRP operations and provide analytical solutions to help drive operational efficiencies, uncover the hidden risks and trends, reduce investigation errors and bad debt, improve customer experience and predict & recommend the optimizations for future state of BRP operations.
As a Business Analyst, you will be responsible for modeling complex problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities through the use of business intelligence, data mining and visualization techniques. You will need to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver successfully against high organizational standards. The candidate should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and present the insights in concise and effective manner. Additionally, the candidate should be an effective communicator capable of independently driving issues to resolution and communicating insights to non-technical audiences. This is a high impact role with goals that directly impacts the bottom line of the business.



Key job responsibilities

- Use analytics and data mining techniques to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.

- Employ the appropriate tools, methodologies to discover patterns of risks, abuse and help reduce bad debt

- Design experiments, test hypotheses, and build actionable models to optimize BRP operations

- Solve analytical problems, and effectively communicate methodologies and results

- Build analyses for product launches and operations and help predict workflow and capacity requirements for BRP operations

- Draw inferences and conclusions, and create dashboards and visualizations of processed data, identify trends, anomalies

- Work closely with internal stakeholders such as business teams, engineering teams, and partner teams and align them with respect to your focus area

A day in the life
Pipeline Operations — Monitor and triage Datanet ETL jobs; resolve dependency timeouts, upstream delays, and schema drift; coordinate with data providers on blocked feeds; backfill data when logic changes.

Ad-Hoc Investigations — Query fraud/abuse signal tables for point-in-time analysis; investigate multi-account abuse patterns (linked accounts, ATO, concession leakage); decrypt/trace customer IDs across evaluation systems.

Dashboard & Reporting — Build/maintain QuickSight dashboards on Redshift aggregates for MAA metrics; add dimensions as needs evolve; validate metric definitions against production logic.

Business Reporting — Prepare WBR/QBR inputs (abuse BPS, goal tracking, forecasts); support goal-setting with prior-year reconciliation; generate ad-hoc regional/program splits.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
- Experience in Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with SQL
- English proficiency required (written and verbal)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with operations, risk, fraud investigations etc.
- Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
- Experience visualizing data in Tableau or other relevant data visualization software
- Experience with one of the following areas: machine learning technologies, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) or related applications
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
- 5+ years of senior level leadership support, or 7+ years of Amazon experience
- AWS Professional level certification, or 10+ years of IT platform implementation in a technical and analytical role experience

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Revenue Cycle Consultant, Healthcare Finance Operations
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Healthcare Finance Operations Services as a Revenue Cycle Defect Analyst focused on identifying, documenting, and validating revenue cycle defects that impact financial performance. In this role, you will serve as a critical individual contributor responsible for defining defects within billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. You will hypothesize about potential defects, design and execute experiments to prove their existence and impact, and package findings into structured defect analyses that enable technology and operations teams to implement solutions.

Through data-driven analysis and manual review, you will identify patterns among aged receivables, analyze billing and cash receipts reports, and surface trends that contribute to revenue leakage, claim denials, and operational inefficiencies. You will leverage your knowledge of AI-assisted analytics and statistical methods to strengthen the rigor of your findings, ensuring that each defect paper provides clear evidence, quantified impact, and actionable root cause analysis.

The ideal candidate brings strong healthcare revenue cycle expertise, demonstrates exceptional analytical capabilities, possesses an eye for detail and process improvement, and has a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, evidence-based documentation. Experience with statistical methods, AI-enabled tools, and a passion for experimentation are highly valued.

The Finance Operations organization works with every part of Amazon to provide procure-to-pay, revenue-to-receipt, real-estate and facilities, operations accounting and operations excellence services with the highest level of controllership at the lowest cost to the company. We provide the backbone systems and operational processes which completely, accurately, and validly pay Amazon's suppliers, invoice our customers and report financial results. Amazon is quickly building the Finance Operations capabilities in the healthcare industry by creating the Healthcare Finance Operations Services.


Key job responsibilities
In this analytical role, you will identify and investigate revenue cycle defects across billing, collections, cash application, and denial management processes. Your primary focus will be discovering issues through data analysis, forming hypotheses about root causes, and running targeted experiments to validate your findings before packaging them into structured documentation for stakeholder action.

- Analyze coding, charge capture, billing, cash receipts, and accounts receivable reports and activities to identify defects, anomalies, and trends that impact revenue, cash flow, and operational efficiency
- Hypothesize about potential defects based on observed patterns, denial trends, and system behaviors, then design and execute experiments (through analytics or manual review) to prove or disprove defect existence and quantify impact
- Package validated defects into structured defect analyses that clearly articulate the problem, evidence, root cause analysis, quantified financial impact, and recommended resolution path for technology and operations stakeholders
- Leverage AI-enabled tools and awareness of emerging AI/ML capabilities to enhance defect detection, automate pattern recognition, and improve the speed and accuracy of analytical workflows
- Apply statistical methods and experimental design principles to ensure rigor in defect validation, including appropriate sampling, significance testing, and data-driven conclusions
- Identify trends and categories among aged receivables, denial patterns, and payer behaviors; provide clear, actionable feedback to stakeholders to improve results and prevent recurrence
- Identify trends and develop insights that ultimately reduce cost and improve revenue lift
- Analyze workflow and operational procedures to identify opportunities for improved reimbursement; document findings and present recommendations to leadership
- Produce clear, well-structured technical writing including defect analyses, root cause analyses, and process documentation that effectively communicates complex findings and processes to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Coordinate cross-functionally to analyze data drivers, develop comprehensive insights, and present clear, actionable findings to key stakeholders including technology teams, operations, and finance
- Contribute to the evaluation of AI initiatives and explore how automation, machine learning, and robotic process automation (RPA) can enhance defect detection and resolution workflows

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 3+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience within registration, scheduling, billing, cash collection, cash application, or denial management/follow-up
- Medical billing experience with an understanding of healthcare reimbursement processes, third-party payer guidelines, and compliance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to analyze processes and information, identify problems and trends, and develop effective solutions and strategies
- Strong technical writing skills with the ability to clearly document findings, articulate complex issues, and communicate effectively in written form to diverse stakeholders
- Ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, and exhibit problem-solving skills with an exceptional eye for detail

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of healthcare revenue cycle experience in a hospital or physician provider setting
- Coursework or applied experience in statistics, experimental design, or quantitative research methods
- Professional certifications such as CPC (Certified Professional Coder) or CRCR (Certified Revenue Cycle Representative), Certified Coding Associate (CCA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)
- Awareness of AI/ML tools and their application to data analysis, pattern recognition, and process automation in revenue cycle contexts
- Experience writing structured analyses, research papers, or technical documentation that translates complex findings for diverse audiences
- Extensive knowledge of critical business processes including Coding, Charge Capture, Billing, Collections, Cash Application, Dispute and Denial Management
- Knowledge of system interfaces with Accounts Receivable and experience identifying incomplete or inaccurate data and determining root causes
- Experience creating process improvements through analysis and automation
- Experience with electronic health record systems and clearinghouse platforms

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, ASCS - Amazon Freight
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Freight, a key pillar within Amazon Supply Chain Services (ASCS), is looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our Enterprise Account Management team. This is a customer facing relationship management role within our commercial organization. You will serve as the primary operational partner for Amazon Freight's largest enterprise shippers, owning the customer relationship, identifying systemic issues that impact their experience, and coordinating cross functional teams to drive resolution.



Key job responsibilities
• Own the enterprise customer operational relationship across all freight modes (TL, IMDL, LTL), serving as the single threaded point of contact for your accounts' operational points of contact
• Identify systemic operational defects impacting your accounts using performance dashboards and customer feedback. Quantify the problem in dollars, loads, and retention risk
• Coordinate cross functional teams to resolution: gather customer insights, understand requirements, bring the right internal teams together, align on the path forward, and ensure we deliver. You don't solve problems alone but you own making sure they get solved
• Own the customer facing performance narrative. Lead Quarterly Business Reviews, produce recovery plans during performance degradation, and proactively communicate progress on open issues with timelines and measurable targets
• Own escalation communication to customer executives when something goes wrong: what's happening, what we're doing about it, and how we're tracking toward resolution
• Own internal reporting, including MBRs, account bridges, and leading inspection mechanisms for your accounts. Report out on performance metrics, cost inputs, and customer KPIs
• Influence customer operations to drive optimal inputs that lower our costs. Define what good looks like, measure it, and partner with customers to change how they operate
• Activate structured recovery programs before the customer escalates

A day in the life
Your day starts with account health dashboards, spotting a detention-charge trend at one customer's facilities and digging into its cause. By midmorning you're briefing a customer's regional transportation director on performance, then rallying ops and pricing partners on a structural issue hitting multiple facilities. After lunch you build your MBR narrative, quantifying your team's impact and open items. Later you lead a working session with operations and product on a fix to prevent recurring defects, then close by updating a customer VP on a two-week escalation, showing progress against committed targets.



About the team
The Enterprise Customer Success team is newly formed within Amazon Freight's commercial organization. This team serves as the single threaded relationship owner for our largest customers' operational points of contact. We exist to ensure that every enterprise shipper on our platform experiences the service level we committed to, and when they don't, we coordinate the teams that fix it.

descriptionHtml:
Imagine being a part of a team where your ideas can help reshape the future of the Energy industry and improve the lives of many. Here at Amazon Web Services (AWS), you'll work with a talented & inclusive team while using the latest technologies to help our customers accelerate the global energy transition.

We are looking for an experienced and motivated technologist who possess a deep understanding of the Oil & Gas industry. You will have a business mindset, technical depth, and have strong interpersonal skills to build the future with us as a Solutions Architect - supporting one or some of the largest Energy companies in the world.

You will work with customer line of business owners to solve their biggest business problems and help them attain new levels of performance. You will leverage AWS’ leading AI and cloud services to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that address business problems and accelerate the customer cloud journey. These solutions always have the customer and their experience at the center of everything we do.

You will adeptly interact, communicate and partner with other teams at AWS such as product, marketing, and professional services, and represent your team to executive management. You possess a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. Your dynamism, creativity and passion for excellence will make a positive impact with your customer.

If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while inspiring the impossible, come build the future with us.

** Must be located within 25 miles of San Antonio, TX

Key job responsibilities
As an AWS Solutions Architect, you will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures.

Internally, you will be an advocate acting on behalf of the customer to help drive continual improvements to the AWS platform, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features and services. You will also help shape the future of the Solutions Architecture organisation by helping to hire, coach and mentor others.

In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define or invent cloud-native reference architectures with the worldwide AWS Solutions Architect community. You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelise and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).

A day in the life
There is no typical day. A representative week includes leading a 2-hour architecture review with the customer's platform engineering team on data lake modernization, driving deep technical discussions on design trade-offs. You'll spend a day on-site at the customer's office conducting discovery sessions with new business units, having lunch with the VP of Digital to discuss their AI roadmap and influence strategic direction. Mid-week, you'll build and refine a generative AI demo using RAG architecture for automated drilling report summarization, sync with your account team to align on messaging, and brief specialist teams on complex workloads. You'll present Well-Architected reviews to the customer's cloud center of excellence, write competitive displacement patterns for peer Solutions Architects, participate in hiring debriefs, and lead community sessions to share reference architectures that scale beyond your direct delivery.

About the team
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS National Security Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our National Security Space and Sensor Customers.

As a Solutions Architect on AWS National Security Team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to AWS customers in the Intelligence Community – you are the “face of Amazon” to our customers; you will engage on a broad variety of technical challenges which are not just complex, but mission-critical.

This is a high visibility role where you collaborate with, and influence, both external stakeholders and internal AWS teams including sales and platform engineering. National Security Solutions Architects (SAs) are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies not only on a conceptual level, but also on a practical, architectural level.

As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels – you'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements, envisioning new solutions and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their mission objectives. You'll make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with National Security implications.

Often, the best way to innovate around a customer challenge is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to enhance existing AWS service features and even create entirely new tools to adapt to our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services is looking for experienced and motivated technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance.

Key job responsibilities
• Architect cloud-based solutions in response to complex technical challenges
• In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
• As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
• Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
• Design and implement generative AI, machine learning, and agentic AI architectures using AWS services (Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, Amazon Q) tailored to IC mission requirements
• Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
• Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
• Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
• Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
• Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

title: Business Strategy & Execution Operations Engineering Intern Spring and Summer 2027 (Bellevue, WA )
descriptionHtml:
Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. You'll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places at scale. You'll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day. Here, the impact of what you build isn't abstract, it's visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world's most complex operations moving forward. This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

IMPORTANT NOTE: This role is based out of our corporate office in Bellevue, WA. Applicants must be able to work on-site at our Bellevue, WA office during the spring semester and be available for travel during summer months. During summer months, travel to Amazon fulfillment centers under construction and corporate offices around the US is required.

The Business Strategy & Execution Operations Engineering Internship is an on-site part-time internship (20 hours a week) during the Spring 2027 academic season (February 2027 - May/June 2027) based in our Bellevue, WA corporate office.

Upon school release for Summer 2026 (May/June 2027 - July/August 2027) this position shifts to a 12-week internship "full-time" (40 hours/week) with travel opportunities to fulfillment centers under construction and corporate offices across the United States.

This is a hybrid corporate and field position, combining strategic business work in our corporate office environment with hands-on operations engineering support at fulfillment centers, sort centers, delivery stations, and construction/job trailer environments.

Amazon is searching for innovative and solutions-oriented Business Strategy & Execution Operations Engineering Interns to be a part of our North America initiative to develop and deliver next generation, world-class fulfillment systems while building strategic frameworks that drive operational excellence. What is fulfillment you ask? Fulfillment is how we refer to completing or fulfilling a customer's Amazon.com order and the acts of picking, packing, shipping, sorting and delivering their order to meet or exceed their expectations!

Our Business Strategy & Execution Operations Engineers have the ability to quickly strategize, plan and execute solutions to complex business challenges while building scalable mechanisms that drive standardization, operational efficiency and organizational success. They are comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, using strategic insight and influence to align cross-functional teams and drive coordinated execution across the network. Guided by curiosity, customer obsession, and innovation, they transform ideas into mechanisms that enable NA Operations Engineering’s most advanced business operations.




Key job responsibilities
Drive resolution for strategic business projects by owning and deep diving data to support process improvement recommendations and organizational frameworks.

Build standard operating procedures for teams to follow, ensuring scalable and repeatable business processes.

Develop business plans that help the organization run more smoothly and efficiently during peak operational periods

Guide and coordinate design and execution efforts between internal teams and outside vendors including equipment specifications, material flow, process design, and site layout

Coordinate with local site management to ensure proper operator training, procedural compliance, maintenance and safety practices are followed for new and existing equipment

Manage and streamline administrative operations support, including project tracking systems coordination, documentation management, and identifying opportunities to automate routine administrative processes to improve operational efficiency

Work 12-hour shifts on feet (when supporting field operations)

Cover extensive distances in large warehouse facilities

Use ladders, stairs, and gangways safely

Perform frequent bending, stretching, and reaching motions

Travel to various locations across the United States during summer months

- Available to transition to full-time (40 hours/week) for a 12-week period during Summer 2027 (May/June 2027 - July/August 2027)

title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

On Agentic WorkSpaces our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do. AI agents are no longer chatbots waiting for prompts. They're digital workers - processing claims reconciling invoices securing infrastructure. And they need the same things every employee needs: identity permissions governance and a trusted place to operate. Our team builds the platform which enables enterprise agents to safely execute autonomous work in governed environments.

We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high and the roadmap is concrete with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year. The team is small enough that your work goes to production fast and visibly. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you.

Key job responsibilities
• :
• Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production * Build new services for policy enforcement session recording and replay and human-in-the-loop approval workflows * Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team * Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product * Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces * Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 AM, you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross-team syncs or design reviews. The team is small so you'll know what everyone is working on and when something breaks the whole team rallies. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause - not just the symptom. We encourage responsible AI usage across our development workflow - it's one way our team moves fast. The problems are interesting and the pace is high but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it.

About the team
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
