We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to lead the strategy, execution and performance behind two of the AIM organization's most critical marketing functions: activation management and integrated marketing and campaign planning across Workforce Staffing's global hiring portfolio. This role starts with the customer: understanding hiring needs, translating them into marketing goals, and owning how those goals are achieved. You define how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are strategically planned, measured and optimized, and how the team scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.

As a marketing strategist and cross-functional operator, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across priority geographies globally. You translate complex performance data into decisive activation recommendations, manage daily pacing and spend governance, and own the narrative for senior leadership. You flex between deep-focus, data-rich environments and wide-focus, relationship-heavy environments with equal confidence.

You shape organizational strategy, build trust, drive clarity, and solve problems before they escalate.

Your insights don't just inform decisions — they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps and align business managers on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement. You build the trust, mechanisms, and reporting that close the existing gap. You don't wait for perfect data — you make decisions with what exists and build toward what's needed.


Key job responsibilities
Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the annual marketing strategy and plan the direction for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order trajectory across your portfolio. Lead quarterly strategy reviews, updating priorities based on performance data, market shifts, and evolving business needs. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Push back on media recommendations with data where channel performance does not support continued investment.

Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across assigned markets, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for assigned markets, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events. Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate changing labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive collaboration with Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Creative, Talent Engagement, Marketing Analytics, and Business stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams. Bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Manage a wide portfolio of countries with varying levels of data maturity, labour order certainty, and stakeholder sophistication.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Oversee daily pacing reviews, implementing ramp-down or pause decisions when application delivery targets are met. Share insights with Performance Marketing to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own escalation thresholds and spend decision governance.

Stakeholder Communication & Alignment: Own weekly and monthly Business Review deep dive presentations for senior leadership, translating risk sites and marketing performance into clear strategic narrative. Maintain regular alignment with Business Managers and cross-functional partners on fill rate risk and marketing actions. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases. Adapt communication to audience maturity — from sophisticated data-driven forums to foundational trust-building conversations.

Application Quality & Fill Rate Improvement: Monitor performance against goals including fill rate, non-paid application share, spend per hire, and application-to-usable application ratios. Implement data-driven optimisations for underperforming sites. Identify quality gaps (geo-targeting, shift messaging, channel mix) and coordinate with Paid Marketing, Creative, and Owned Marketing teams to resolve. Own the activation logic that balances cost efficiency with fill rate delivery.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes — from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.


A day in the life
Your morning starts with reviewing overnight pacing data across your markets and making activation decisions for the day. You join the weekly reporting call with your stakeholders, leading the marketing view for your area with a clear recommendation for each at-risk site. Mid-morning, you're on a stakeholder call with business partners in Brazil translating application pacing risk into language they understand and building alignment on marketing levers available. After lunch, you're deep-diving a high-spend site in Germany where channel efficiency has dropped — pulling site-level data, identifying the issue, and producing an internal discussion analysis for the Paid Marketing team. In the afternoon, you're working through quarterly initiatives with other teams — defining what to learn, which markets to test in, and how results will inform next quarter's strategy. Later, you prepare the MBR narrative for senior leadership, connecting this month’s activation decisions to fill rate outcomes. You close the day connecting the dots: what patterns are emerging across your portfolio, what's working, what needs to change, and how to translate that into the quarterly strategy update you're presenting to leadership next week.

Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences — engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience in marketing or marketing research
- Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership
- Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using SQL to pull data and metrics to deliver reports

title: Data Science Manager, Security Compliance Engineering, Stores Security
descriptionHtml:
Security is moving from something builders stop for to something that runs quietly inside how they already work: guidance that shows up in their tools as they code, and continuous checks that replace the weeks-long review queue. Behind that shift is data. Knowing which controls a service actually needs, surfacing where real risk lives across a massive portfolio, whether the guidance we give is accurate enough to trust, and whether any of it is genuinely reducing risk. You'll lead the data science and data engineering team that answers those questions and makes that whole model measurable.

Proving efficacy at scale is where you'll have the biggest impact. It's easy to ship guidance, but hard to know it's working: that it's accurate, that builders act on it, that fewer issues reach production because of it. You'll own the data that turns those into answers leaders can act on, and the feedback loop that uses every issue we find to make the guidance smarter so the same problem never recurs.

You'll be the leader who gets the craft of data scientists, data engineers, and business intelligence engineers, and can bring them together as one group with a shared direction. You'll set the vision, raise the technical bar, and build the foundations good science depends on: trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research.

You'll love this role if you enjoy:

- Turning security from a gate into a default, and proving with data that the shift actually works.
- Finding where risk really lives, using data and models to surface the issues and high-risk code that matter most before they reach production.
- Answering hard measurement questions at scale: is our guidance accurate, are builders acting on it, are fewer issues reaching production?
- Working across disciplines, using science, analytics, and engineering together so each makes the others stronger.
- Standing up something new: shaping the strategy, culture, and standards for a team ready for its first dedicated data leader.
- Growing engineers and scientists and watching them take on bigger scope because of how you invested in them.

Key job responsibilities
- Set the strategy, roadmap, and technical direction for a combined data science and data engineering team, turning an ambiguous, fast-moving security mission into clear, prioritized work and partnering with tech and business leadership to shape the vision.
- Own how we measure whether embedded security is working: build the metrics, experiments, and analysis that show whether guidance is accurate, whether builders act on it, and whether fewer issues reach production because of it.
- Lead the data science behind risk identification and the compounding feedback loop: surface where real risk lives across a large portfolio, scope which controls each service needs, and make sure every issue found feeds back into smarter guidance so the same problem does not recur.
- Determine the right mix of science, data engineering, and BI resources, use those disciplines to complement rather than duplicate one another, and lead senior individual contributors credibly across both the science and engineering sides of the team.
- Hold the bar on quality and delivery: judge whether outputs are trustworthy and ready to inform decisions or ship, without letting work be under-scoped or over-engineered, and invest in the data foundation of trusted data, reliable pipelines, and reproducible research. Own the results and credit the people who deliver them.
- Grow the team and manage ambiguity: develop scientists and engineers into bigger scope, support in-flight discipline transitions, establish the shared standards and data culture that let the team deliver without you, and mitigate risks and escalate with good judgment before they become roadblocks.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of building quantitative solutions as a scientist or science manager experience
- 2+ years of scientists or machine learning engineers management experience
- 5+ years of applying statistical models for large-scale application and building automated analytical systems experience
- PhD in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field
- Knowledge of Python or R or other scripting language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a least one area of Machine Learning (NLP, Regression, Classification, Clustering, or Anomaly Detection)
- Experience with fairness in machine learning and artificial intelligence to detect and remove bias in ML/AI systems

title: Software Development Engineer II
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking for an opportunity to build a highly available, large scale, enterprise-wide software solution? Does it excite you to find patterns and build generic, composable software solutions to solve complex problems? Are you looking for inventing newer and simpler ways of building solutions? If so, we are looking for you to fill a challenging position in Amazon Finance Automation Payroll Technology team.
Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights.  As an SDE II on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g., significant component, set of features, mid-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g., performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.) You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time (or at least minimize incidental complexity). You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over-engineering. You re-use where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g., designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned engineer. In this position, you will play a leading role in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large-scale and complex financial applications. You will push your design and architecture limits by inventing and simplifying complex problems. You have strong verbal and written communication skills, are self-driven, and can deliver high quality results in a fast-paced environment. You will work with Amazon engineering and business teams across the globe in planning, designing, executing and implementing this new platform.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Software Development Engineer II, CloudWatch Collectors
descriptionHtml:
Come and build the future with us as we change the way the world sees the Cloud!

CloudWatch is the observability platform of AWS, built for developers, system operators, site reliability engineers (SRE), and IT managers. CloudWatch collects monitoring and operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, providing a unified view of AWS resources, applications and services that run on AWS, and on-premises servers. Customers use CloudWatch to set high resolution alarms, visualise logs and metrics side by side, take automated actions, troubleshoot issues, and discover insights to optimise their applications, and ensure they are running smoothly. The CloudWatch team in Dublin is growing and we are looking for exceptional software development engineers to create the next generation CloudWatch experience.

CloudWatch is one of the largest real time data platforms in the world, processing more than 68 quadrillion metric observations per month and growing fast! This requires teams in CloudWatch to innovate at an unprecedented scale. In CloudWatch we love giving customers what they want: high quality, highly usable, highly available services. It's humbling and energizing to work with excellent, dedicated engineers to build and deliver world-leading service monitoring solutions at AWS scale.

We're looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we've been building.

Key job responsibilities
As a Software Development Engineer for the CloudWatch organisation, you will work in an agile team to design, build and maintain highly available, massively scaled systems used by millions of users worldwide. You will design and implement complex software to the highest quality for the services you and your team own, building our telemetry collection agents in Rust and Go and engaging with the upstream open-source communities, such as OpenTelemetry, that our software is built on and contributes to.

You will help expand our services across all AWS Regions, and when issues arise you will dive deep to understand the root cause and apply fixes that prevent them recurring. You will leverage GenAI and AI-powered development tools to enhance your productivity while staying current with emerging technologies, and you will also mentor junior engineers, helping grow the technical capability of the team.

A day in the life
On a typical day you might root-cause a collection issue affecting a fleet of hosts, ship a new feature in one of our agents, take a change upstream to OpenTelemetry, or design a solution to a performance or footprint problem you have never seen before. You translate customer and internal requirements into designs, weigh the tradeoffs, and break the work into incremental deliverables your team can ship. A strong community of senior and principal engineers gives direct feedback and pushes your thinking. You are surrounded by people who are passionate about observability and who believe there is still a lot of ground to cover in helping developers, SREs, and operators understand their systems.

About the team
We own telemetry collection for CloudWatch: the agents that run on millions of hosts and containers across AWS and gather the metrics, logs, and traces that everything else in CloudWatch is built on. Our software is written in Rust and Go and built on OpenTelemetry, and we contribute back to those open-source communities. We are a growing team in Dublin, and our mission is to give every AWS customer a reliable, low-overhead way to collect the telemetry their systems produce.

We invest in growing our engineers from day one. You will be paired with a buddy, work closely with senior and principal engineers.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Strong programming skills in at least two of the following: Rust, Go, Java, C++, Python

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Open-source enthusiasm and contributions (e.g. a GitHub portfolio, or contributions to projects such as OpenTelemetry)

title: Propulsion Functional Technician, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing experience with flight hardware and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Additional Requirements:

Standing for long periods of time, climbing up and down ladders, bending, grasping, sitting, pulling, pushing, stooping, and stretching may be required to perform the functions of this position

Able to lift-up to 25lbs. unassisted

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Candidates must be 18 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirements and safety guidelines.

The starting pay for this role in Washington State is up to $33.50 / hour and employees are eligible for incremental raises based on tenure. This information is provided per the Washington State Pay Transparency Act. Base pay information is based on market location. Applicants should apply via Amazon’s internal or external careers site.

Key job responsibilities
Assemble, fabricate, and process materials into complex manufactured products across propulsion subsystems per engineering documentation and SOPs, following one or more defined process paths.

Learn to perform troubleshooting activities associated with manufacturing products, observing, receiving, and obtaining information from all relevant sources to assist in debug and root cause analysis. Seek guidance when deviation from available procedures is needed.

Learn to perform hardware inspections and document discrepancies. May assist with development stage assemblies and first article builds under guidance of senior peers.

Read, interpret, and work from engineering documentation and drawings following well established processes.

Provide engineers with feedback on tooling, consumables, debug observations, and process issues through structured channels such as MES WOT entries.

Identify training needs for the team and assist in the training of new hires and junior peers to help them scale in their role.

Contribute to process improvement ideas within your project scope, working with leaders and engineers individually or in group settings.

Follow best practices as defined by leaders, lead techs, manuals, and SOPs. Meet productivity and quality standards consistently.

Uphold job and site safety standards and operations protocol. Follow proper procedure when quality or safety issues occur.

Attempt to resolve individual work blockers before escalating. Identify additional tasks once assigned work is complete and communicate to Lead Technician before proceeding.

Utilize MES and SAP systems for production tracking, traceability, and work order documentation. Capture and record data accurately in applicable systems.

May assist with servicing, repairing, calibrating, regulating, fine tuning, and testing machines, devices, and equipment.

Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization.

A day in the life
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will perform a variety of hardware manufacturing, testing and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems to ensure hardware meets production requirements for flight. They will work closely with engineering teams to provide feedback on processes and identify improvements.
This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

Basic qualifications

- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- High school diploma or equivalent
- 2+ years relevant aerospace/automotive manufacturing experience or equivalent industry experience
- 2+ years of hands-on work experience with electro-mechanical assemblies, final integration and/or harness integration experience
- 2+ year’s experience in a fast-paced production environment with flight hardware
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, etc.)
- Proficiency in reading, interpreting, and working from engineering documentation and/or drawings
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment

Preferred qualifications

- Aircraft & Powerplant certification/license, automotive certifications, or other technical certifications/Associate's degree
- Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements
- Experience working with MES software packages (SAP, SFC transactions, traceability)
- Experience with root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective action processes
- Experience contributing to or owning SOP development and process documentation
- Experience with 6S, Kaizen, or continuous improvement methodologies
- Experience with PCBA inspection/rework and troubleshooting

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: UX Designer, Shopping Design
descriptionHtml:
As a UX Designer for Shopping Design, you will design solutions for difficult design and technical challenges that enable customers to make confident buying decisions across our growing and diverse product catalog. You'll craft experiences that are simple, fluid, and beautiful while working within defined product strategies to deliver the right information at the right time.

title: Systems Development Engineer, ESC Managed Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS has successfully launched the European Sovereign Cloud (ESC), marking a significant development in Utility Computing (UC). To spearhead this initiative, we are actively seeking experienced systems development engineers with a strong background in automation and operations. As part of the AWS Managed Operations team, you will play a pivotal role in building, operating and evolving operations and development teams dedicated to delivering high-availability AWS services, including EC2, S3, Dynamo, Lambda, and Bedrock, exclusively for EU customers. For more information on ESC please check out our blog: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/in-the-works-aws-european-sovereign-cloud/

Your responsibilities will encompass overseeing the ongoing operations and expansion of the ESC, working closely with global AWS teams, and influencing the evolution of AWS services and technology. A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring continuous improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You will be required to occasionally participate in "on-call" rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

The overarching goal is to deliver scalable services and ensure a high-availability experience for EU customers. If you are an experienced professional ready for a challenging and impactful opportunity, we invite you to join our efforts in operating and scaling a best-in-class development engineering and operations team that aligns with AWS' commitment to customer satisfaction and continual innovation.

Utility Computing (UC)
European Sovereign Cloud (ESC) is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC).
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Managed Operations engineers engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Eligibility requirement
- Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
- Candidate must be a national of an EU member state and residing in the EU to operate the AWS European Sovereign Cloud.
- Amazon will provide relocation support for successful applicants relocating within the European Union.
- Employees will participate in an On-Call rota.

A day in the life
A typical day in this role involves collaborating with technology leaders, contributing to the enhancement of day-to-day operations, and ensuring improvements in availability, reliability, latency, performance, and efficiency of the ESC. You’ll spend roughly 50% of your time operating production systems and 50% working with your team to make long-term improvements to the reliability, availability, and performance of those software systems. Over the course of a week, you will root cause why some deployments recently failed, and fix those bugs. Later in the week you may execute a highly sensitive time-critical change to production. You can round off the week by participating in design discussions by another team, writing code, and providing actionable feedback to your team’s code. You will be required to occasionally participate in “on-call” rotations to resolve incidents occurring out-of-hours.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.


Basic qualifications

- Experience developing software code in one or more programming languages (java, python, etc.)
- Experience in Linux OS and network troubleshooting, or experience in networking administration and troubleshooting
- This role requires you to be a national of an EU member state
- Experience in engineering, working with hardware, software, networking, operating systems
- Experience designing systems for performance, simplicity, and scalability, durability, cost, and security.

Preferred qualifications

- Able to lead the creation, revision, and/or improvement of standard operational procedures (SOPs) and driving operational best practices.
- Experience actively mentoring junior engineers and working cross-organizationally and leading strategic team efforts requiring work from multiple team members
- Experience operating 24x7 high-availability, distributed software applications and performance tuning software applications and optimizing fleet utilization
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (such as CDK, CloudFormation, Puppet, Chef, Ansible, or similar) and monitoring frameworks (such as CloudWatch, Datadog, Grafana, Elastic or similar).
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Generative AI technologies, including automated deployment, configuration management, continuous integration workflows, prompt engineering, model deployment, and AI-powered automation tools

title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Applied AI Solutions
descriptionHtml:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

On Agentic WorkSpaces, our vision is to enable AI agents to work the way humans do — with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. For enterprises to trust autonomous agents with their essential business applications, they need a full suite of governance capabilities: an identity for every agent, human-in-the-loop controls to audit and approve what agents do, and the ability for a human intervene in an agent's session when required. Our team is building these systems end to end. Upcoming launches will give every agent a verifiable identity, record every desktop action as a reviewable visual audit trail, enforce policy on every tool call before it executes, pause agents for human approval on sensitive actions, and let a human take control of an agent's session mid-task before handing it back to the agent, which resumes with full context of what changed. Identity and agentic governance present hard problems in our industry today, and we're excited to on the forefront of solving them.

We're looking for an SDE II who can ramp quickly deliver features end-to-end and thrive in greenfield work. Much of what we're building doesn't exist yet. You'll take early designs to production make pragmatic calls about what to build versus what to compose from existing AWS services and ship on a schedule tied to real customer milestones. The pace is high with re:Invent deliverables targeted for this year and an ambitious 2027 roadmap. If you like owning features from design through production and want your work to be the reason enterprises trust AI agents this team is for you.

Key job responsibilities
• Own features end-to-end: design implement test deploy and operate in production
* Build new services for policy enforcement, session recording and replay, human-in-the-loop approval workflows, and human takeover of agent sessions
* Integrate with AWS services and make build-vs-compose decisions with your team
* Handle customer content with care: recording pipelines retention and access controls where correctness is the product
* Collaborate with engineers on adjacent teams to unblock dependencies and align on interfaces
* Contribute to operational excellence: oncall runbooks alarms and incident response

A day in the life
Your mornings are usually free for focus work - writing code reviewing CRs and working through whatever problem you've picked up. Around 11 you'll have standup then grab lunch with the team (if you like) before the afternoon opens up for integration work cross-team syncs or design reviews. Our pipelines are full CD our ticket queue is small and when something pages us we fix the root cause - not just the symptom. We encourage responsible AI usage across our development workflow - it's one way our team moves fast. The problems are interesting and the pace is high but we believe we can move fast do exceptional work and have a full life outside of it.

title: Shift Manager Delivery Station, Amazon Logistics
descriptionHtml:
When you join Amazon as an Area Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.
Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. You will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential, As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations.
Job Specifics:
- This role is fully onsite and requires flexibility to work and rotate shifts: weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, and Ability to work overtime both in peak season and as needed.

Key job responsibilities
- Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyze and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
- Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
- Analyze performance and suggest process improvements to optimize work and improve customer service
- Promote best practice and continuous process improvements across your team in areas like health and safety and productivity
- Collaborate with other managers to standardize shift processes


A day in the life
You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritizing routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.

Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analyzing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

descriptionHtml:
※このポジションの勤務地は大阪府茨木市近郊を予定しています。

当社の物流拠点のビジネスゴールを達成するためにチームのオペレーションを管理する責任を負います。あなたのチームは20～300 名程度のメンバーで構成されます。数十億円の予算規模の年間の運営計画を立て、その実行責任を負います。分析スキルや問題解決スキルに加え、チームとしてパフォーマンス目標を確実に達成するため、メンバーと良好な関係を構築し、チームのリーダーシップを強化するためのコーチングやメンタリングなどの人材管理スキルを発揮することやや新しいサービスの導入を進めていく改善スキル、推進力も期待されます。

私たちは毎年新しいオペレーション拠点を立ち上げ、プロフェッショナルとしての成長機会を提供しています。パートタイムのアソシエイトからDirectorまで、多様なBackgroundを持つメンバーとのCross-functionalワークを通じて、新しい視点やスキルを身に付けることができます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
【キャリアパス】
Operations Managerは、大きな組織をリードしリージョンやネットワークの取り組みを実行する次のSite LeaderまたはSenior Operations Managerへと成長することが期待されます。また、Supply Chain、Transportation、およびLogisticsなどAmazon のオペレーションのあらゆるOpportunityを模索することもできます。

【具体的な業務内容】
- 物流拠点運営、ソートおよびディスパッチオペレーションのリードおよび監督
- シフト全体の安全性、品質、パフォーマンス、カスタマーサービス向上
- 組織の方針と手順に従っての監督責任
- オペレーション目標の達成、および、それを上回る成果の実現
- 物量等の予測に基づく、戦略的な計画立案、パフォーマンスの評価、問題の解決および人材配置に関するニーズへの対応
- メンバーがより生産的で、パフォーマンスが高く、多様性があり、インクルーシブになるようサポート、指導し、動機付けします。チームメンバーの個人的な成功に対するビジョンとコミットメントを持って、共感を持ってリーダーシップを発揮し、楽しく仕事をし、メンバーに楽しんでもらいましょう。
- Learning and Talent Developmentチームとのパートナーシップにより、人材の獲得、パフォーマンスとキャリア開発、育成、サクセッションプランに関する計画の立案と実行
- 年間のオペレーション計画を編成し、日次/週次の生産計画と実績確認、短期/長期の需要変動対応、3PLを含む関係者との調整を通じて、コストを管理しながら、年間のオペレーション計画を実行します。
- DEI やSustainability関連の大規模プロジェクトや、Family Day、ボランティアイベントなどの大規模イベントをリードします。
- 部署間、シフト間、およびネットワーク間でベストプラクティスが着実に共有されるように、積極的なアクションを講じます。

このポジションに求められるのは、経験に裏打ちされたプロセスの改善能力と、Amazonの成長速度に合わせ、メンバーのモチベーションを高めながらさまざまなチャレンジに対して短期間で成果を出していく能力を持つ候補者です。また、さまざまな経験、バックグラウンドを持つ多様なメンバーと協業していく柔軟性が求められます。
まだ若い組織であり、組織やビジネスとともに成長できる高い意欲とポテンシャルをもった方を求めています。

title: Senior Program Manager, Financial Deductions
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to own the strategy that eliminates millions in vendor financial friction? Amazon's EU Financial Deductions Vendor Compliance Program (FD VCP) is seeking a Program Manager III to drive strategic program design, cross-functional stakeholder alignment, and scalable mechanism-building across our global vendor compliance ecosystem. You'll operate as a single-threaded owner with full autonomy — from problem definition to solution design, stakeholder alignment, launch, and impact measurement — turning pilot programs into scaled, multi-marketplace operations.

This is not your typical program management role. You'll shape the strategic direction of a dual-service model — Proactive account management and E2E Financial dispute settlement — partnering closely with the Account Management leadership who owns business goals and team execution. Your focus will be on designing program frameworks, building governance mechanisms, driving vendor experience transformation (VSAT), and influencingcross-functional teams spanning FinOps, Amazon Vendor Services, Retail, Item and Supply Management, and Category Leadership to unlock operational efficiencies and sustained metric improvement at scale.

Key job responsibilities
Drive continuous program improvement by defining success metrics, building measurement frameworks, and enabling data-driven decision making across WBR, MBR, QBR, and Account Manager Scorecard governance cadences

Design and scale proactive vendor defect prevention programs across marketplaces by building globally replicable playbooks, operating models, and program frameworks that convert pilot programs into multi-marketplace operations

Influence senior leadership stakeholders to secure investment decisions, resource allocation, and strategic buy-in for program growth by writing effective narratives (BRDs, PR-FAQs) and presenting to directors and vice presidents

Partner with cross-functional teams (FinOps, AVS, Retail, ISM, Category Leadership) to define program strategy, set objectives, analyze data, and drive measurable improvements — proactively identifying and mitigating risks across teams, processes, and systems before they become roadblocks

Own the vendor experience transformation roadmap (VSAT), designing engagement frameworks and feedback mechanisms that improve vendor satisfaction while partnering with Account Management leadership on execution and delivery


About the team
Join the EU FD VCP team where you'll own the strategic program roadmap that is driving millions in vendor financial recovery across Amazon's vendor compliance ecosystem — launching programs in new countries, designing scalable frameworks, and shaping the vendor experience across marketplaces. Our vision is to be recognized as the worldwide specialized center of excellence for Financial Deductions, empowering Retail and Amazon Vendor Services teams across all Amazon marketplaces with expert resolution support, proactive dispute prevention, and scalable financial health solutions that reclaim critical bandwidth and drive vendor satisfaction.

title: HR Business Partner, FC HR
descriptionHtml:
愛知県名古屋市港区の大規模物流拠点（フルフィルメントセンター/以下FC）にて、ハンズオンで業務遂行が可能なHRビジネスパートナー（HRBP）を募集しています。
HRBPは、担当するFCで働く従業員をカスタマーと考え、FCのリーダーの戦略パートナーとして、ビジネス成長に欠かせない組織・人材面の意思決定をサポートする上での重要な役割を担います。
組織開発、人材育成・配置、キャリア形成の機会、組織文化の醸成など、短期・中長期にわたるさまざまなHRソリューションを人事部門の他チームやメンバーと連携・協働しながら提供します。
また、勤務地は愛知県名古屋市ですが、影響範囲は勤務するFCに留まらず、様々なプロジェクトを通じて他拠点にも貢献する機会があります。

このポジションでは、採用、評価、配置、退職といった一連の人事管理と、FCで働く従業員の勤怠や労務環境を管理する労務管理について、ハンズオンなアプローチで責任を持って業務遂行して頂きます。

これらの業務を遂行するため、高いコミュニケーション能力とハンズオンのアプローチが必要です。また、論理的かつ分析能力に優れ、労働法、組織開発、報酬・福利厚生等における幅広い知識を持っている必要があります。

title: Applied Scientist, Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI)
descriptionHtml:
Alexa+ is Amazon’s next-generation, AI-powered virtual assistant. Building on the original Alexa, it uses generative AI to deliver a more conversational, personalised, and effective experience. Alexa Sensitive Content Intelligence (ASCI) team is developing responsible AI (RAI) solutions for Alexa+, empowering it to provide useful information responsibly.

The Mission
Build AI safety systems that protect millions of Alexa customers every day. As conversational AI evolves, you'll solve challenging problems in Responsible AI by ensuring LLMs provide safe, trustworthy responses, building AI systems that understand nuanced human values across cultures, and maintaining customer trust at scale.

What You'll Build
You'll pioneer breakthrough solutions in Responsible AI at Amazon's scale. Imagine training models that set new safety standards, designing automated testing systems that hunt for vulnerabilities before they surface, and certifying the systems that power millions of daily conversations. You'll create intelligent evaluation systems that judge responses with human-level insight, build models that truly understand what makes interactions safe and delightful, and craft feedback mechanisms that help Alexa+ grasp the nuances of complex customer conversations. Here's where it gets even more exciting: you'll build AI agents that act as your team's safety net—automatically detecting and fixing production issues in real-time, often before anyone notices there was a problem. Your innovations won't just improve Alexa+; they'll fundamentally shape how it learns, evolves, and earns customer trust. As Alexa+ continues to delight customers, your work ensures it becomes more trustworthy, safer, and deeply aligned with customer needs and expectations.

Your work directly protects customer trust at Amazon's scale. Every innovation you create—from novel safety mechanisms to sophisticated evaluation techniques—shapes how millions of people interact with AI confidently. You're not just building products; you're defining industry standards for responsible AI.

This is frontier research with immediate real-world impact. You'll tackle problems that require innovative solutions: training models that remain truthful and grounded across diverse contexts, building reward models that capture the nuanced spectrum of human values across cultures and languages, and creating automated systems that continuously discover and address potential issues before customers encounter them. You'll collaborate with world-class scientists, product managers, and engineers to transform state-of-the-art ideas into production systems serving millions.

What We're Looking For

* Deep expertise in state-of-the-art NLP, Large Language Models
* Track record of building scalable ML systems
* Passion for impactful research—where frontier science meets real-world responsibility at scale
* Excitement about solving problems that will shape the future of AI

Ready to work on AI safety challenges that define the industry? Join us.


Key job responsibilities
The Responsible AI (RAI) team is at the forefront of building AI systems that are safe, ethical, and trustworthy. As an Applied Scientist-II, you'll be a key contributor to end-to-end Responsible AI solutions—developing and refining algorithms that detect and eliminate false information, building models that identify vulnerabilities exploited by bad actors, and training systems that understand human values across diverse cultures. Working alongside world-class engineers and scientists, you'll apply state-of-the-art NLP and computer vision techniques to content classification and safety challenges—turning cutting-edge research into production systems that protect millions of customers daily.

But here's what makes this role exciting: you'll grow into a future leader. You'll contribute to identifying, defining, and mitigating AI safety risks early—helping protect customers before they're impacted—while building deep expertise in responsible AI. You'll work within multi-agent architectures, implementing components where distributed AI systems maintain human oversight and control. Every model you build and every experiment you run—from consensus-driven reasoning modules to orchestration components—will directly strengthen trustworthy AI at the world's largest scale.

A day in the life
As a Responsible AI Scientist, you're at the frontier of AI safety—experimenting with breakthrough techniques that push the boundaries of what's possible. You partner with engineering to transform research into production-ready solutions, tackling complex optimization challenges. You brainstorm with Product teams, translating ambitious visions into concrete objectives that drive real impact. Your expertise shapes critical deployment decisions as you review impactful work and guide go/no-go calls. You mentor the next generation of AI safety leaders, watching ideas spark and capabilities grow. This is where science meets impact—building AI that's not just intelligent, but trustworthy and aligned with human values.

About the team
Our team pioneers Responsible AI for conversational assistants. We ensure Alexa delivers safe, trustworthy experiences across all devices, modalities, and languages worldwide. We work on frontier AI safety challenges—and we're looking for scientists who want to help shape the future of trustworthy AI.

The term “sensitive content” includes within its scope a wide range of categories of content such as offensive content (e.g., hate speech, racist speech), profanity, content that is suitable only for certain age groups, politically polarizing content, and religiously polarizing content. The term “content” refers to any material that is exposed to customers by Alexa (including both 1P and 3P experiences) and includes text, speech, audio, and video.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development

title: Strategic Sourcing Specialist, Global Corporate Procurement
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) team manages several billions in annual global spend across Professional Services — spanning areas such as Risk and Insurance, Banking, Financial Services, Software Implementations, Protective Services, Audit and Accounting, and Legal Services. As the organization's demand for these services continues to grow, so does the need for procurement professionals who can deliver meaningful savings targets while maintaining quality and enabling business agility.

This Strategic Sourcing Specialist role sits within the Professional Services category and supports complex, global sourcing engagements valued in the tens of millions of dollars. You will partner with business units across Amazon — including Tax, Legal, HR, and Technology — acting as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into effective sourcing strategies. On the supplier side, you will negotiate directly with C-level executives to secure sustainable, long-term partnerships that deliver value at scale.

At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive measurable cost savings across complex, global sourcing engagements valued in the tens of millions of dollars, from strategy development through to contract execution
- Design and lead end-to-end sourcing strategies that balance business needs, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency across multiple categories
- Act as a trusted advisor to business units — including Tax, Legal, HR, and Technology — translating their requirements into procurement solutions that deliver value
- Negotiate commercial terms and contracts directly with C-level supplier executives to secure sustainable, long-term partnerships
- Grow procurement's influence across the organization by expanding the scope of spend under management and demonstrating the strategic value of the function
- Deliver procurement analytics and data-driven insights that inform category strategies and support stakeholder decision-making
- Provide structured project management across sourcing initiatives, ensuring milestones are met and results are delivered on time
- Conduct market research and benchmarking to identify opportunities, assess supplier landscapes, and inform sourcing recommendations
- Contribute to the development of category management plans that drive long-term value and supplier performance
- Influence business unit leaders to adopt improved procurement practices and embed procurement earlier in their planning processes

A day in the life
Your morning might start with a cross-functional alignment call for an upcoming RFP involving three business units, followed by analyzing bid responses and building a recommendation deck for senior leadership. After lunch, you could be on a negotiation call with a strategic supplier's C-suite to finalize contract terms, then pivoting to a spend review with Finance to validate savings actuals against targets. You might close the day by coaching a business partner through the supplier evaluation framework for an upcoming engagement. No two days look the same — you will balance long-range strategic planning with hands-on execution, often managing five or more active sourcing engagements simultaneously across different stages of the lifecycle.

About the team
Global Corporate Procurement (GCP) manages Amazon's indirect spend across Employee Services, Marketing, Professional Services, Technology, Logistics, and Real Estate and Facilities. We are a global team of sourcing professionals who combine analytical rigor with creative problem-solving to deliver sustainable value at scale. Our culture values deep ownership, intellectual curiosity, and a bias for action — we move fast, but we move smart. Your work will be visible to senior leadership and directly tied to Amazon's bottom line.

Basic qualifications

- Experience with international procurement
- Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)
- Experience managing multiple indirect spend categories, some of which may include the following: IT Software, IT Services, Corporate Services, Marketing, Contingent Labor, Facilities and Real Estate, Capital Expenditure, and Human Resources/Employee Services

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in project management
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Demonstrated experience in Professional Services including sourcing and managing spend

title: Sr. Product Designer, Prime Video Experience Design
descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in shaping the future of live entertainment experiences?

Prime Video is redefining how customers discover, follow, and engage with the content and moments that matter most to them. Across live sports, breaking news, linear channels, and special events, we are creating more intuitive, personalized, and connected ways for customers to find what is happening now, understand why it matters, and stay engaged before, during, and after the live experience.

The Prime Video Experience Design (PVXD) studio is seeking a strategic, hands-on Senior Product Designer to help define the next generation of live and intelligent entertainment experiences. You will lead high-impact design initiatives across sports, news, and live TV categories, shaping how customers move from discovery and anticipation to live viewing, catch-up, and re-engagement.

This role is ideal for a senior individual contributor who thrives in ambiguity, combines strong product thinking with exceptional interaction design craft, and can turn emerging opportunities into tangible customer experiences. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Science, and Design teams to develop experience visions, build interactive prototypes, test hypotheses, and influence product direction.

You are equally comfortable framing a long-term customer vision, designing polished cross-device interactions, and rapidly prototyping new approaches. You recognize that great live experiences are not only about what customers see, but how the product responds to context, timing, personal interests, and the unfolding story.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end product design for high-impact initiatives across sports, news, live channels, and other real-time entertainment experiences.
- Define customer journeys and interaction patterns that connect live discovery, event anticipation, viewing, key moments, catch-up, and ongoing engagement.
- Translate ambiguous opportunities into clear customer problems, hypotheses, experience principles, and scalable design frameworks.
- Design intuitive, personalized experiences that help customers understand what is live, what matters now, and what to watch next.
- Explore AI-enabled and context-aware experiences, including personalized storytelling, recommendations, insights, and natural-language interactions, in close collaboration with technical partners.
- Create wireframes, high-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes, and production-ready specifications across devices and surfaces.
- Rapidly prototype and validate new concepts with Product, Engineering, Research, and Science partners, using AI-assisted workflows where they accelerate learning.
- Drive systems-level thinking and consistency across sports, news, and linear experiences while respecting the distinct needs of each content category.
- Influence product strategy and roadmap priorities through customer insight, design rationale, experimentation results, and clear storytelling.
- Present work to senior stakeholders, mentor designers, and raise the bar for design craft, collaboration, and customer obsession.

A day in the life
As a Senior Product Designer on the Sports, News & Linear Experiences team, your work will span strategy, detailed product design, and hands-on experimentation.

One day, you may be shaping an intelligent live hub that helps customers navigate games, news coverage, channels, and special events. Another day, you may be prototyping how fans discover an important moment across simultaneous games, or exploring how a news viewer can quickly catch up on a developing story. You may work with engineers and scientists to test a context-aware experience using real signals, then translate those learnings into clear design direction.

You will own meaningful customer problems while collaborating across multiple initiatives and surfaces. Success requires strong individual design ownership, a bias toward learning through making, and the ability to bring clarity and alignment to complex, fast-moving opportunities.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience
- An available online portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work
- Experience designing across complex customer journeys and multi-surface experiences
- Strong experience with modern design tools such as Figma and prototyping platforms
- Experience building interactive prototypes that communicate concepts and validate customer hypotheses
- Strong visual, interaction, and systems-thinking design skills
- Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams in highly cross-functional environments
- Excellent communication and storytelling skills, including presenting to senior stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience designing for sports, live events, media, or entertainment platforms
- Experience working in rapid prototyping environments using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code, or similar AI-assisted workflows
- Experience designing data-rich and real-time interaction experiences
- Strong product strategy and service design thinking
- Experience defining design frameworks, principles, and scalable experience patterns
- Experience mentoring designers and helping elevate team craft
- Comfort working in highly ambiguous, fast-moving product spaces

title: HR Partner, Human Resources, NASC PXT
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Partner role offers an exceptional opportunity to build your career in human resources, focusing on employee experience, engagement, leadership development and HR operational excellence.

As an HR Partner on the NASC PXT team, you will support PXT operations through consistent standard work execution, relationship-building, and timely issue resolution. With a visible presence across site operations, you'll foster team culture, support engagement, and coach leaders on PXT practices. You'll create positive employee experiences while building your skills in navigating increasingly complex issues and influencing without authority. Success in this role comes from building strong partnerships, demonstrating sound judgment, and maintaining a customer-centric approach. You'll learn to use data-driven insights and HR technologies to enhance the employee experience while developing core HR capabilities that will serve as the foundation for your career growth.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility.

Key job responsibilities
- Support a positive employee experience by executing key programs, reinforcing workplace standards, and partnering with PXT and Operations to create a culture where employees feel valued, heard, and supported.

- Execute standard work with consistent quality and timeliness, meeting established service level agreements (SLAs) and maintaining accurate documentation of HR processes and employee interactions.

- Provide frontline employee support by responding to inquiries, addressing concerns, and ensuring appropriate resolution or escalation of employee matters. Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

- Assist in running and monitoring feedback channels such as roundtables, floor walks, and employee engagement activities. Support issue tracking and follow-up, partnering with senior PXT team members to drive resolutions and improvements in employee experience.

- Coach frontline leaders on behaviors that impact engagement and retention. Reinforce expectations and guide leaders in selecting and effectively utilizing available tools to improve team communication, recognition, and performance conversations.

- Support the execution of site-level engagement, communication, and culture-building initiatives. Coordinate logistics, gather feedback, and monitor effectiveness.

- Learn to track and summarize PXT-related data (e.g., attrition/attendance trends, hiring data, employee sentiment). Help prepare insights for site reviews or team discussions.

- Promote the use of self-service tools to resolve routine employee and manager questions. Help identify recurring gaps and escalate opportunities to improve tool usability or adoption.

A day in the life
A typical day involves balancing standard work execution with responsive employee support. You'll maintain consistent presence on the operations floor, engaging directly with hourly employees and partnering with leaders to address concerns and drive engagement initiatives. Operating under the guidance of senior team members, you'll execute core HR processes while ensuring quality service delivery.

Through data tools and HR technologies, you'll assist in tracking metrics and identifying trends, while developing your ability to build trust through personal interaction. You'll support employee engagement activities, help coordinate feedback channels, and assist in coaching and development of others. When complex issues arise, you'll seek guidance from senior team members, learning to navigate challenging situations while developing sound judgment.

Success in this role comes from maintaining organized routines, demonstrating strong follow-through, and building effective partnerships with both the PXT team and operations leaders. This role requires excellent organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same.

About the team
The North American Sort Center (NASC) network is composed of over 100 buildings across the U.S. and Canada, as part of Amazon’s Middle Mile Operations. NASC ensures billions of packages move safely and efficiently from fulfillment centers to the last mile carriers.

The NASC HR teams partner to deliver the best customer experience that is resilient to variability and solutions-focused in a rapidly-changing environment. We enable our teams to operate with autonomy in a diverse workforce structure and we foster a culture where people connect, develop and deliver together.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon experience with 1-year human resources general experience or equivalent experience (e.g., operations, customer service, retail, manufacturing) experience
- Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., creating documents in Word, using basic spreadsheet functions in Excel, managing calendars/emails in Outlook).
- Ability to maintain confidentiality in handling sensitive information
- Experience communicating effectively with diverse audiences (e.g., explaining processes, addressing concerns, providing technical guidance)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in customer service or people-facing roles, demonstrating effective verbal and written communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to analyze information, solve problems, and make data-driven decisions
- Intermediate skills in Microsoft Excel (e.g., ability to use pivot tables, v-lookups, and formulas)
- Proficiency in using AI-powered tools, HR analytics platforms, and emerging technologies to derive insights and drive process improvements
- Ability to effectively train, guide, and support others in the use of various HR technologies and digital platforms, with a focus on increasing user adoption and enhancing end-user experience
- Strong organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and deliver results in fast-paced, dynamic environments
- Experience building partnerships and collaborating effectively across teams, demonstrating adaptability and autonomy
- Ability to exercise sound judgement and navigate ambiguous situations with limited direction
- Basic understanding of HR processes and policies
- Demonstrated problem-solving skills and resourcefulness

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. title: Senior Treasury Analyst, EMEA Regional Treasury Center (RTC)
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll drive the continued automation of our liquidity management framework, improve trade finance processes end to end, and develop standards and policies designed to scale beyond EMEA. You’ll partner with our two other regional treasury centers to shape and align global standards, while bringing a “one treasury” mindset to a region defined by growth and complexity. Working across FinOps, FP&A, Tax, Legal, and external banking partners, you’ll connect multiple workstreams and keep them moving in the same direction.

You’ll be expected to challenge the status quo: where a manual process can be automated, you’ll fix it, and where AI can make the team faster and smarter, you’ll bring it to the table. You’ll have the autonomy to make those changes happen. Reporting to the Head of EMEA Treasury in Luxembourg, you’ll work across time zones in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous, high-impact environment. If you thrive on complexity, want broad exposure across Treasury disciplines, and want to help shape how Amazon does Treasury, in EMEA and globally, this role is for you.


Key job responsibilities
- Liquidity Management: Drive the continued automation of liquidity management across EMEA, including cashpooling, funding optimization, and rule-based frameworks that reduce manual intervention and improve cash visibility.
- Trade Finance: Lead end-to-end improvements to trade finance processes, from digitization through credit capacity oversight, to cut manual effort and increase speed and scalability.
- Global Standards: Develop Treasury policies and standards that meet EMEA needs and scale globally, working with the two other regional treasury centers to shape and align a consistent global approach.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with FinOps, FP&A, Accounting, Tax, Legal, and external banking partners to deliver cross-functional initiatives with a “one treasury” mindset.
- Controllership: Embed Treasury policies, standards, and controls into day-to-day operations to maintain a strong, audit-ready control environment.
- AI & Innovation: Identify and implement practical applications of AI and automation to challenge legacy processes, eliminate manual work, and raise operational performance.
- Market Intelligence: Monitor financial market trends, regulatory developments, and the evolving banking landscape across EMEA, and translate those insights into proactive recommendations for Treasury strategy

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, statistics or business, or a Bachelor's degree and experience in quantitative role (engineering, process re-engineering, quality assurance)
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field
- Experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses
- Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis
- Experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
- Can demonstrate strong numerical and analytical skills

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of Tableau
- Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
- Experience developing financial models in Excel with advanced functions (pivot tables, macros, VBA, Power Query)
- Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday)
