title: Senior Delivery Consultant - AI & Data, Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.


Key job responsibilities
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
1. Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
2. Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
3. Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
4. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
5. Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

Language Requirement: Candidate must be able to speak French at a professional level.

About the team
Diverse Experiences: AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of experience designing and implementing data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouse solutions, including hands-on experience with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proficiency in SQL and at least two programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Scala), with experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and managing large-scale data
- Hands-on experience with distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark (including Spark SQL), Hive, or similar technologies
- Experience with MPP data warehouse technologies (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Teradata, Snowflake) and data modeling
- Experience with streaming and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, or Amazon MSK
- Hands-on experience building generative AI solutions, including LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector databases, with experience taking solutions to production
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code and workflow automation tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation, Airflow, CI/CD pipelines)
- Experience in a customer-facing role, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to present technical solutions to both technical and executive audiences

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS data and AI services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Amazon EMR, Amazon Athena, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, and Amazon OpenSearch
- Experience with the Hadoop ecosystem (e.g., HDFS, Hive, YARN) and migrating on-premises Hadoop or legacy data warehouse workloads to AWS (e.g., Amazon EMR, S3, Glue, Athena)
- Experience with agentic architectures and frameworks (e.g., Strands Agents, LangChain, LangGraph) and with the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Experience with LLM evaluation, fine-tuning or customization, guardrails, and LLMOps/MLOps
- PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field

title: Assistant Brand Manager (SBS), Private Brands
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. The Brand Specialist will work on offering dedicated support to top-tiered brands/ vendors to grow with Amazon by identifying and improving key customer inputs for growth such as content, marketing and stock availability among others. Apart from this, the Brand Specialists will also help brands/ vendors leverage Amazon’s tools and programs to improve on their business inputs.

We are seeking creative, goal-oriented and highly entrepreneurial people to join our exciting and fast-paced team.

About the Role:

As an Asst Brand Manager Consumables Private brands India, you will focus on delivering 5 core focus areas for the brand/ vendor: selection, demand generation, catalogue quality, business advice and availability.

The person who joins the leadership team in this position must share our passion and commitment for serving our customers. This ideal candidate should have experience in forging and building brand/ vendor relationships. Some understanding of planning product cycles and selling online is preferred. The right candidate will be flexible, action and results oriented, self-starting and have strong analytical skills. He or she must have a proven track record in taking ownership, driving results and moving with speed to implement ideas in a fast-paced environment. He or she should be entrepreneurial with the confidence to make independent, data-driven decisions. The candidate must demonstrate the ability to succeed at: planning and forecasting, and driving an online business. The candidate must be an effective communicator in working with some of Amazon’s most important partners and vendors, as well as with internal colleagues and groups.

Responsibilities:

This person will have responsibility for:
- Building selection: Identify selection gaps. Track brand’s offline catalogue to ensure all relevant selection is present on Amazon.

- Demand generation: Responsible for demand generation. This includes working with other members on the category management team to create a marketing calendar based on vendor's objectives

- Business Advice: Support participation of brand/ vendor in Amazon programs

- Availability: Ensuring continuous availability of products

- Catalogue Quality on Amazon: Ensuring the best inputs from brand/ vendor is updated for customer interface on Amazon Detail Pages through perfect Images, Product descriptions, etc.

- 3+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
- Master's degree
- Experience using analytical specific tools such as Google Analytics, SQL or HTML

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in financial analysis, retail buying, retail planning & allocation, product/project management, marketing, business development, consulting, negotiation or supply chain

- Experience managing large amounts of data

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities
Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services
Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations
Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects
Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team
We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028
- Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
- Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts
- Right to work in the United Kingdom for the duration of the internship

Preferred qualifications

- Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company
- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including security, storage, or databases (relational and/or NoSQL)
- Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
- Interest in or experience with generative AI, for example building with LLM APIs, agents or AI coding assistants
- Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)

title: Security and Loss Prevention Expert, NA
descriptionHtml:
The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This role leads the effort to efficiently and effectively provide End-to-End (E2E) S&LP services across all assigned operational business units. This position reports to the SLP Cluster Manager.

Key job responsibilities
* Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.
* Actively monitor and report outcome for systems and tools that generate data indicating site/region opportunities.
* Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents.
* Utilize continuous improvement to drive process enhancements and increase efficiency.
* Serve as department's liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert keeping site leadership informed on department's key issues, strategies and the performance.
* Identify, promote and implement security best practices while effectively partnering with internal customers to evaluate current and future security needs, processes, and initiatives, incident response planning, facilitating and management.
* Domestic regional travel up to 50% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Expert, you will join a team of S&LP professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you will collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in various processes to identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You will be working on multiple high-impact initiatives/projects by collaborating with stakeholders across organizational levels to deliver measurable outcomes through effective project management. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our S&LP plan.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon's Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of relevant professional or military experience
- 2+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement, or 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors
- 2+ years of operational experience in risk management, audit, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance, retail, warehouse, distribution center services, delivery service, or supply chain
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and business continuity planning experience
- Proficient in Microsoft Office; including use of Excel pivot tables and development of charts/graphics

title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our team of innovative Software Engineers and build the next generation service platforms for AWS, EC2 and our customers. These services are key components of the Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2) web service.

Our platform handles a significant load of Internet traffic generated by internal and external customers that build their solutions on EC2. On any given day we use Java, Kotlin, Typescript, Python, Ruby, Go and C++ as well as various Native AWS services and Amazon-internal tools. We don't expect you to be an expert in, or know all these technologies, but we do expect you to have strong programming fundamentals and be excited to learn about these technologies.

Our team invents, designs and builds software that is stable, scalable and performant. We write and support code that is easy to understand with solutions that are pragmatic. We keep a high bar in code reviews to ensure high quality code.

Engineers in our teams have great ownership, a drive to innovate and aim to have resounding impact in whatever we build.

As a member of this team, you will own and contribute to the development of quality designs & solutions, solving complex problems. You are able to operate with limited guidance and take a long term view of your team’s services and how they fit into the broader architecture. The services that your team own are used by many teams and you will have opportunities to work and influence engineers and teams outside of your own team to build out EC2 architecture that supports Amazon scale business needs.

We follow a DevOps model and we assign projects and tasks based on what will help each team member develop into a more well rounded engineer that will enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. This position includes on-call duties which is on rotation with the rest of the team. Our team values work-life balance.

As an Amazonian, you will enjoy interacting with some of the most talented engineers in our industry through breakfast talks and demos, internal communities and extensive training material that spans all aspects of our business.

We are looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, curious, empathic, motivated and reliable. The development opportunities are plentiful and we're only just starting to scratch the surface. If this sounds intriguing to you, then come build with us.

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, National Security Solutions Architecture Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to support our US Government customers in the Northern Virginia / DC Metro area. (Relocation assistance is available.)

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

As a Solutions Architect on the National Security team, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to your Intelligence Community customers. You are the “face of Amazon” to your customers, and they will consult you regarding a broad variety of technical challenges that are complex and mission-critical. You can build sample solutions, “think big,” and provide architecture designs and cloud enablement strategy that suit your customer’s business and technical needs. This is a high-visibility role where you collaborate with and influence external stakeholders (our government customers) and internal AWS teams like Sales and Platform Engineering.

National Security Solutions Architects are regarded as technical “thought leaders” within the Intelligence Community who evangelize emerging technologies on a conceptual level and on a practical, architectural level. Our SAs have played a critical role in the widespread adoption and advancement of cloud computing capabilities within the Intelligence Community. SAs think outside of the box to deliver results to our customers and provide solutions that are cost-effective, time-saving, and secure. As a National Security SA, you’ll solve problems at both the business and technical levels. You'll work backwards from our customers’ requirements and envision new mechanisms and strategies we can leverage that would enable agencies to operate more efficiently and better execute on their goals. Then, you'll figure out how to make the puzzle pieces fit together from the technical side and deliver the offering to the customer at scale. Frequently, you will be responsible for mission-critical solutions with life-saving implications.

Sometimes, the best way to innovate around a customer pain point is to create a new product altogether. This position offers you the unique opportunity to drive the AWS service roadmap to support our customers’ requirements within the complex technical constraints of the cleared environment.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for technologists who align with our Leadership Principles and possess a unique balance of technical depth and strong interpersonal skills. You will partner with customers, AWS Sales, and several other AWS teams to craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address Intelligence Community customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with Sales, you will drive revenue growth across a broad set of customers. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mindshare and broad use of AWS within the Intelligence Community. The ideal candidate is be self-motivated, with a proven track record in software/technology sales or consulting. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following:
- Be great fun to work with at AWS. We have a credo of “Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic, creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.
- Enjoy working with Intelligence Community customers. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of Intelligence Community customers.
- Have a strong understanding of large-scale computing solutions. The ideal candidate will have past experience working as a systems or support engineer and pre-sales experience. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

This position can have periods of up to 25% travel.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- In partnership with the sales team, formulate and execute a sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of AWS
- As a key member of the business development and sales team, ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
- Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
- Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
- Capture and share best-practice knowledge among the AWS solutions architect community
- Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer-facing publications such as whitepapers and other reusable content
- Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
- Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Role Summary:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Program Support Specialist to support the Program Management team, in day-to-day operational, administrative, reporting, data analysis, and data management activities. This role is critical in enabling PMs to focus on strategic program delivery by managing the operational and data backbone of the team.

Key Responsibilities:
Reporting & Data Support:
• Prepare, maintain, and distribute weekly/monthly business reports and dashboards for the PM team.
• Collect, clean, and organize data from multiple sources to support program tracking and reviews.
• Assist in building and maintaining trackers (e.g., Excel, Quip, internal tools) for program milestones, deliverables, and action items.
• Generate ad-hoc data pulls and summaries as requested by PMs.

Data Analysis:
• Perform basic to intermediate data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in program and operational data.
• Support PMs in preparing data-backed insights for business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs).
• Create pivot tables, charts, and visual summaries to translate raw data into actionable insights.
• Conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies and flag issues proactively to PM owners.
• Build and maintain standardized analysis templates for recurring review cycles.
• Support deep-dive analysis by compiling data from multiple sources and presenting findings in a structured format.

Data Management:
• Own the end-to-end data hygiene and integrity of team-level trackers, databases, and shared repositories.
• Establish and enforce data entry standards, naming conventions, and version control protocols across team files.
• Perform regular data audits to identify duplicates, missing entries, and inconsistencies.
• Manage access permissions and organization of shared data folders, wikis, and knowledge repositories.
• Support data migration, consolidation, and archival activities as directed by PMs.
• Maintain a single source of truth (SSOT) for key program metrics and operational data.
• Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely and accurate data inputs for program tracking.

Administrative Support:
• Schedule, coordinate, and manage recurring meetings (WBRs, MBRs, program reviews) including agenda preparation and meeting notes.
• Maintain team documentation, wikis, and shared drives in an organized and up-to-date manner.
• Support onboarding logistics for new team members (access requests, tool setup, orientation scheduling).
• Process purchase orders, procurement requests, and vendor-related paperwork as needed.
• Manage team-level communications, distribution lists, and calendar coordination.

Program Operations Support:
• Track open action items from reviews and escalate overdue items to the PM owners.
• Maintain program timelines and status updates across multiple workstreams.
• Support the creation and formatting of business documents (BRDs, status updates, stakeholder decks).
• Coordinate cross-functional inputs for program deliverables by following up with stakeholders.

Business & Process Improvement:
• Identify opportunities to streamline repetitive processes and propose simple automation or template solutions.
• Support standardization of team SOPs, templates, and reporting formats.
• Assist in organizing team events, offsites, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

title: Security and Loss Prevention Expert, NA
descriptionHtml:
The Security and Loss Prevention Expert (SLP Expert) is a key leadership position within the Amazon Security and Loss Prevention (S&LP) team. This role leads the effort to efficiently and effectively provide End-to-End (E2E) S&LP services across all assigned operational business units. This position reports to the SLP Cluster Manager.

Key job responsibilities
* Identify vulnerabilities and conduct root cause analysis using data to define mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards.
* Actively monitor and report outcome for systems and tools that generate data indicating site/region opportunities.
* Manage confidential investigations and prepare prompt reports of theft, fraud, and workplace violence/critical incidents.
* Utilize continuous improvement to drive process enhancements and increase efficiency.
* Serve as department's liaison and security/crisis management subject matter expert keeping site leadership informed on department's key issues, strategies and the performance.
* Identify, promote and implement security best practices while effectively partnering with internal customers to evaluate current and future security needs, processes, and initiatives, incident response planning, facilitating and management.
* Domestic regional travel up to 50% of the time when applicable.
* Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach; Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts; Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud; Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments); Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs).
* This role covers 24/7 operations and must be able to work all shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays.

A day in the life
As a SLP Expert, you will join a team of S&LP professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you will collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analyzing data reports, and conducting interviews. Your findings contribute to identifying vulnerabilities in various processes to identify and drive mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. Furthermore, you identify and act upon initiatives improving our physical security infrastructure and contribute directly to the budgetary planning for our external suppliers. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You will be working on multiple high-impact initiatives/projects by collaborating with stakeholders across organizational levels to deliver measurable outcomes through effective project management. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams across all management levels and manage the implementation of our S&LP plan.

About the team
Worldwide Operations Security (WWOS) is the global organization that supports field Loss Prevention and is designed to support Amazon's Worldwide Operations, as well as affiliate and retail businesses, by creating and maintaining a work environment that is both prepared and secure through global security centers of excellence staffed by subject matter experts in people and asset protection. We accomplish this by creating policy and implementation guidelines; training leadership and staff; using technology to eliminate subjectivity, complexity, and variation; identifying, preparing for, and mitigating risk; and auditing our practices to ensure compliance.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 4+ years of relevant professional or military experience
- 2+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement, or 2+ years of Amazon (Blue Badge/FTE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in implementing metric-based strategies utilizing continuous improvement concepts
- Experience in physical security systems maintenance/implementation and coordinating scope of work with security vendors
- 2+ years of operational experience in risk management, audit, data analytics, inventory control, quality assurance, retail, warehouse, distribution center services, delivery service, or supply chain
- Investigative interviewing experience; Wicklander and Zulawski, Loss Prevention Qualified, Certified Protection Professional, Loss Prevention Certified, Certified Forensic Interviewer, Certified Threat Assessment Certification or other relevant certifications
- Workplace incident mitigation or de-escalation and business continuity planning experience
- Proficient in Microsoft Office; including use of Excel pivot tables and development of charts/graphics

title: Maintenance Manager

title: Launch Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, Amazon Prime Air Europe
descriptionHtml:
How do you get items to customers quickly, cost-effectively, and—most importantly—safely, in less than an hour? And how do you do it in a way that can scale? Our teams of hundreds of scientists, engineers, aerospace professionals, and futurists have been working hard to do just that! We are delivering to customers, and are excited for what’s to come. Check out more information about Prime Air on the About Amazon blog (https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/transportation/amazon-prime-air-delivery-drone-reveal-photos).

If you are seeking an iterative environment where you can drive innovation, apply state-of-the-art technologies to solve real world delivery challenges, and provide benefits to customers, Prime Air is the place for you.
Come work on the Amazon Prime Air Team!
Amazon Prime Air is seeking an experienced program manager to build and launch our drone delivery sites across Europe. As one of a team of Expansion Program Managers, each owning a portfolio of sites, you will start from the signed-off, permitted design handed over by the Expansion Program Manager (Design & Integration), oversee the build delivered by Amazon’s GES construction teams, own the ordering and installation of Prime Air’s site technology and infrastructure, and be accountable for each site launching on the date we committed to. You will own each site’s integrated launch schedule, drive the workstreams you own and hold the teams that own the rest to their dates. Prime Air is expanding drone delivery across Europe, and you will help build the launch process that makes that expansion repeatable.


Key job responsibilities
•. Own delivery of a portfolio of concurrent site launches, including the integrated launch schedule for each site from build start to commercial launch, and be accountable for launching on time
•. Oversee the build delivered by Amazon GES, holding them to the construction schedule within the integrated launch schedule you own, coordinating site activity with the host operation, and accepting the quality of the handover
•. Own each site’s build budget against the approved capital request, including approving construction change requests, and make scope, schedule and cost trade-offs, escalating with options when a launch date is at risk
•. Own the requirements, quantities and on-site dates for Prime Air-specific technology and infrastructure, such as launch ramps, charging systems, site compute and communications equipment and ground support equipment, within the space, power and interfaces defined in the site design, and work with Prime Air Supply Chain to order and deliver it
•. Own the relationship with host site operations from build start to launch, including site access, shared dock and yard use, and keeping disruption to the live operation to a minimum
•. Coordinate installation, commissioning and validation by the responsible teams and vendors, including IT, ground support equipment, quality and product support engineering teams, so that site system integration and first flight start on schedule
•. Drive the readiness workstreams owned by other teams, including regulatory approval, crew hiring and training and operational readiness, holding owners to their dates and escalating any risk to the launch date early
•. Run site launch governance: risk register and readiness reviews, and recommend the launch go/no-go decision against agreed criteria
•. Report status, risk and change control to leadership with clear, decision-ready communication
•. Build the mechanisms that make launches repeatable, and improve the European launch playbook with the lessons from each site
•. Travel up to 50% to launch sites across the UK and the EU

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field
- program or project management experience
- experience in delivering fit-out, equipment installation or construction projects on active sites, working through an in-house or external construction partner
- Experience owning an integrated schedule across multiple teams and vendors and delivering to a fixed launch date
- Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority
- Experience managing risk, change control and dependencies, and communicating status to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management or a related field, or equivalent industry experience
- Business fluency in English (C1 or above)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience launching Amazon fulfilment centre, sort centre or delivery station sites
- Experience with installation and commissioning of technical equipment such as automation, robotics, IT and telecoms or aviation ground equipment
- Experience launching sites in more than one European country
- Experience with aviation or other regulated operations
- PMP or equivalent project management certification
- Working proficiency in a second European language

descriptionHtml:
Join AWS as a Senior Business Development Specialist and help shape how organizations across Latin America harness the power of generative AI and machine learning. You'll work at the intersection of business strategy and cutting-edge technology, partnering directly with customers to unlock new possibilities and drive meaningful outcomes through AWS AI services.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for AWS generative AI and machine learning services across your assigned geographic segments, identifying opportunities to drive adoption and revenue growth.
- Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline by gathering customer and industry insights, understanding business challenges, and positioning AWS solutions as the optimal choice for customers' AI initiatives.
- Partner with cross-functional teams including product managers, solution architects, and account managers to innovate, develop, and deliver customer solutions while influencing the AWS product roadmap based on customer feedback.
- Drive customer and partner engagement by participating in field enablement activities, representing AWS at industry events, and creating thought leadership content that demonstrates AWS AI expertise.

As a Senior Business Development Specialist focused on generative AI, you'll spend your time building and nurturing relationships with customers across Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, and Paraguay. You might start your day analyzing market trends and customer needs, then transition into strategic conversations with key stakeholders about how AWS AI services can solve their most pressing business challenges. You'll collaborate with product teams to understand what customers need, advocate for those insights, and help shape the future direction of our services. Throughout the week, you'll develop go-to-market strategies, participate in customer engagements and industry events, and work alongside account managers and technical architects to close strategic deals. Your role bridges the gap between what customers need and what AWS builds, making you instrumental in driving both adoption and innovation.

About the team
We are the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Generative AI team, and we're passionate about helping customers transform their businesses through AI and machine learning. Our team works backwards from customer needs to build and execute strategies that turn AWS innovations into thriving businesses. We're composed of business development specialists, solution architects, and sales professionals who collaborate seamlessly across AWS to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. We take pride in thinking strategically, delivering results, and operating as one unified team. When you join us, you'll be part of a group that's not just selling services—you're enabling customers to achieve their full potential with technology that matters. We're excited about the opportunity to welcome someone who shares our commitment to customer success and our curiosity about what's possible with AI.

title: Software Development Engineer II, PXT Departures
descriptionHtml:
What is Departures Tech all about?
Amazonian Experience and Technology is investing heavily in technology to modernize and unify the employee departure experience across Amazon's workforce of more than 1.3 million people. Our mission is clear: deliver a seamless, dignified, and operationally excellent experience for every Amazonian navigating a departure. Our team includes dedicated engineers, product managers, and operations managers building world-class systems that serve employees, HR partners, managers, and service delivery teams across the globe.

We are looking for a SDE II to design the end-to-end case management experience a single, unified platform that brings clarity, composability, and intelligence to how multiple service delivery teams manage departure cases from initiation through resolution.

The work we do matters. Every departure impacts a real person navigating one of the most significant transitions in their career. Supporting employees and the teams that serve them with transparent, efficient, and empathetic technology makes a profound difference. We are our own customers; it's our colleagues we support, our processes we streamline, and our data we must safeguard.

Who are we looking for?  We are looking for a talented Software Developer with a strong technical background, customer obsession and bias for action with a track record of leading and delivering robust solutions quickly. Strong judgment and communication skills, long-term technical vision, and continuous focus on engineering and operational excellence are essential for success in this role. You will be expected to be proficient technically, mentor and grow junior developers, encourage software development best practices, and iterate quickly ensuring delivery of a unified case management experience that integrates across multiple service delivery teams. Our north star is a composable, AI-native platform that provides:   A single unified experience for case workers across all service delivery functions; one interface to manage cases regardless of departure type or workflow stage  Clear data funnels and journey visibility; real-time insight into where a case stands, what's happened, and what comes next across the full lifecycle  An AI-native composable architecture; leveraging generative AI to intelligently route cases, surface relevant context, enable seamless transition to a human for understanding the overall landscape enabling them to make the right decisions.   The best candidates will have deep expertise in full-stack development, cloud-native patterns (event-driven architectures, data streaming, microservices), and hands-on experience designing and shipping GenAI-powered features including LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent-based systems,. They will be comfortable navigating a complex internal ecosystem of HR systems, front-end platforms, and data stores to recommend, extend, or build both foundational capabilities (case lifecycle management, workflow orchestration, communication automation, population segmentation, audit trails) and intuitive user-facing experiences that abstract underlying system complexity.   Key job responsibilities  What you'll do:
* As an SDE2 you will be responsible for designing and building new features on a low latency, high through put unified case management platform serving multiple service delivery teams with distinct but overlapping workflows
* Build composable, AI-native services that enable intelligent case routing, contextual recommendations, automated summarization, and conversational interfaces
* Build clear data models and pipelines that provide end-to-end visibility into the customer journey from case creation through resolution and post-departure follow-up
* Drive API-first design patterns that enable extensibility and integration with existing Departures systems (TAA, DLS, DSS, HRSC, Manager Hub, A to Z)
* Raise the technical bar through code reviews, design reviews, and mentorship of SDEs across the team

title: Robotics Systems Engineer I, Robotics Delivery and Packaging Innovation (RDPI) - Tech Deployment
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about the latest advancements in industrial automation and robotics? Would you like to play a vital role in Amazon's investment in advanced technologies? If you have a passion for making an impact on the future today, consider joining Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovations (RDPI) Technology Deployment team within Amazon Robotics (AR) org.

In RDPI, we have the unique role and privilege of deploying leading edge industrial robotics and customer fulfillment technologies across North America Stores operations. We raise the bar on the speed, quality and cost of deploying industrial technologies at scale across North America, functioning as the field team who plan, execute and launch the technologies that our internal design and product strategy partners in RDPI develop.

Project durations vary from a few days to several months, with travel across North America. This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.

As a Systems Engineer in RDPI, you will be overseeing large scale project planning, installation, and launch of industrial automation technologies across Amazons growing Stores network. This field engineering position demands strong technical skills for deploying robotic equipment, including mechanical and electrical systems, network configurations, and software coordination. The ideal candidate has experience with complex electro-mechanical and network systems, demonstrating leadership in installation, maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting of technologies being deployed across North America. You will work with cross-functional partners across our engineering, product strategy, software, supply chain, third-party installers, contracted deployment engineers, construction teams, and internal operations customer teams, functioning as the lead on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on installation Amazon-designed automation equipment. This Systems Engineer position is an individual contributor role, influencing and leading stakeholders from planning through go-live of each project. Candidates should have a proven track record of successfully leading multiple concurrent projects across one or more automation solutions.

**Relocation to Amazon Corporate offices in Seattle, Boston, Nashville or Austin will be required for the role.

Key job responsibilities
As a Systems Engineer I, you will work with a team of 1-5 engineers and collaborate with an on-site project manager to provide technical oversight on the installation of both third party and Amazon designed robotics equipment that may be in various phases of the product life cycle. These deployments require extensive collaboration with various stakeholders, including third-party installers, contracted engineers, construction, hardware, software, IT, and other partner teams. Strong communication skills are essential for interacting with both internal and external partners and customers. As an Amazonian, you must demonstrate independent initiative to identify and solve problems in real time during deployments. A strong technical understanding, love for field work, and a keen interest in diving deep into the understanding of Amazon’s robotics systems are key attributes for this role.

- You will support and guide installation of robotics, packaging and sortation technologies at Amazon fulfillment centers
- You will develop detailed knowledge of the operation of robotic systems and guide installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of these systems both on site and remotely
- You will manage technical ambiguity around integration of work cells in fulfillment centers
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams
- You will travel to project sites and collaborate both virtually and in person to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status
- You will manage day to day project scheduling and budget management
- You will work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space
- You will generate and implement continuous improvement ideas around work-scopes
- You will lead teams of other engineers on projects
- You will travel to both live warehouses and new construction sites, the scopes may vary significantly in length and include heavy travel
- You will manage the tactical deployment of large scale industrial automation technologies, ranging in technical complexity and product maturity from early alpha/beta to mature Generally Available.
- You will own the tactical execution (onsite coordination of installation and acceptance testing) to achieve the target “go-live” date for each project assigned; delivering independently.
- You will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams to convert technical requirements into refined deployment execution documents (schedules, Standard Operating Procedures, dependencies, etc.)
- You will improve operational metrics and team processes through automation and optimization
- You will independently resolve difficult technical problems during deployment, considering operational burden and making appropriate trade-offs between time, quality, and resources
- You will create and improve standard work documents and operational guidebooks, and work towards automating or improving team processes.
- You will influence internal and partner teams towards meeting team level goals.
- You will develop subject matter expertise in one or more deployment domains
- You will mentor junior engineers and participate in technical assessment
- You will drive operational excellence initiatives with measurable results
- This is a travel-based role and you will be expected to travel to meet the requirements of your projects across North America, upwards of 75% or more.
- Lift and move totes up to 49 pounds each
- Regular bending, lifting, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
- Walking in the FC and around area with great frequency; facilities are over a quarter mile in length
- Must be able to stand/walk for up to 10-12 hours
- Should be able to work in environments with variable noise levels, lighting conditions and temperature variation
- Able to access all areas of building (ascending and descending ladders, stairs, gangways safely and without limitation)



A day in the life
In this role you will be focused on execution of end-to-end deployment and manage technical ambiguity around integration of workcells in fulfillment centers. On a daily basis you will collaborate with hardware engineering, technical program managers, product managers, and internal customers including site maintenance and operations teams, to ensure the product you are deploying, is both ready for deployment and capable of achieving the business requirements. You will travel to your project sites, collaborate both virtually and in person, to ensure all business stakeholders are aligned on program status. You will manage the day-to-day project execution, and work on continuous improvement activities to improve the projects in your space. You will spend time with mentors and your manager to develop your professional skills and collaborate amongst your team to move the needle on the services you are accountable for.

About the team
Are you inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work impacts the bigger picture? Answer yes to any of these and you’ll fit right in here at Robotics Delivery & Packaging Innovation (RDPI) within Amazon Robotics (AR). We are a smart, collaborative team of enthusiastic doers that work passionately to apply advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we can’t even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are RDPI and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun

RDPI Tech Deployment are missioned with enabling the delivery of large scale automation technologies designed and manufactured by Amazon. The team is multi-disciplinary, and consists of Field Deployment Engineers, Controls Engineering, Design for Deployment, Product Single Threaded Leaders, and a Program Management Office team, who collaborate on enabling the delivery of new technologies and packaging solutions that delight our customers, and improve the safety, quality and costs within the Amazon fulfillment processes. The team is geographically located across four North America hub locations. The work we deliver directly impact high priority goals set each year to our most senior leadership at Amazon.

descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Key job responsibilities
Lead technical delivery across customer engagements. Own the technical strategy and execution for complex, multi-workstream customer AI programs. Make architecture decisions that span multiple services and organizational boundaries. Align technical approach with the customer's long-term technology strategy. Requires 30–50% travel.

Architect and build production AI systems at scale. Design the foundational architectures — multi-agent orchestration, enterprise retrieval systems, decision intelligence platforms — for the most complex customer engagements. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

Own production excellence across workstreams. Define operational standards, evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria for AI systems across your engagement scope. Establish mechanisms (testing strategies, observability standards, incident response playbooks) that ensure AI systems remain healthy. Drive operational improvements that raise the bar for the team.

Scale the team's effectiveness. Define engineering patterns, contribute to the interview and hiring process, and mentor junior FDEs into independent contributors. Coach others on system design, customer engagement, and production operations. Drive engineering excellence standards within your scope.

Accelerate customer transformation. Identify systemic opportunities to expand AI adoption across the customer organization. Create accelerators and reusable platforms that reduce time-to-value from months to weeks. Feed learnings back into AWS services and the FDE practice.

title: Refrigeration Engineer/Program Manager, Global Energy Sustainability & Automation (GESA)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Operations Global Engineering Materials & Sustainability (Ops GEMS) organisation sets the strategy, technical standards, and programme delivery that keep Amazon's operational estate safe, energy-efficient, and sustainable — spanning fulfilment centres, delivery stations, grocery, and fresh-food facilities worldwide.
Within Ops GEMS, the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) team provides hands-on technical leadership for Amazon's global portfolio of building management systems (BMS), energy platforms, and refrigeration systems — driving safety, reliability, and energy reduction through deep engineering expertise combined with enterprise SCADA, monitoring, and analytics platforms. We are a small, high-impact team that partners closely with RME, D&C, and operational stakeholders across all regions.

Purpose of the Role - We are seeking an Refrigeration Engineer to take ownership of the refrigeration estate supporting Amazon's food delivery network across the Middle East and India. This is an agile role spanning varied projects — system optimisation, automation rollouts, failure investigations, and energy-reduction initiatives — with safety, reliability, and reducing energy consumption as the common thread. You will combine deep refrigeration knowledge with strong aptitude for automation, enterprise SCADA, and performance data analytics, working closely with the European refrigeration team (Barcelona) and Global BMS Technical Services. The ability to context-switch and deliver across concurrent workstreams is essential.


Key job responsibilities
• Champion safety as the overriding priority across all refrigeration activities, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, Amazon safety policies, and food safety standards.
• Drive reliability programmes that reduce unplanned downtime, extend asset life, and minimise risk across the portfolio.
• Lead energy-reduction initiatives — identify consumption hotspots, establish measurable baselines, and implement control strategies that deliver sustained efficiency gains.
• Support the deployment and optimisation of enterprise SCADA platforms for refrigeration monitoring across the Middle East and India estate, working controller-agnostic across diverse technology stacks.
• Manage alarm rationalisation and tuning to reduce noise and surface genuine events that threaten safety or reliability.
• Analyse performance data from SCADA historians and monitoring platforms to identify trends, anomalies, and optimisation opportunities. Generate reports and actionable insights for stakeholders.
• Identify technical improvement and energy-efficiency opportunities across the regional refrigeration estate; evaluate emerging technologies and conduct feasibility studies.
• Act as a trusted technical advisor to RME and Maintenance Operation Centres, providing specialist guidance beyond routine troubleshooting through the established escalation model.
• Support D&C projects with operational best practices, lessons learned, and alignment with regional legislation and design standards.
• Develop and deliver training material and contribute to a shared knowledge base covering fault modes, diagnostics, legislation, and spare parts management.

Basic qualifications

- Experience gathering and analyzing large amounts of data and delivering continuous business improvements
- Experience working effectively across cross-functional teams and partner well with people at all levels within an organization, including coaching of junior staff
- Experience as a strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly and effectively influence across cross-functional teams
- 5+ years of refrigeration industry experience
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Refrigeration Engineering, HVAC/R Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. Alternatively, a recognised advanced apprenticeship or Higher National Diploma (HND) in Refrigeration / Air Conditioning with substantial demonstrable industry experience.

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of managing food safety and quality in a large-scale retail or manufacturing environment experience
- 4+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience, or experience in Amazon RME (Reliability, Maintenance, and Engineering), fulfillment operations, or automation deployment environments
- Familiarity with multiple refrigeration controller platforms (e.g., Danfoss, Carel, Emerson/Dixell) and enterprise SCADA packages, with a controller-agnostic mindset.
- Experience with cloud-based data analytics, IoT platforms, or predictive maintenance tools applied to refrigeration or HVAC/R systems.

Experience interviewing and selecting candidates who meet Amazon's high-performance bar

title: Principal Product Manager, Shipping Express, Amazon Air Cargo
descriptionHtml:
You're a Principal Product Manager with deep experience in supply chain, transportation, or logistics product strategy within complex, rapidly scaling organizations. You've owned end-to-end product vision for a shipping, delivery, or transportation product at scale, and you have a track record of turning operational networks into differentiated, customer-facing products that customers love and adopt to. You excel where the problem spans network operations, product definition, commercial strategy, and customer experience — and you bring the strategic judgment to define the right long-term bets while delivering near-term value.

You have strong analytical skills and are comfortable diving deep into transit-time and cutoff economics, network flow and injection constraints, coverage and lane profitability, pricing structure, and competitive benchmarking to decide where product and network investment drives outsized revenue and share impact. You understand that this is not project management — this is setting direction for a shipping product that competes head-to-head with industry leading services and must earn every shipper's choice.

High judgment is expected at the Principal bar: defining the product promise and service bar customer-back (not operations-forward), making trade-offs between operational feasibility and customer delight, deciding when to build versus influence a platform or operations team's roadmap, and influencing across operations, network design, commercial, finance, and engineering teams without direct authority. You set strategy that other senior leaders and teams align to, you regularly engage with senior leadership to secure investment and drive high-stakes decisions, and you are relied on to be right a lot. You have a proven track record of building a transportation or delivery product that became a durable competitive advantage.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Product Management — Define the executive-level vision for the Shipping Express 2-day product and translate it into actionable multi-year roadmaps aligned across operations, network design, product, commercial, and engineering. Define the product customer-back — product promise, cutoff times, guaranteed delivery windows, tracking/visibility SLAs, pickup experience, coverage footprint, service tiers, and pricing framework — benchmarked dimension by dimension against UPS 2nd Day Air and FedEx 2Day. Own end-to-end outcomes and business impact (shipper acquisition and retention, volume and share growth, delivery-performance SLAs, cost per shipment, and shipper satisfaction).

End-to-End Product Lifecycle & Quality Ownership — Own the full product cycle for Shipping Express and the quality of the product at every stage:

Vision — Set the long-term product vision and the "why now," grounded in customer need and competitive gap.
Requirements — Translate the vision into clear, prioritized product requirements that engineering and operations can build from.
Phased launch — Launch in deliberate phases (pilot → scale → expand), defining the entry and exit criteria for each phase rather than attempting a single big-bang release.
Measurement — Instrument the product and define the success metrics up front; measure actual performance against the product promise and the business case after each phase.
Quality improvement — Identify quality gaps from the data (service misses, exceptions, defects, failure modes) and drive the highest-impact improvements back into the product and network.
Product evolution — Continuously evolve the roadmap based on customer feedback, operational quality and cost, and P&L outcomes — deciding what to double down on, what to fix, and what to retire.
Cross-Team & Network Leadership — Lead product vision and execution across multi-org dependencies, driving alignment across network design, sort/injection operations, air gateway capacity, and middle-mile/last-mile execution. Translate hard operational constraints (pickup-to-injection timing, gateway cutoffs, sort-center flow) into a single recommended network path and a product customers can rely on. Eliminate fragmented ownership and missed handoffs across the shipping journey; own the build-vs-influence calls and ensure capabilities land in the right long-term home.

Operational Excellence & Scale — Design a product and the supporting network capabilities that scale with volume growth without proportional increases in manual exception handling. Use data to identify and eliminate the highest-impact friction points across the pickup-to-delivery experience and the lanes that drive cost and service risk. Build the governance and review mechanisms that keep cross-org investment aligned year over year.

A day in the life
Set the strategic direction for the Shipping Express product across teams — aligning operations, commercial, and engineering around a single customer-back product definition, not a stack of operational compromises.
Deep dive into data (transit-time and on-time performance, cutoff and injection constraints, lane profitability, competitive benchmarks, shipper feedback) to shape the roadmap and decide where to invest for maximum share and margin impact.
Run the product cycle end to end — move initiatives from vision to requirements to phased launch, then measure outcomes, surface quality gaps, and feed them back into the next iteration.
Partner with engineering and operations leaders to shape network and product design, ensuring the product scales with volume growth and holds its service promise.
Unblock cross-org dependencies before they become escalations; frame program narratives for senior leadership — connecting network and product progress to business outcomes.
Spend time with Ops teams and in the network to pressure-test whether the product performs for shippers in the real world.

What this takes

Someone who toggles between deep product and operational insight and strategic product leadership — owning the full product cycle from vision through launch, measurement, and continuous quality improvement — and turning a complex transportation network into a scalable, benchmark-beating 2-day shipping product that shippers choose.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning technology products

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Networking Operational Excellence
descriptionHtml:
AWS Building Connectivity Engineering owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of the internal networks that Amazonians rely on to access their tools and achieve connectivity for internal uses within Data Center environments. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to help transition this organization into a software-first mindset and reality as we develop new tools to replace old processes.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

In this role, you will be responsible for the collaboration, planning, oversight and execution of major software migrations from a broad array of older tools and processes. You will work with Network Development Engineers and other stakeholders to understand and map their business requirements that need to be turned to code, and be the expert on the ecosystem and interplay between the different elements of the AWS Networking ecosystem of teams, services, and networks. You'll discover risks to the plan, and own the elimination of those risks by working to ensure the right people are always working on the right things and we are never surprised by changing circumstances and hidden requirements. You will communicate with our stakeholders about the way things are changing, making sure that the changes coming through are the right ones to meet their needs, and will really solve their problems, building trust in our work and deepening the important relationships we have with our stakeholders both inside and outside of our organization. Our network is critical to all AWS infrastructure operations and scaling. This is an opportunity to work on advanced network technologies and make a meaningful impact on millions of customers worldwide.

The ideal candidate will require proven technical project management, critical thinking and problem solving skills. The candidate should be open to new challenges, extremely good at multi-tasking, innovative, self-directed and a great team player.

Candidates should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and software engineering teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards deliverables for network operations. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

If you like to work with new technologies and optimize existing technology, and have experience participating in network/systems support for a large-scale enterprise or a service provider, we encourage you to apply! Your work will play a key role in driving the stability and sustainability of next-generation networking solutions.

Key job responsibilities
• You’ll drive both network hardware and software programs to meet the ever-growing customer demand.
• You’ll manage competing cross-organizational projects/programs on a global scale.
• You’ll interact cross-team Network Managers, cross-team Technical Program Managers, Engineers, and Data Center Technicians and senior management.
• You will run meetings, create and maintain timelines, and keep large, diverse groups informed of progress and obstacles.

Technical Program Managers in AWS Networking have a wide range of responsibilities: we work with internal partners to develop and implement the next gen infrastructures along with the tooling ecosystems to support with these platforms driving efficiency and scalability through the automation of builds, configuration deployment, and the scaling of capacity. As our network is one of the largest in the world, there is no blue print at our scale allowing our engineers to develop solutions to the complex challenges that we face daily. We encourage durable solutions that look around corners while taking into consideration our customer needs from a cost, performance, and reliability perspective. Our team develops tooling that provides the required visibility and control of traffic across the network, while prioritizing the automatic mitigation of events to minimize the impact to our customers during events.

Within AWS Networking, the Building Connectivity Engineering (BCE) organization is responsible for the design, implementation, and operations of a wide array of networking infrastructure that provide global connectivity between all AWS Regions and edge locations. We provide the massive scale required to support our AWS customers and internal services, via a network that grows by 70% annually. In addition, we have teams are responsible for the design and operation of our global data center network, allowing tens of thousands of Amazonians to perform their daily tasks in support of our customers. We provide software tooling that allows the global AWS footprint to scale via new Region and datacenter location builds, automated systems that control the flow of traffic across devices, and are building our next generation network controllers to drive improved performance and efficiency across the networks that we operate.
