title: Sr. Marketing Communications Manager, DSP Experience, Americas DSP Marketing Communications
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to support Amazon’s mission to build the world’s safest, most efficient, and sustainable delivery network by helping our Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) build safe, quality businesses while retaining teams of satisfied and engaged drivers? We are looking for a Senior Marketing Communication Manager, DSP Experience who works to support 2,500+ DSPs who employ 175,000+ Delivery Associates (DAs) operating Prime-branded vehicles on road, delivering tens of millions of packages per week through our Last Mile delivery network.

Specifically, this candidate will work across multiple stakeholders and use communication strategies to bring to life all the ways that Amazon is investing in the DSP and DA experience. You will thrive in ambiguity to translate technical and operational information via the Change Management process into user-friendly resources and communications to make it convenient and seamless for DSPs to manage their business.

You’ll also help shape the team’s emerging Marketing Communications initiatives, helping ensure that we not only get the right candidates in the top of our marketing funnel so they apply for the program, but keep them engaged when they go to the bench to wait for the right opportunity to launch their DSP business. You’ll help build ongoing engagement and field marketing initiatives that are deployed to DSPs once they launch their business, supporting them through various marketing communication tactics across their full lifecycle.

In addition, you’ll serve as a primary liaison for the DSP Org to the broader transportation organization’s Day 1 initiatives, helping ensure that our VP’s entire organization remains plugged in and active to these initiatives to drive employee engagement and culture.
The ideal candidate must be a strong communicator with strategic communications and/or marketing communications experience, business acumen, and excellent writing ability – one who is able to flex between internal and external communication modalities. Not only will you need to help strategize on plans, you’ll need to help program manage them from ideation to execution to keep things on track. You will be a thought leader who indexes high on emotional intelligence and professionalism as you’ll be interacting with leaders at the highest levels. You’ll have to be comfortable with testing, learning, and rolling up your sleeves. Our environment is fast-paced and requires a candidate who isn’t afraid to innovate and propose disruptive ideas. You’ll also have a passion for fostering a collaborative and engaged culture and be a catalyst in bringing that to life. You’ll need to be able to influence teammates up, down, and across to buy-into the mission and prioritize it among the other day-to-day responsibilities.

This role can be based in Nashville, TN or Bellevue, WA.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop a multi-channel strategy, including written communications and executive messaging
• Translate complex messaging into simple and easy-to-understand content to help launch new programs and products
• Identify emerging topics and develop proactive plans with stakeholders
• Drive creative campaigns to both solve business needs and instill passion among the DSP community
• Partner with stakeholders to ingest customer listening data and use it to inform a communication strategy
• Monitor and measure the effectiveness of communications and other engagement tactics
• Partner with agencies and internal creative teams to develop compelling content and partner engagement strategies – both for acquisition and ongoing lifecycle purposes
• Develop team culture and employee engagement opportunities aligned to a broader org strategy

A day in the life
We write a lot and "are right a lot!” We respond to business needs and develop messaging for change announcements. We also interview DSPs and DAs to build compelling spotlight and advocacy stories. We own multiple channels by which we communicate to DSP Owners and their teams of DAs, partnering across our DSP Experience (DSPX) team to turn the flywheel that attracts, engages, equips, empowers, advocates, and inspires.

About the team
The Americas DSP Marketing Communications team is made up of 20+ high performing leaders. Even though we are based in different cities across the U.S., Canada, and LATAM, we have a highly inclusive and collaborative culture. We approach each other with respect and humility and have fun every day by answering Questions of the Day (QOTD) in Slack to stay connected across multiple locations, sharing memes, and hosting interactive team building events. DSPs & DAs count on us to provide helpful and trustworthy information so they can operate their business efficiently and focus on what matters most to them, i.e., building a safety-first culture, developing their team and delivering millions of smiles in their communities.

- Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
- Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint

title: Data Center Engineering Operations Trainee
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS Data Centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Trainee will be responsible for Data Center Engineering Operations within an Amazon Data Center including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

We are looking for an individual with little to no experience, a result-driven individual with technical (electrical/ mechanical) understanding and the drive and passion to learn data center engineering operations. The role will report to the DCEO Manager and be responsible for sustaining availability, cost management, risk assessment and mitigation, review corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure and metric reporting.

You’ll interface with a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

This position is for a 6 month fixed term hire with a possibility to convert to a full time role.

Key job responsibilities
- Learning the Data Center industry through in-classroom and on-site experience.
- Assist the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed, is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
- Maintaining performance benchmarks, conduct analyses & prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility infrastructure operations & maintenance.
- Generate Change Management requests & Incident Management tickets for DCEO as directed.
- Learn and contribute to documentation relevant to business & facility operations.
- Assist with the installation of the racks and the provision of power/cooling within its constraints.
- Be involved with the routine maintenance and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switchgear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
- Assist and learn about the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
- Assist with the management of the Facility assets and the provision of infrastructure & inventory asset management as directed.
- May participate in Construction & Operational Meetings as required.
- Assist with Work Order compliance and review of contractual SLAs.
- Interface with Infra Ops teams for day to day operational requirements.
- Assist in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering or services issue.
- Delivery of exceptional customer service and satisfaction.
- Meet daily hours of operations, shift and on-call requirements for response during shift rotations.

This role may involve bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching, ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely.

Due to the location of our sites, candidates should possess a valid driver's license and their own vehicle.

A day in the life
At today’s large-scale data centers, you will be involved in:
- Provide support and assistance to the onsite operations team, in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service-Level Agreements (SLA).
- Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
- Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained.
- On-site management of contractors, subcontractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
- Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications
- Interest in maintenance of a Data Center or Critical space facility.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong attention to detail.
- Strong leadership and organizational skills.
- Facilities Management mindset.
- Ability to prioritize in complex, fast-paced environment.
- Physical Security protocol awareness .
- Computer literate, confident with Office Suite
- This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift rack equipment; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.

Preferred Qualifications
- Degree or Technical (Military/ Trade School)
- Degree / Cert IV and relevant experience
- Data Center Engineering/Operations Experience
- Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or relevant discipline.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of data center engineering experience

title: Senior BMS Specialist, Global BMS Technical Services
descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.

1. Support the development and execution of a comprehensive strategy for maintaining, improving, and expanding our global support services
2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools
5. Monitor and maintain ticket and work order queues, ensuring customer care and quality meet the high bar
6. Ensure compliance with change management processes
7. Monitor and analyze BMS data to proactively identify and action opportunities for optimization, energy efficiency, and cost savings
8. Establish and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and vendors, ensuring a customer-centric approach
9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists
12. Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing within the team
13. Willingness to work flexible shifts to provide 24/7 BMS support across global time zones

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, engineering technology or equivalent
- Ability to integrate multiple communications protocols such as BACnet, LON, Modbus, and SNMP to a single platform with normalized data for standard visualization.
- Ability to remotely troubleshoot BMS communication issues, including fieldbus (BACnet, LON, Modbus via RS485), Network Gateways and IP-based protocols (Niagara Fox, MQTT, BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP, SNMP).
- Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
- Deep understanding of HVAC, lighting, Utilities, field devices, and other building systems, as well as energy management principles.
- Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize initiatives in a dynamic environment.
- Strong problem-solving skills with a strategic and innovative mindset.
- Organized and self-motivated to take ownership of complex tasks.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Industrial control systems, both hardware and software
- Experience working in cross-regional BMS projects with multicultural teams
- Proficiency in cloud-based IoT platforms, data analytics, and visualization tools
- Certification in relevant programming languages or BMS systems
- Certification with Tridium Niagara
- Certification with Distech Controls
- Strong customer relationship management skills
- Experience and understanding of facility management and relevant electrical and mechanical aspects of BMS equipment
- Proficiency in additional spoken languages

title: Technical Program Manager, Global Procurement Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon’s Global Procurement Organization is transforming how procurement operates at Amazon scale, and we are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive that transformation. This role owns the programs that move procurement from individual AI-assisted productivity toward an operating model where AI agents carry processes end to end and people verify, orchestrate, and govern. It sits at the intersection of technology, business process redesign, and organizational change, where your work shapes not just the tools procurement uses but how the work itself is structured.

Key job responsibilities
• Define and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional technology programs, from problem definition and design through build, launch, and iteration.
• Stand up and operate new delivery team structures for AI transformation initiatives, from team charter and composition through to solutions running in production.
• Define how transformation success is measured and establish baselines before changes land, so that claimed gains can be verified rather than argued.
• Design and run program decision gates, including the criteria for continuing or stopping an initiative, the evidence required at each gate, and the escalation path when something is not working.
• Partner with business leaders to redesign processes, targeting the coordination effort that becomes unnecessary once supplier, commercial, risk, and policy information is maintained as a shared capability.
• Drive architecture and design discussions, applying working knowledge of AI and AWS services to evaluate trade-offs and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sound.
• Build the mechanisms the program depends on, including team and charter registries, playbooks for standing up new teams, and the feedback loop that carries learning between business areas.
• Independently identify and resolve structural blockers across teams, including governance gaps, duplicated solutions, missing orchestration between existing tools, and unclear ownership.
• Manage program roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across multiple engineering teams, proactively identifying risks and removing barriers to keep delivery on track.
• Facilitate business and technical meetings, driving crisp decisions and ensuring the right people are in the room at the right time.
• Communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes to stakeholders from engineering teams through Directors and VPs, in clear written narratives and verbal updates.



About the team
Global Procurement Technology builds the systems behind Amazon’s procurement function, from how suppliers are brought on and assessed to how commercial terms, risk signals, and policy are applied across the company. We set the technology strategy for the business and lead its AI transformation, embedding intelligent automation and data-driven capability into the procurement experience rather than layering tools on top of unchanged processes.
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures, and can hold their own in design reviews and technical deep dives. You have a strong grasp of AI and machine learning technologies and understand how to apply them to solve real-world operational problems. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, bringing structure and clarity where none exists, and you have a bias for action that keeps programs moving forward. Above all, you are customer-obsessed, always working backwards from the needs of the business and the end user.

Basic qualifications

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- 2+ years of software development experience
- 4+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience working with AI systems, including large language models and agent-based workflows, strong enough to assess feasibility and challenge proposed designs

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

title: Security Engineer I, Secure Third Party Tools (S3T)
descriptionHtml:
Are you motivated to protect customers at scale by building security into every third-party interaction? The Secure Third Party Tools (S3T) team within Amazon Security is shifting how we safeguard customer trust — moving from reactive assessments to proactive, automated protection. As a Security Engineer on this team, you will combine technical review expertise with a builder's mindset to evaluate third-party services, identify risks, and contribute to tooling that codifies security decisions into repeatable automation. You'll collaborate closely with service teams and senior security engineers, communicating risk clearly and driving resolution. This is a role for someone who is curious, adaptable, and eager to grow their security engineering craft while strengthening how Amazon manages vendor risk.

Key job responsibilities
- Perform technical security reviews of third-party services — including AI/ML integrations, cloud architectures, and services handling sensitive customer data — identifying gaps in security controls and recommending mitigations.
- Trace data flows through complex systems, threat model third-party use cases, and evaluate vendor penetration test reports to surface risks and drive proportionate remediation decisions.
- Contribute to AI-powered security tooling and automation that scales review decisions across the organization, scripting solutions and improving existing runbooks.
- Communicate identified risks and recommendations in written and verbal form to service teams and leadership, escalating where appropriate to drive resolution.
- Author and refine security decision rubrics and implementation patterns so that future engineers can build upon your findings.

A day in the life
You start by picking up a new third-party engagement, reviewing the architecture diagrams and data-flow documentation the service team has provided. You apply threat modeling to identify where sensitive data crosses trust boundaries, then draft your findings and discuss them with a senior engineer during a checkpoint. After lunch you might write a script to automate a repetitive validation step, or update the team's internal tooling with a new decision pattern you've identified. Your work feeds directly into the automation that makes the next review faster and more consistent.

About the team
The S3T team sits within Amazon Security and is responsible for evaluating and securing third-party services used across the company. The team is composed of security engineers at multiple levels who partner closely with builder teams, legal, and privacy stakeholders. Our mission is to scale security through software — encoding high-judgment decisions into automation so we can protect customers worldwide without growing linearly. We are building toward a future where every third-party integration is assessed proactively and continuously, and we are looking for engineers who want to help shape that vision.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of web protocols, common security attacks, and remediation (non-internship) experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Knowledge of system security vulnerabilities and remediation techniques, including penetration testing and the development of exploits or equivalent
- Experience with web protocols, common security attacks, and remediation (non-internship)
- Experience solving basic problems by writing code or scripts with some assistance

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings

title: Engineering Operation Technician Night Role
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.



A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Software Development Engineer, DynamoDB
descriptionHtml:
Want to help shape the future of one of the largest NoSQL database services on the planet?

The Amazon DynamoDB team is looking for deeply technical, team-first-mentality full stack software engineers who are willing to commit themselves to our goal to grow the business 10 times over the next 2 years.

DynamoDB is a key-value database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

You will be responsible to maintain a high bar in terms of execution, operational readiness, code and design quality. You will serve as a mentor for junior engineers and help them grow. You are comfortable working with other seasoned DynamoDB engineers and hold your ground during design and customer experience reviews.

This is a hands-on position where you will own everything from end to end: design, design reviews, implementation, code reviews, iterative feature launches, operations, mentoring, driving continuous improvement, and more.

Key job responsibilities
Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base. You’ll bring a passion for innovation, data, search, analytics, and distributed systems. You’ll also:

- Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
- Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions.
- Build high-quality, secure, performant, highly available, always-on products.
- Automate and improve repetitive operational processes.
- Deep dive and continuously improve performance to deliver superior customer experience.
- Scale distributed systems with optimal balance between performance and cost.

A day in the life
As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also:
- Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
- Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
- Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input.
- Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

About the team
About the team
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Data Center Chief Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide.
The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime.
Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small-to-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities.
The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States)


Key job responsibilities
• Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center.

• Act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed
• Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
• Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever-level events within internal SLA
• Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams
• Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians
• Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff
• Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows
• Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience
• Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling.
• Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions.

Physical Requirements:
• Walk job sites in uneven terrain
• Work at heights and from ladders
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
• Coordinate body movements when using tools or equipment
• Reach and stretch to position equipment and fixtures while maintaining balance
• Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
• Perform physical tasks all day without becoming overly tired
• Use hands to manipulate small wires and objects
• Push or pull heavy objects into position
• Work in a noisy environment
• Work at depths, such as under raised floors

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

title: Lead Quality CMM Programmer, Amazon Leo - Quality Receiving
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Develop, revise, and optimize offline and online CMM programs using PC-DMIS, PolyWorks, and CALYPSO across bridge/gantry CMMs, ROMER Absolute Arms, and Hexagon OPTIV M multisensor systems
Program, set up, and operate coordinate measuring machines for complex aerospace components; define measurement strategies for new part introductions
Produce and standardize CMM set-up and operational instructions for specific parts or machines
Store all CMM data securely and maintain regular backups; own configuration control and revision management on program files and job records
Evaluate and improve legacy inspection programs; lead, mentor, and train CMM programmers and inspection personnel
Oversee inspection of incoming material, work-in-process, and final product for conformance to quality standards
Verify supplier-provided hardware against purchase orders, engineering drawings, and specifications
Lead preparation and disposition of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for nonconforming parts; present dimensional findings and recommendations to the MRB
Provide quality and metrology technical leadership, audit, inspection, problem identification/resolution, training, and expertise to manufacturing groups and suppliers
Review and approve inspection records for compliance with AS9100/ISO 9001 requirements
Lead and execute First Article Inspections per AS9102 standard
Verify all design characteristics, material certifications, manufacturing process verification, and nonconformance resolution during FAI
Define FAI strategies and execute inspections for new parts, design changes, process changes, and after long production lapses
Utilize CMMs, OPTIV M multisensor systems, ROMER arms, 3D scanners, hand tools, and other testing equipment for FAI verification
Lead metrology support for PPAP submissions to validate that production processes can consistently meet requirements
Drive digitization efforts for PPAP and FAI as quality gates in aerospace manufacturing

A day in the life
This role will work daily to:

Own the end-to-end CMM programming function across all metrology platforms (bridge/gantry CMMs, ROMER Absolute Arms, Hexagon OPTIV M multi-sensor systems) — develop, validate, and maintain inspection programs while establishing programming standards, revision control processes, and best practices for the metrology team

Serve as the metrology technical lead interfacing with Quality, Design, Manufacturing Engineering, and Supplier Quality teams — drive metrology input into new product development, define inspection strategies for incoming hardware, and support supplier PPAP correlation activities

Lead dimensional root cause and corrective action (RCCA) investigations for non-conforming hardware — perform detailed CMM analysis to isolate failure modes, author nonconformance reports, and present findings with data-driven recommendations to the Material Review Board (MRB)

Mentor and develop CMM programmers, machine operators, and inspection personnel — conduct training on programming techniques, multi-sensor workflows, GD&T interpretation, and software proficiency across PC-DMIS, PolyWorks, and CALYPSO

Drive continuous improvement of metrology processes through Lean methodology — identify opportunities to reduce inspection cycle times, improve measurement repeatability, and optimize CMM utilization across the receiving inspection operation

About the team
The Amazon Leo Receiving Quality team is driven to develop an Amazon Leo Quality System that is capable of scaling aerospace quality to volume and cost levels to meet end customer needs. This position will join the team at an exciting moment, with an opportunity to own quality system development and contribute to the design of requirements, processes, and systems used across the business. We value data driven decision making, a comfort with dealing in ambiguous situations across multiple projects, and an ability to earn trust of various stakeholders to deliver high quality results.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years CMM programming experience (PC-DMIS specifically)
- Extensive experience performing FAI per AS9102
- Expert in reading/interpreting blueprints with GD&T per ASME Y14.5M
- Experience with receiving inspection of aerospace components
- Knowledge of AS9100/ISO 9001 quality management systems
- Experience with tight-tolerance, high-value aerospace components
- Fluent in precision hand tools, gages, optical comparators, and surface plate work
- Experience documenting and tracking discrepancy/non-conformance reports
- Calibration management experience
- Demonstrated experience programming multiple Hexagon metrology platforms including bridge/gantry CMMs, ROMER Absolute Arm portable CMMs, and OPTIV M multisensor CMMs (Vision+, Scan+, or DualScan+ variants)
- Experience developing multisensor inspection programs that combine vision, tactile, and/or laser measurement within a single measurement routine
- Proficiency with additional metrology software platforms such as PolyWorks Inspector and/or ZEISS CALYPSO
- Experience developing and maintaining CMM program libraries, revision control processes, and standardized inspection documentation across multiple metrology platforms
- Experience leading, mentoring, and training CMM programmers and inspection personnel on advanced programming techniques, multisensor workflows, and best practices

Preferred qualifications

- Deep experience within the Hexagon metrology ecosystem — PC-DMIS across bridge CMMs, ROMER arms, OPTIV M multisensor systems (Vision+, Scan+, or DualScan+ variants), and Hexagon Metrology Asset Manager
- Experience programming OPTIV M multisensor routines that leverage vision, touch-trigger, scanning, and/or laser sensors for complex part inspection in a single measurement run
- Experience with PC-DMIS automation routines, custom scripting, or integration with ERP/MES systems for inspection data flow
- Experience with statistical process control (SPC) tools and using CMM data to build process capability studies and control charts
- PPAP documentation and submission experience, including measurement correlation studies across multiple CMM platforms
- Experience developing in-process inspection programs and integrating metrology into production workflows
- Knowledge of NADCAP special processes (heat treat, plating, coating, EDM, grinding) and their impact on dimensional inspection requirements
- Experience in satellite/space hardware manufacturing or other high-reliability aerospace programs
- Experience with 3D scanning, CT scanning, or non-contact measurement technologies integrated with PC-DMIS
- IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 knowledge (for PCBA receiving inspection)
- Experience with calibration program management and measurement system analysis (MSA/Gage R&R)
- Experience driving Lean process improvements within a metrology or CMM programming function
- Knowledge of ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) for traceability and inspection record management

title: Safety Monitoring Compliance Analyst, NAST Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's North American Surface Transportation Safety & Compliance team (NAST S&C) is looking for a Compliance Analyst to join Safety Monitoring. Safety Monitoring assesses carrier safety performance against Amazon's standards. We use FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS) data and Amazon's Violation Rate Metrics (VRM), and we take action when a carrier falls below the standard.
This role can be assigned to third-party (3P) carrier monitoring or to monitoring for Amazon's own fleet, Transportation Operations Management (TOM). The core work is the same in both. You will run recurring monitoring steps on a fixed schedule, pull and validate data, keep every case record current, and report results. The work follows written procedures and thresholds. Each result can drive an enforcement or safety action, so you will check the data before it moves. You will report to the Safety Monitoring manager and escalate anything that falls outside the procedure.


Key job responsibilities
Pull safety data from FMCSA SMS and internal sources on the monthly schedule.

Validate every record against source data before it goes out, reconciling counts, spot-checking individual records, and documenting each check.

Maintain SIM and Asana so the current status of every case lives in one place.

Prepare recurring metrics for business reviews, including suspension and reinstatement counts, exception outcomes, inspection results, and cycle timeliness.

Maintain procedure documents and recommend process improvements.

Escalate data discrepancies, new case types, and anything with possible legal exposure.

Prepare the monthly BASICs and VRM suspension and reinstatement lists against the written thresholds.

Log carrier exception requests, build each case file against the written criteria, and present cases at the weekly exception review.

Record every review decision as granted, denied, or pending final review.

Submit suspension and reinstatement tickets to Carrier Health and confirm they are actioned.

Send carrier notifications from approved templates once a decision is recorded, answer carrier questions about their status, and route anything outside the templates to your manager.

Monitor carriers under review each week for new violations, out-of-service events, and safety rating changes.

Run the same monitoring steps for Amazon's own fleet, tracking roadside inspection results, out-of-service events, violations, and BASICs results for TOM.

Report trends and open items to TOM safety and operations leaders on a set schedule.

Flag changes that need attention, such as a rising violation rate or a new out-of-service event, to your manager and TOM safety leaders.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of professional or military experience
- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management
- Experience with Excel including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data manipulation
- Experience with SQL databases (querying and analyzing)

title: Data Center Controls Technician
descriptionHtml:
As a member of the Global Controls Team, you will collaborate with highly motivated operators, engineers and technicians in the data center industry to maintain and optimize critical infrastructure systems. You will be responsible for troubleshooting and maintaining the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) while developing new processes and standards that drive innovation in the controls space.

AWS data centers utilize sophisticated industrial control systems to automatically operate mechanical equipment, maintaining optimal temperature and pressure conditions throughout the facilities. These systems integrate and monitor multiple critical components, including generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic and static transfer switches, air-cooled and water-cooled chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAHs), and air economizers. Within this industrial control system infrastructure, the BMS serves as the primary control platform for all mechanical systems within the data center, while the EPMS functions as the primary monitoring platform for all electrical systems. This position offers the opportunity to work with technology in mission-critical environments while contributing to the reliability and efficiency of AWS's global infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
Manage small to medium-sized projects and programs.
Perform point-to-point checkouts between field devices and controllers.
Conduct first-line diagnostics, troubleshooting, and maintenance of BMS/EPMS programming code and hardware.
Provision servers, controllers, industrial PCs, and networks; test communication between third-party devices and controllers.
Install, replace, configure, and calibrate sensors.
Read and interpret electrical schematics and control panel drawings; apply closed-loop controls and field sensor scaling.
Supervise low-voltage contractors per AWS requirements.
Provide commissioning and systems-level testing support; create red-lined drawings.
Follow change management processes for work requests and methods of procedures.
Participate in factory witness tests and perform root cause analysis.
Manage service agreements: vendor scheduling, QA, and invoice review.
Enforce OSHA safety standards.

A day in the life
As a Data Center Controls Technician, your primary customers are Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO), who rely on you to keep Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS) healthy and operational. On a given day, you are the boots on the ground solving problems that directly impact data center availability. You might diagnose a controller communication loss, calibrate instruments feeding inaccurate data to operators, or supervise vendors performing quarterly maintenance. For new builds, you perform point to point testing and support commissioning alongside construction teams.

About the team

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Associate’s degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field with 1+ years of relevant industrial Controls or HVAC controls experience, OR 3+ years of relevant industrial or HVAC controls experience in lieu of a degree.
- Basic understanding of Industrial controls system, knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, relays and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment in a data center, hospitals, large commercial complex, water, power, oil & gas or similar industries.
- 1+ years of experience working with low voltage controls, wiring, networking signals, electrical and mechanical systems, computers and operating systems.
- Ability to work non-standard hours and differing work rotations/shifts and overtime as required.

Preferred qualifications

- A+ or CND (Certified Network Defender) or Network+ or Security+
- Associate's degree in related field
- 4+ years of military experience
- International Society of Automation (ISA) Certified Controls System Technician (CCST) Level I or higher certification.
- Experience using common communication protocols (MQTT, BACnet, and/or MODBUS).
- 5+ years of experience in controls/automation, construction or related field in a technical environment.
- Demonstrated understanding of engineering documentation, electrical and mechanical diagrams, and standard operating procedures.
- Experience in data centers or mission critical environment
- Fundamental knowledge of network design and layout as well as low voltage (copper/ fiber) cabling.
- Prior AWS/Amazon experience

title: Sr. Product Designer, AWS Search, Security, Observability, Governance
descriptionHtml:
Security is one of the hardest problems in the world and it just got harder. As AI agents begin to write code, triage infrastructure, and take action autonomously on customers' behalf, the old model of security — dashboards a human reads, alerts a human triages. The hard question is no longer can a person see what happened? It's can a customer trust a system that acts on its own, verify what it did, and stay in control? That question of trust is the design problem of this decade, and it sits at the center of this role.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to help reimagine what security looks like in an agentic world. You'll own the end-to-end experience for agentic security surfaces including AWS Continuum and AWS Security Hub products we're rebuilding from first principles around autonomy, action, and trust rather than around tables of findings. This is net-new territory: there is no established pattern language for how a customer grants an agent autonomy, watches it work, understands its reasoning, and reins it back when needed. You'll invent it. Your work will decide whether customers feel confident handing real consequence to a system that acts for them, the difference between security that customers tolerate and security they trust.

Key job responsibilities
1. Own the end-to-end design for agentic security surfaces — AWS Continuum, AWS Security Hub, and related products — from problem framing and research through interaction design, visual craft, and launch.
Define how trust is earned in the interface: how a customer grants autonomy, observes an agent's actions and reasoning, verifies outcomes, and intervenes — building confidence through evidence rather than demanding it up front.
2. Set the design vision and the pattern language for autonomy in security, in a space where those patterns don't yet exist, and bring partners along with sharp narratives and prototypes.
3. Partner daily with product, engineering, and science to balance customer needs, deep technical constraints, and the novel safety and verification demands of agentic systems.
4. Confront the runtime verification problem head-on: when an agent acts faster and more opaquely than a human can follow, design the experience that keeps the customer informed, in control, and able to trust what the system did.
5. Ground every decision in evidence — synthesize qualitative and quantitative signal, run research, and validate with real security practitioners before and after launch.
6. Translate dense security and agentic concepts (autonomy levels, agent reasoning, remediation, verification, telemetry) into interfaces that reduce cognitive load and build confidence.
7. Raise the design bar across the team through critique, mentorship, and reusable patterns, and extend the shared systems your work depends on.

A day in the life
Your morning might start in a working session with your PM and tech lead, pressure-testing how much autonomy a customer should be able to grant an agent on day one — and how the interface earns the right to ask for more. Midday you're in a critique, giving and getting sharp, specific feedback on how an agent surfaces its reasoning without burying the customer in detail. In the afternoon you watch a security analyst work through your Continuum prototype — the moment they hesitate before letting the agent act tells you more than any survey — and you redesign that moment before you log off. Across the week you move between zoomed-out strategy (what does security even look like when agents do most of the work?) and zoomed-in craft (is this the right default, the right disclosure, the right word for "undo"?). You're trusted to set your own direction, surrounded by partners who treat the trust problem as seriously as you do.

About the team
AWS Security sits inside SSOG, where the thesis is direct: as AI systems grow more capable and more autonomous, security has to keep pace — and the gap between what an agent can do and what a human can verify is one of the defining problems of the field. We're not bolting AI onto yesterday's security console; we're rebuilding the experience for a world where agents act and humans need to trust, verify, and stay in control. Our design org is the MOAT proving the clarity and trustworthiness of an experience is as much a differentiator as any capability. We're a senior, tight-knit group that ships real products for real customers, invests in craft and research, gives designers genuine ownership of their problem space, and cares about raising each other's work.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of design experience

Preferred qualifications

- Have an available online portfolio
- Knowledge of usability principles and techniques
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings

title: Senior Network Development Manager, Networking
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's network is a key differentiator for Amazon Cloud Computing and Web Services (AWS), enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Our AWS networking teams develop and operate the network platform for all of Amazon, including e-commerce products and cloud computing solutions. This platform is industry-leading for its efficiency, throughput, and reliability -- making it critical to the success of hundreds of thousands of AWS customers.

We are looking for a Senior Network Development Manager (NDM) to join our team, serving large customers with unique requirements. This opportunity will have you lead the design, operation, scaling, and expansion of the network, software, and systems that support AWS Regions. This infrastructure is dedicated to the enterprise and mission needs of partners across federal and civilian agencies, research and development centers, and private industry. It combines innovation in cloud computing with dedicated infrastructure that provides customers and partners with the scale and speed needed to move from data collection to decisions and action.

As a Senior NDM, you will be hiring, managing, and developing multiple teams of network and systems engineers. You will be responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the network including capacity management and forecasting, scaling and expansion, change control, and continuous improvement through new software automation, tools, and systems. You will lead the operations and evolution of a network that is software driven, highly automated, and operating at an unmatched global scale. You will also represent the networking team to our customers, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery and safe operations.

At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be great engineers who can dive deep and get involved in helping their engineers make good decisions and deliver quality solutions. They should maintain a good level of technical understanding and be able to ensure the right engineering expertise exists within the team. In addition, our leaders are thoughtful managers who support and mentor their team and create a friendly working environment of mutual trust and respect.

This is a high visibility and high impact role.
To be considered for this role you must be a UK national.

Key job responsibilities
The person in this role will be responsible for:

- Managing software and network issues to drive down availability risks, while ensuring they are addressed long-term through effective solutions that prevent a recurrence.
- Identifying and implementing innovation opportunities that improve the security, availability, scalability, performance, agility and cost efficiency of the network.
- Working closely with customers and internal partners to develop, communicate, and deliver technology roadmaps that invent new network and software solutions.

title: Sr. Performance Marketing Mgr, Veeqo
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager with experience in marketing specifically for a B2B SaaS company targeting mid-market to enterprise level clients. The ideal candidate will be a data-driven and analytical marketer with a track record of driving growth through performance marketing, specifically across paid channels including search (Google, Microsoft), paid social (LinkedIn, Meta), display, and programmatic. They have experience leading cross-functional paid media initiatives in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, balancing long-term channel strategy with the ability to execute tactical optimizations in a fast-growing space.

As the Senior B2B Performance Marketing Manager you will work closely with other members of the marketing team and cross-functional teams, to develop, test, and iterate on performance marketing campaigns that drive qualified leads and revenue growth. You will own, develop and scale paid media campaigns across the full funnel with the goal of driving acquisition, adoption and engagement with Veeqo.

It is important the candidate can foster a creative team environment, inventing new approaches to ad creative and targeting, building robust A/B testing structures, diving deep into campaign performance data, and doubling down on what's performing.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Performance Marketing Manager you will:

- Develop and execute comprehensive full-funnel paid media strategies across search, social, display, and programmatic channels that deliver measurable business results.
- Manage the day-to-day operations of paid media campaigns including launching, testing, and optimizing ad creative, audiences, bidding strategies, and landing pages across the funnel.
- Own budget allocation and pacing across paid channels, ensuring efficient spend and maximizing return on ad spend (ROAS) and cost per acquisition (CPA).
- Lead marketing automation and audience strategy implementation to drive program efficiency and improve lead quality.
- Establish rigorous testing frameworks (A/B, incrementality, geo-lift) and optimization processes. Develop metrics and measurement to determine campaign effectiveness and true incremental impact.
- Lead budget planning and forecasting for paid media initiatives. You will be responsible for actively communicating the progress and financial health of the program across the organization.
- Drive continuous innovation in measurement, attribution, and incrementality testing across paid channels.
- Explore and scale emerging paid media opportunities including AI-powered ad formats, new platforms (e.g., Reddit), and audience expansion strategies.
- Partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Data to align on growth initiatives and ensure paid media supports broader business objectives.
- Manage relationships with external agencies and platform partners to maximize campaign performance.

About the team
Veeqo (veeqo.com) – a startup which was acquired by Amazon in 2021 – is Amazon's recommended shipping, inventory, and warehouse management solution for Sellers. Our vision is to become the multi-channel solution for eCommerce sellers, for both their on-Amazon and off-Amazon business. We help sellers manage fulfillment operations across all their online stores, and ship orders to customers at the lowest cost and in the fastest possible time. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place.

In order to accelerate the next phase of Veeqo's development, we are committed to transforming the depth, scale and ambition of our marketing capabilities. The marketing team uses data, seller insights, and automation to invent, test and scale programs that raise awareness of Veeqo and drive Sellers to signup or engage with our sales team. We're in a high-growth phase and seeking exceptional talent to drive our next stage of expansion.

Basic qualifications

- Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
- Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Experience aggregating and analyzing internal and external campaign metrics to assess performance drivers and identify insights
- Proven track record of scaling paid media programs that delivered significant revenue impact, including measurement, creative strategy, audience targeting, and activation across all parts of the funnel.
- Deep hands-on experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and/or Meta Ads at scale.
- Strong understanding of paid media technology, bid management, attribution models, and marketing automation platforms.
- Ability to analyze raw campaign data and develop actionable insights related to paid media performance. Understanding of basic statistics and mathematical modeling concepts such as statistical significance, standard deviations, and regression analysis.
- Experience with incrementality testing, geo-lift studies, or other advanced measurement methodologies.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using any of SQL or other analytical tools for conducting data analysis
- Experience with customer segmentation, profiling, and targeting
- 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, with 4+ years specifically in paid media and demand generation.
- Experience managing six-figure+ paid media budgets with demonstrated ability to optimize spend efficiency while scaling volume.
- Experience working with external agencies or platform reps to source creative and manage campaigns within a defined budget.
- Strong analytical skills with proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI tools.
- Experience with AI-driven campaign strategies (Performance Max, broad match with smart bidding, etc.).

descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Catalog Ontology is the shared product-knowledge layer that powers experiences across the entire Stores ecosystem. Every time a customer searches, browses, or buys, structured product knowledge is working behind the scenes to deliver accurate discovery, trustworthy information, and broad selection. This is the first time the ontology is getting a dedicated Principal Product Manager - Technical to treat it as a product in its own right. You will define the product strategy from the ground up, drive adoption across the downstream domains that depend on it, and shape a roadmap whose benefits compound across the Stores business. If you are a technical product leader who does your best work in ambiguous, cross-organizational spaces and wants to own a problem where one good decision makes dozens of teams more effective, we want to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities
