title: Senior Technical Infrastructure Program Manager, QC Pre-Construction, North America Quick Commerce
descriptionHtml:
The Quick Commerce (QC) Pre-Construction team is looking for a Technical Infrastructure Program Manager III (TIPM III) to own the pre-construction strategy, technical design standards, site feasibility evaluation, and international design benchmarking for QC’s rapidly scaling North America network.

QC deploys multiple physical infrastructure formats, including Stand Alone and Co-Located sites, where pre-construction requirements vary by site type, existing building conditions, infrastructure capacity, permitting jurisdiction, and deployment scenario.
This role operates at the intersection of technical design and site readiness, defining how prospective QC sites are evaluated for infrastructure feasibility, how design packages produced by Architects of Record (AORs) and Engineers of Record (EORs) are reviewed for constructability and specification compliance, and how international quick commerce design approaches are benchmarked and adapted to improve QC’s North America standards.

The TIPM III will develop and maintain site evaluation criteria, technical design review standards, AOR/EOR performance frameworks, cost estimating methodologies, permitting strategies, and change-management mechanisms that govern QC pre-construction delivery. You will use technical domain knowledge to assess site feasibility, evaluate AOR/EOR design deliverables, identify design and permitting risks, challenge cost and schedule assumptions, benchmark technical solutions against international quick commerce operators, and provide feedback to Design Engineering, Real Estate, and Construction teams for specification and process improvement.

This role goes beyond reviewing a completed design package. You will define and continuously improve the pre-construction process itself into scalable standards that improve speed, design quality, cost predictability, and constructability across the QC portfolio.

Key job responsibilities
• Own and continuously improve QC pre-construction technical design and site evaluation standards across formats.
• Develop site feasibility criteria, technical design review checklists, cost estimating frameworks, and due diligence standards.
• Define new pre-construction processes where established evaluation methods, design review workflows, or permitting strategies do not yet exist.
• Evaluate prospective sites for infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, constructability, permitting complexity, cost, and operational requirements to inform site selection decisions.
• Lead technical review of AOR and EOR design deliverables, evaluating design packages for constructability, specification compliance, infrastructure integration risks, code compliance, and alignment with QC deployment standards before construction handoff.
• Benchmark QC technical design standards against international quick commerce operators, identifying design innovations, infrastructure approaches, and deployment methodologies that can be adapted to improve QC’s North America standards.
• Partner with Design Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, and external AOR/EOR partners to resolve complex pre-construction issues and align site evaluation criteria.
• Root-cause recurring pre-construction issues and translate findings into upstream improvements to site selection criteria, design specifications, AOR/EOR scopes, cost models, and permitting processes.
• Establish change-management mechanisms ensuring design learnings, cost data, jurisdictional findings, and international benchmarking insights are consistently incorporated into future site evaluations and design standards.
• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex pre-construction issues, determining whether gaps stem from site conditions, AOR/EOR design quality, cost assumptions, permitting, or evaluation methodology.

A day in the life
You start by reviewing a batch of prospective sites, assessing infrastructure capacity, existing building conditions, permitting jurisdiction complexity, and technical constraints to inform site selection and determine fit for QC deployment. Mid-morning, you lead a design review session on an AOR’s 90% construction document set, flagging a refrigeration layout concern and a fire protection code question that need resolution before permit submission. After lunch, compare QC’s cold-chain infrastructure approach against a leading international quick commerce operator’s design, identifying an equipment standardization opportunity worth exploring. You then join a call with a municipality and EDP partners to resolve an open plan review comment that is holding up a permit timeline. Before end of day, you document lessons from a recently permitted site and update the EOR scope of work template so the next design cycle captures requirements that were missed in this round. Your work turns site evaluation, design review, and international benchmarking learnings into repeatable improvements for future QC deployments.

About the team
The QC Pre-Construction team evaluates and prepares multiple site formats across varying building conditions, jurisdictions, and infrastructure configurations supporting Amazon’s Quick Commerce across North America. TIPMs work alongside Pre-Construction Managers, Construction, Design Engineering, Real Estate, SUEX, WHS, Finance, Operations, EDP, and external AOR/EOR partners to develop scalable pre-construction solutions. While Pre-Construction Managers lead day-to-day site evaluation and project setup activities, TIPMs define and improve the technical standards that guide how sites are assessed and how design partners deliver.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Structural, Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
- 4+ years of construction or project management, or 10+ years of relevant discipline work experience
- Experience evaluating prospective sites or facilities for technical feasibility, infrastructure capacity, constructability, and deployment fit.
- Experience reviewing architectural and engineering design deliverables for constructability, code compliance, specification alignment, and infrastructure integration.
- Experience managing AOR, EOR, or A&E consultant relationships, including scopes of work, design deliverable reviews, performance management, and technical issue resolution.
- Experience developing or implementing pre-construction standards, site evaluation criteria, design review processes, or technical specifications.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses
- PE, RA, CCM, CPE, PMP, or similar technical/professional certification.
- Experience developing new infrastructure deployment processes or technical standards where established solutions did not previously exist.
- Experience leveraging data and technology to identify systemic infrastructure issues and drive process improvement across a portfolio.

title: Software Dev Manager, DDB Index and Search
descriptionHtml:
Software Development Manager, DynamoDB Vector Search

Amazon DynamoDB is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a new initiative building native vector search, full-text search, and hybrid retrieval . You will lead engineers working at the intersection of distributed databases, information retrieval, and AI infrastructure, enabling customers to search their operational data without building and managing a separate search stack.

The technical decisions are substantial. How should vector indexes be organized across a changing, partitioned dataset? How do selective filters affect approximate nearest-neighbor retrieval? How should semantic and keyword results be combined? How do you deliver high recall and predictable tail latency while data is continuously inserted, updated, and deleted?

Your team will tackle these questions across the search stack—from index structures and storage integration to distributed query execution and relevance evaluation. The work includes evaluating graph-based and clustering-based indexing approaches, compression, caching, text analysis, and ranking. You will guide decisions about what to build, how to measure it, and how to evolve the architecture as customer workloads grow.

As the SDM, you will own the team’s roadmap, engineering execution, and operational readiness. You will work with senior and principal engineers to resolve architectural questions, establish measurable launch criteria, and turn exploration into production capabilities. You will hire and develop engineers, build technical leadership within the team, and create an environment where engineers can make decisions and carry them through to customer outcomes.

This is an opportunity to shape a new database capability from its foundational architecture through launch, helping developers build semantic discovery, recommendations, and retrieval for generative AI applications directly on DynamoDB.



Key job responsibilities


- Lead and grow an engineering team building vector, full-text, and hybrid search; develop engineers with depth in search algorithms, database internals, and distributed execution.
- Own the technical roadmap, sequencing algorithm evaluation, integration, performance qualification, and customer delivery into achievable milestones.
- Guide architecture for vector and text indexes, including choices among retrieval algorithms, memory and disk layouts, compression, and update strategies.
- Lead delivery of query planning and execution across partitions, including filter placement, candidate selection, ranking, and combining results.
- Establish evaluation practices that reveal how recall, relevance, latency, and cost change with dataset size, filter selectivity, write rate, and workload skew.
- Partner with storage and database teams to support search under continuous data changes, infrastructure failures, and growing workloads.
- Make deliberate scope and staffing decisions, resolve dependencies, and ensure testing and rollout plans develop alongside implementation.
- Own production readiness and team health, including observability, deployment safety, incident learning, and sustainable on-call practices.


Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams
- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of engineering experience
- Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams
- Experience leading architecture and delivery of distributed databases, storage systems, replication, or transaction infrastructure.
- Experience delivering substantial changes across multiple teams while maintaining production reliability.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Electrical Engineer, Power Resiliency
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is seeking an experienced Technical Infrastructure Program Manager (TIPM) to join our Global Engineering Services & Analytics (GESA) organization within the Power Resiliency team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end program management of power resiliency assets—including generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and related electrical infrastructure—across Amazon’s global portfolio of fulfillment centers, sort centers, and delivery stations.
You will drive the implementation, commissioning, and lifecycle management of technical power projects that ensure uninterrupted operations at Amazon sites worldwide. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work cross-functionally with electrical engineering, construction, operations, safety, and procurement teams to deliver resilient power solutions at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Implementation & Delivery
• Scope, plan, and execute generator and BESS installation projects from concept through commissioning, ensuring on-time, on-budget delivery aligned with site operational requirements.
• Develop and maintain comprehensive project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and status reports for all assigned power resiliency capital projects.
• Coordinate commissioning, testing, and acceptance protocols for new power equipment, ensuring compliance with Amazon technical standards, NEC/NFPA codes, and local jurisdictional requirements.
• Manage design reviews and technical submittals, working closely with electrical engineers and third-party design firms to ensure constructability and operational readiness.
• Drive the procurement process for generators, BESS units, switchgear, and related balance-of-plant equipment in partnership with Strategic Sourcing.

Maintenance & Lifecycle Management
• Develop and oversee preventive and corrective maintenance programs for generators, BESS, automatic transfer switches (ATS), paralleling switchgear, and associated controls across assigned sites.
• Establish maintenance KPIs and reporting cadences; analyze equipment performance data to identify trends, predict failures, and optimize maintenance intervals.
• Manage end-of-life planning and replacement strategies for aging power resiliency assets, including capital justification and prioritization.
• Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements, manufacturer recommendations, and Amazon internal standards for power equipment maintenance.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management
• Manage vendor relationships with generator OEMs, BESS suppliers, electrical contractors, and commissioning agents; hold partners accountable to scope, schedule, quality, and safety standards.
• Serve as the primary point of contact between engineering, construction, operations, and external partners for all power resiliency project activities at assigned sites.
• Facilitate stakeholder alignment across regional operations teams, site leadership, safety, and corporate engineering to ensure seamless project delivery and transition to steady-state operations.
• Negotiate contracts, change orders, and service agreements; manage purchase orders and invoicing through the project lifecycle.

Technical Leadership & Strategy
• Support the development of Amazon’s global power resiliency strategy, including site assessment frameworks, resiliency scoring models, and technology evaluation criteria.
• Evaluate emerging technologies in energy storage, distributed generation, microgrid architecture, and renewable integration to inform the team’s technical roadmap.
• Author and maintain technical standards, design guidelines, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for generator and BESS programs.
• Conduct root-cause analysis on power system failures and outages; develop corrective action plans and drive implementation across the portfolio.
• Represent the Power Resiliency team in cross-functional reviews, leadership briefings, and incident response coordination.

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related field
- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- Knowledge of project management tools and software
- 3+ years of construction or project management, or 3+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 2+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA 110, NFPA 111, IEEE, and other applicable codes and standards governing emergency and standby power systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in data centers or critical infrastructure
- Experience working in a matrixed organization

- Knowledge of microgrid design, distributed energy resources (DERs), renewable energy integration, and advanced energy storage technologies (lithium-ion, flow batteries, etc.).

title: Software Development Manager, Product Data Quality Measurement Systems
descriptionHtml:
Every time a customer searches, browses or asks an AI assistant for help on Amazon, the experience depends on great product data. Lead the team that defines what "high-quality" means for every product in our catalog of billions, and builds the LLM and agentic systems that measure it.

Amazon's Catalog Systems division is looking for an exceptional engineering manager to lead, architect and deliver Generative AI-powered solutions that measure and raise the quality of the world's largest product catalog. An accurate, information-rich catalog powers product discovery, helps customers make confident buying decisions and makes Amazon the first stop for shoppers. That's true whether customers shop through search and detail pages or through conversational assistants and AI agents.

You'll be the engineering leader behind the single quality score used across Amazon for every product. Brands and sellers use it to fix their listings. Category leaders use it to set goals. Search, shopping experiences and AI assistants use it to decide which products and details to show customers. Your systems use LLMs and multimodal models to find defects in titles, attributes, bullet points, rich content, variations and images. They catch text that contradicts the product image, weigh each defect by how much it hurts the customer, and roll it all into one score people trust.

There's no single right answer here, and that's what makes it interesting. Some days it's a smart heuristic or a classic ML model. Other days it's LLM-as-a-judge, multimodal reasoning or an autonomous agent that improves its own prompts. You'll do all of this at a scale few places can offer, and your work will shape how millions of customers discover and buy products worldwide.

What you'll work on:

- GenAI and LLMs: Run production LLM and multimodal pipelines at catalog scale. Benchmark models, tune prompts and fine-tune for high precision at low cost.
- Agentic systems: Build AI agents that detect defects, find root causes, check their own accuracy and close the loop with selling partners. Bring agentic coding practices to how your team builds software.
- Powering customer experiences: Supply trusted, machine-readable quality signals that search, detail pages, recommendations and AI shopping assistants use to decide which products and details customers see.
- Scale and cost: Build batch and real-time, event-driven systems on AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, EMR/Spark, ECS, Lambda). Keep inference and compute costs growing more slowly than the catalog.
- Measuring the measurers: Track precision and recall for every detector, and use human-in-the-loop auditing and smart sampling to build ground truth.
- Insights and guardrails: Give brands and sellers fast feedback and self-service insights, and set up AI guardrails that block bad data before it reaches the catalog.
What you'll own:

- The vision, strategy and roadmap for AI-driven product quality measurement
- Hiring, mentoring and growing a high-performing team of engineers and tech leads
- Partnerships with science, image/media, catalog and selling partner teams to keep raising the quality bar
- Technical decisions that balance innovation, accuracy, cost and operational excellence
If you want your work to shape what millions of customers see every day, however they choose to shop, let's talk.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the long-term vision and strategy for AI-driven product data quality measurement, and turn it into a roadmap your team can deliver.
- Lead a team of software engineers, including senior engineers, to architect, build, test and deploy scalable batch and real-time systems with a constant focus on customers.
- Drive delivery of LLM, multimodal and agentic solutions that detect product data defects, weigh them by customer impact and roll them up into a trusted quality score.
- Partner with science teams to benchmark models, tune prompts and fine-tune, so quality signals stay accurate as costs come down.
- Set and track precision, recall and cost metrics for every detection system, and use the results to keep improving.
- Work with image/media, search, catalog and selling partner teams to define product quality and turn measurements into fixes customers can see, across search, detail pages and AI shopping assistants.
- Make technical decisions that balance speed, accuracy, cost and operational excellence. Manage technical debt and own system reliability and on-call health.
- Hire, mentor and develop engineers and future technical leaders, and keep the team performing at a high level.
- Report on progress, quality, operations and system performance to senior leadership, and influence their technical direction and investment decisions.

A day in the life
Your main job is making sure the product quality score is accurate, trusted and gets better every week. Most mornings start with your team's dashboards. Are the detectors catching real defects? Did a new LLM prompt raise precision or just cost? Is the real-time pipeline healthy?

From there, the day is a mix of people and problems. You might work through a design with your engineers on scaling a new multimodal check to billions of products. Then you might sit down with scientists to decide whether a fine-tuned model is ready for production. You'll also meet with partner teams in image, search and selling partner experience, who rely on your score and bring you the hard questions. For example, why does this product get a low grade? Or can you flag this defect before it goes live?

Your customers are both inside and outside Amazon. Brands and sellers use your signals to fix their listings. Category leaders use them to set goals. Shopping experiences, from search to AI assistants, use them to decide what customers see.

Some days go beyond the usual work. You might dig into a customer complaint that shows a gap in how quality is measured, try out an AI agent that improves its own prompts, or explain to senior leaders why a metric moved. And you'll always make time to coach your team and help your engineers grow.

About the team
We believe every customer should be able to shop on Amazon with confidence in the product information they see. Our team builds the systems that measure product data quality across billions of products, then turns them into action. Brands and sellers use our insights to improve their listings, category teams use them to set goals, and shopping experiences from search to AI assistants use them to decide what customers see. You'll work with engineers, scientists and partner teams in image, search and selling partner experience. We value trust over coverage, design for billions from day one, and believe customer stories reveal what metrics miss.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Colo Electrical Engineer, Colocation Regional Engineering

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Role
As a Colo Electrical Regional Engineer, you will drive Electrical Engineering services, construction and implementation of enterprise data centers, which meet quality and performance levels across the globe. You will work directly with our Design Engineering Stakeholders, Construction, Operations, and Commissioning teams regionally and globally. You will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyper-scale.

The Colo Electrical Regional Engineer is the engineering representative on behalf of the Data Center Colo Regional Engineering team responsible for the successful delivery of projects. In this role, you will assist in Data Center site selection, planning, development. You will evaluate different mechanical/electrical systems and make a data driven decision about a suitable solution based on our guidelines.

Key job responsibilities
• Work with Colo vendors to review the design for new Data Centers in your region, including design input, submittal review and incorporating AWS products to ensure the design is meeting AWS expectations.
• Act as Resident Engineer during new Colo construction projects. Support construction, commissioning, and handover.
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
• Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including essential equipment, and event support.
• Provide technical support to the design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
• Supporting operating partners to lead, review, and approve designs for existing Colocation data center upgrades which improve availability/efficiency.
• Interface with operating partners, data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered by operating partners.
• Work on concurrent projects, sometimes in multiple geographical regions.
• Initiate and lead engineering site audits within Colo data centers. Produce reports outlining risks with recommended mitigations and remediations.

A day in the life
Each day you will interact with different teams responsible for all aspects of the data centers. You will prioritize your activities to support data center capacity availability and safety focusing on the actions that are most impactful. You will have the opportunity to work on projects locally and globally. You will be leading projects to fit out the data centers we support to meet ever-evolving customer needs as we continue expanding our fleet to hyperscale.

About the team
We are a collaborative group of engineering professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of data center design and implementation. Our team is committed to creating robust, efficient, and scalable infrastructure that supports global technological innovation. We value technical excellence, creative problem-solving, and a passion for continuous improvement.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field

descriptionHtml:
Network Flow Control Tower:
At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step and a day to look forward to new challenges. And today is that day for you. It's your day to be part of something great. A day to make your ideas come to life and your day to join a company that redefines itself every day. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon.

Network Flow CT is the central control center for Transportation Execution across the Amazon's European Transportation Middle Mile network, supporting both domestic and inter-country transportation movements for European geographies. Control Tower Team is the central owner to manage the sort center capacities in ATROPS and operates with a vision to provide uninterrupted sort center flows by managing the virtual capacities, tracking inbound flows and reacting to network disruptions that impact the Sort Center Flow. CT team plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon's European transportation network and thereby has direct impact on Amazon's ability to serve customers on time.

Purview of a Process Specialist
Process Operations Specialist works across the EU in a cross-functional environment with Sort Centers, Forecasting ,Supply Chain, FCs, to determine future demand for Sort Centers Capacity and translates the aforementioned into accurate capacity plans. S/he also maintains and reports up to date and accurate statistics, management reports and analysis. S/he also facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. Process Operations Specialist also provide timely resolution to the issue in hand by researching and querying internal tools and by taking real-time decisions. An ideal candidate should be able to understand the requirements/be able to analyze data and notice trends and be able to drive Customer Experience without compromising on time. The candidate should have the basic understanding of Logistics and should be able to communicate clearly in the written and oral form.

title: Manager, Software Development, Pre Station Planning Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon has come a long way since opening on the World Wide Web in July 1995. Today, we operate retail websites in multiple countries across geographies, offering products in many categories (books, media, digital, electronics etc.) worldwide, and we still like to work hard, have fun and make history! The Amazon.com brand has become synonymous with a superior level of convenience, selection, low prices, and customer service. The

Last Mile Planning team, within the LMT organization, is at the heart of our growing logistics network at Amazon. We build all the software that creates efficient route, station and capacity plans that operations uses to deliver billions of packages that Amazon customers order worldwide, right up to their doorsteps. We’re challenged to constantly improve and innovate on our vehicle routing/planning software and tools to better support fast delivery to customers. The technology innovations that are developed by the Last Mile Technology team scale our growing network and include a wide breadth of solutions from ML and operations research-based routing and planning algorithms, our own in-house maps and navigation platform, IoT and hardware innovations, doorstep delivery experience, and the consumer grade native mobile apps that brings all these experiences together.

The Pre Station Planning Technology team is one of the critical teams supporting and enabling Last Mile operations for Amazon Worldwide. We build software for demand forecasting, capacity planning, jurisdiction and topology management and fleet planning among other areas. All of these services help estimate the precise number of stations, vehicles, drivers and routes to deliver billions of packages to customers worldwide and have a high impact on cost as well as deliver efficiency.

We are looking for a Software Development Manager with exceptional technical skills and a passion for delivering great software to join our team. As a member of this team, you will be responsible to own and deliver highly visible, innovative projects that directly impact the customer experience. You will be involved in driving the technical and architectural vision for a planning team that touches every Amazon package, as well as all the aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing & delivery of our product.

Key job responsibilities
1. Be responsible for the end to end ownership of a technology team, including setting the technical vision for developing our systems to serve Amazon's needs.
2. Build and manage great software engineers that are responsible for developing and maintaining software that ensures safety and compliance for our customers, associates and carrier partners.
3. Be a champion of engineering and operational excellence: establish team metrics for measurement of engineering and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvement.
4. Establish a consistent, project management framework and excellent development processes to deliver high quality software, in rapid iterations, for business partners in multiple geographies.
5. Show strong business and technical judgment that will accelerate time to market of releases, while incrementally moving our services towards the long term vision.
6. Be responsible for mentoring and developing engineers.
7. Represent the technical organization and evangelize the work to business stakeholders and senior leadership.
8. Raise the bar on technical excellence, show thought leadership, and communicate well to different audiences.

A day in the life
1. Be part of discussions, brainstorming ideas with Product Managers, SMEs, SDMs etc.,
2. Drive tech team with Sprint execution, identify efficiencies, operational improvements and be part of design reviews, two-way door decisions etc.,
3. Have 1:1s with the team, cross-team SDMs, managers and skip managers
4. Drive the team and org vision with innovative solutions and think big ideas
5. Have a lots of customer obsession and deliver results.
6. Collaborate closely with partners, stakeholders, UX and others to help define the scope of the product.
7. Contribute to OP plans, OE/ EE/ KTLO

About the team
The Pre Station Planning Technology team is one of the critical teams supporting and enabling Last Mile operations for Amazon Worldwide. We build software for demand forecasting, capacity planning, jurisdiction and topology management and fleet planning among other areas. All of these services help estimate the precise number of stations, vehicles, drivers and routes to deliver billions of packages to customers worldwide and have a high impact on cost as well as deliver efficiency.

descriptionHtml:

Your broad responsibilities will include owning the technical engagement and the ultimate success of specific implementation projects, and developing deep expertise in AWS technologies along with broad know-how of how applications and services are built on the AWS platform. You will work hands-on alongside customers to co-create solutions and write production-ready code, using AI-powered development tools (such as Amazon Quick and Kiro) to accelerate prototyping, modernize workloads, and turn ideas into working software faster.

The ideal candidate will possess customer-facing skills that will allow them to represent Amazon well within a customer's environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables them to easily interact and give guidance with software developers and architects. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Instandhaltungstechniker:in
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

The minimum basic salary for this position is 2885.8 EUR gross per month. In accordance with the applicable legal requirements, we also state that the minimum salary for this position is determined by the relevant collective bargaining agreement. Depending on experience and qualifications, there is a willingness to overpay. In addition, depending on the position, we offer sign-on payments and restricted stock unit (RSU) award as well as employee discount.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit

WIR BIETEN:
• Einen unbefristeten Vertrag direkt mit Amazon.
• Spannende Aufgaben in einem expandierenden, innovativen und internationalen Umfeld.
• Gestaltungsfreiräume für Ideen und Wertschätzung von Engagement.
• Hervorragende Perspektiven aufgrund unseres Wachstums.
• Die Mitarbeit in einem kompetenten, hoch motivierten Team.
• Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und ein attraktives Vergütungspaket mit Unternehmensbeteiligung.
• Das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgrundgehalt beträgt € 39.243€ brutto pro Jahr. Eine Überzahlung ist je nach Qualifikation und Erfahrung möglich.

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk

- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

title: HR Partner, Amazon Leo (L5)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites to deliver low-latency, high-speed broadband to unserved and underserved communities worldwide. We're looking for a Human Resources Partner (HRP) to join the team shaping the people experience behind this industry-changing initiative.

In this role, you'll serve as a strategic and hands-on HRP to site leadership and frontline managers across the Leo organization. You'll collaborate with senior leaders, HRBPs, and cross-functional PXT teams — including Employee Relations and Labor Relations — to design and execute people strategies that drive engagement, build manager capability, and strengthen the employee experience. A core focus of this role is leveraging listening mechanisms — including regular floor walks and sentiment analysis — to proactively surface trends, recommend actions, and close the loop with leadership.

You'll also play a key role in building the HR infrastructure for a scaling operation: launching policies, processes, and tools; leading change management; and standing up programs tailored to Leo's unique operating environment. Until centralized solutions are fully in place, you'll provide interim support for employee lifecycle processes and serve as the first point of escalation for employee concerns and time-sensitive issues, including labor relations matters.

This is an on-site role based at SEA133 in Kirkland, WA, working Tuesday through Saturday on a night-shift schedule from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM, with flexibility to adjust hours based on business needs. You must be reachable for escalations outside standard hours on a rotational or as-needed basis. Travel to the Everett or Redmond facility is required as driven by business need. This role will provide cross-site coverage, supporting the Redmond and Everett sites during shift.

Key job responsibilities
- Conduct regular Gemba walks and analyze employee sentiment data to advocate for employee needs, enhance engagement, and develop proactive strategies with leaders.
- Partner with business leaders and cross-functional PXT teams (HRBPs, Employee Relations, Labor Relations) to align on engagement actions and execute site-specific programs, including defining ER/LR strategy for the Florida site.
- Consult on talent management, performance management, compensation, and employee relations — including coaching, Focus & Pivot/PIP guidance, promotion and talent review support, and off-cycle compensation changes.
- Conduct workplace investigations and support employee queries with discretion, applying Amazon policies and high judgment. Serve as first point of escalation for concerns beyond MyHR (policy exceptions, emergency management, regulatory escalations).
- Build and launch HR infrastructure — policies, processes, and tools — followed by change management and manager training (e.g., performance management practices, ADAPT).
- Provide interim employee lifecycle support for processes not yet automated or centralized (e.g., payroll corrections, escalations not handled by MyHR).
- Coach and guide managers to enhance their decision-making and managerial capabilities across performance, talent, compensation, and employee relations.
- Collaborate with central teams to improve processes, influence product development, and implement mechanisms that achieve key business goals.
- Evaluate and streamline HR structures, identifying opportunities for centralization and standardization.

- HR experience supporting hourly populations in Manufacturing, Aerospace, or Operations
- Meet level requirement for role
- Export Control: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred qualifications

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Software Development Engineer II. You will build the backend-for-frontend layer, the service that sits directly behind the customer-facing surfaces and orchestrates over the many backend systems that make satellite internet work: ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support.

The job is to shape what the frontend needs, route and orchestrate requests across those systems, translate between them, and compose their responses into reliable operations the customer experience can depend on. The core of the work is integration: calling many APIs, handling partial failures gracefully, mapping between different service models, and keeping latency and reliability high across a lot of moving parts. Much of this is built zero-to-one and expanding into new countries, so you will move from ambiguous problems to working products. You will own the full development lifecycle and work closely with frontend, product, and partner service teams.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build backend gateway APIs in Java that route and orchestrate requests across many downstream services, from concept through deployment and operation.
- Integrate with ordering, payments, billing, equipment and network provisioning, and support services: calling their APIs, translating between their models, and composing their responses.
- Handle the realities of a distributed system: partial failures, retries, timeouts, error translation, and keeping latency and reliability high across many dependencies.
- Work with product managers, frontend engineers, and partner service teams, and help the platform expand into new countries.
- Use agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to deliver faster, and improve the system with AWS native services.
- Review code, give feedback, and coach teammates on service integration patterns and well-tested code.
- Document your team's software and train new team members on how it is built, tested, and operated.

About the team
We build the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base at Amazon Leo. Our team owns the backend-for-frontend layer: the single API the customer-facing app talks to, and the orchestration behind it that connects to the systems provisioning and running satellite internet. We work hand in hand with the frontend team, shaping our APIs around what their experiences need. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 5+ years of programming using a modern programming language such as Java, C++, or C#, including object-oriented design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience testing back end services

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- 5+ years of contributing to new and current systems architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) experience
- Experience with test-driven development
- Experience with dependency injection, API modeling, and clean layering (separating API endpoints, business-logic orchestration, and downstream service clients)
- Experience building API gateway, orchestration, or backend-for-frontend services that integrate many downstream dependencies

descriptionHtml:

You will be the senior-most engineering leader for the team in São Paulo. You'll lead a team of Software Development Engineers that designs, builds and runs the systems behind Amazon's own lending offerings. These systems cover customer onboarding, credit decisioning, loan servicing, repayments, and integration with local partners and regulators.

This role sits where technology, financial products and regulation meet, in two of Latin America's largest and fastest-growing markets. You will work closely with Product, Risk, Finance, Legal and Compliance in Brazil and Mexico, and with engineering teams in India. Together you'll launch new products, grow into new markets and raise the technical bar for lending at Amazon.

Key job responsibilities
Lead and grow the team: Hire, manage, coach and develop a team of SDEs in São Paulo. Set a high bar for engineering quality, operational excellence and Amazon's Leadership Principles.

On a given day you might:

Sync with your counterparts in India on a shared launch.
Work with Risk and Legal on new regulatory requirements in Brazil or Mexico.

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. As a Workplace Health & Safety Specialist (WHSS), you'll be at the forefront of transforming workplace safety culture at one of the world's most innovative companies. Your expertise and dedication will directly protect employees, ensuring they return home safely to their families every day. You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. This isn't just about maintaining safety standards – it's about revolutionizing how we think about and implement workplace safety, making a lasting impact on our people and operations. As your building's designated safety champion, you'll have the unique opportunity to build relationships, influence positive change, and help write the next chapter in Amazon's commitment to becoming Earth's Safest Place to Work.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Program Excellence & Implementation - Drive comprehensive safety programs through data-driven strategies. Lead daily safety audits, incident investigations, and risk assessments while implementing innovative solutions to prevent injuries. Deliver engaging safety training that resonates with associates and promotes a proactive safety culture. Champion continuous improvement initiatives that enhance workplace safety while maintaining operational efficiency.

Associate Advocacy & Cultural Leadership - Serve as a trusted safety advisor and advocate for associate wellbeing, building strong partnerships across all levels of the organization. Foster a culture where safety is everyone's priority through effective communication, coaching, and positive reinforcement. Develop strong relationships with frontline associates and leadership to drive behavioral changes and ensure safety best practices become natural habits. Transform safety data into compelling narratives that influence positive change and drive engagement in safety initiatives.

Additional Job Elements include:

Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
Work in an environment where the noise level varies

Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)
Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site

Must be available to work flexible shifts including days, nights and/or weekends.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

- High school or equivalent
- A minimum of 1 year in an Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) related field OR; A Bachelor’s degree in EHS-relevant background OR; 6 months experience performing in a safety-related role within Amazon

- Experience using Microsoft Word and Excel in a professional capacity
- Experience maintaining confidentiality in matter involving security and/or personnel issues in the workplace

Preferred qualifications

- Experience leading and managing a team, ability to analyze accident data, new processes, and machinery for potential safety concerns, and conduct job hazard and job safety analyses

title: Principal Product Manager, Technical, Ads , APM
descriptionHtml:
Omni-channel advertising is reshaping how advertisers achieve their marketing objectives on Amazon and beyond. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded leader of a product, engineering, science, and business development team charged with bringing Amazon's omni-channel advertising vision to life. You and your team will work across partner teams — including the Amazon Demand-Side Platform (DSP), Supply-Side Platform (SSP), and go-to-market organizations — to define the product strategy, build the technology, and drive advertiser adoption. You will design advertiser-facing workflows powered by generative AI, partner with teams building creative transformation technology that converts a single advertiser asset into display, audio, and video formats, and identify and resolve gaps in ad-serving and bidding logic that limit omni-channel performance. If you are a technically curious product leader who thrives on turning ambiguous, high-impact opportunities into concrete results, we would love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the 3–5 year product vision and strategic roadmap for omni-channel advertising, translating broad market opportunity into a sequenced plan of deliverables with clear trade-offs and measurable outcomes.
- Lead end-to-end product development across engineering, science, design, and business development teams, deconstructing complex technical challenges into straightforward solutions and driving alignment across multiple organizations.
- Define and coordinate experimentation strategies — including multi-phase testing programs — to validate hypotheses around ad-serving optimization, creative transformation, and advertiser adoption, using data and metrics to inform investment decisions.
- Partner as a technical peer with engineering and applied science teams to evaluate architecture proposals for extensibility, scalability, and performance, ensuring today's decisions do not constrain tomorrow's strategic options.
- Drive strategic communications through written narratives, business reviews, and executive forums, influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to secure resources and align priorities.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin with a deep-dive into experiment results from a new ad-format test, deciding whether the signal warrants scaling or pivoting. By mid-morning you are in an architecture review with engineering, weighing trade-offs in real-time bidding logic. After lunch you lead a cross-team alignment session to resolve a prioritization conflict between your roadmap and a partner team's deliverables. Later you draft a vision document for a whitespace opportunity you have been researching, pulling together advertiser feedback, usage data, and competitive signals. You close the day by reviewing a generative AI prototype your team built to streamline creative workflows, pressure-testing the output quality before greenlighting the next sprint.

About the team
Our team sits within Amazon Ads and is focused on making omni-channel advertising simple and effective for advertisers of every size. We build the products and technology that let advertisers reach customers across display, audio, and video through a unified experience. The team is a collaborative mix of product managers, software engineers, applied scientists, and business development professionals who work closely with partner teams across the DSP, SSP, and sales organizations. We are investing in generative AI, creative automation, and advanced bidding systems — and this role will be at the center of shaping what comes next.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 7+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with and deep understanding of advertising technologies (i.e., ad server, DSP)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements
- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a Manager, WHS Program Management to be part of a team delivering WHS programs across the EU network. In this role you are part of a team of program managers, own a portfolio of programs they deliver, and ensure safety initiatives are executed consistently and to measurable results. You turn the team's capability into reliable, network-wide safety outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
Own a portfolio of WHS programs the team delivers across the region. Ensure safety programs are executed consistently and deliver measurable results. Work on the team's portfolio, prioritisation and stakeholder relationships with operations and engineering. Use data and metrics to improve team performance, drive improvements, and present portfolio results and risk to senior leadership.

A day in the life
You are part of a team responsible for the WHS program portfolio across the region. Your day mixes developing your people — prioritising their portfolio, removing blockers — with steering the programs they own end-to-end. You review the team's highest-impact initiatives, make the call on the toughest trade-offs, and represent the program portfolio to operations, engineering and senior WHS leaders. You balance delivering today's programs with building your team's capability for what's ahead.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF).
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (C1), both written and verbal.
- Relevant experience directly managing and developing a team.
- Track record of owning a portfolio of WHS or safety programs across multiple sites or a region.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.
- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Membership of a professional body in the field of occupational health and safety.
- Experience using data and metrics (including advanced Excel and SQL) to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification.

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

title: Risk Manager, NA Launch, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Global Environmental Assurance and Protection team works to make Amazon the global benchmark for environmental excellence across our operations. As the NA Launch Program Manager, you own the lifecycle of Amazon's most complex environmental launch and emergency response programs across North America and turn an ambiguous, fast-moving regulatory landscape into program frameworks the field can execute. That scope covers environmental permitting and regulatory readiness for new site launches, emergency and spill response planning, incident management and contingency programs, and emerging launch and response regulatory obligations across the region. You take partially defined business problems and regulatory requirements and build them into structured programs with clear objectives, milestones, and success criteria, owning each program through its pilot and scaled rollout.

As an individual contributor, you own the strategic definition and lifecycle management of these launch and emergency response programs. You break ambiguous challenges into program plans that account for real field constraints, define what "done" looks like, and design the systems, processes, and tools, with measurement built in, that the field organization adopts and sustains on its own. You partner with legal, regulatory affairs, operations, technology, design and construction, due diligence, and procurement to keep programs aligned with the operating model, and you contribute to internal operations planning while owning goals within the NA launch and emergency response program portfolio.

You identify and influence cross-functional investments that solve long-term launch readiness and emergency response requirements, negotiating resources, priorities, and timelines across organizations. You build business cases with quantified risk and return, present them to director and vice-president audiences, and represent EAP in cross-functional planning forums so that launch and emergency response requirements are built into business decisions. You own the program governance, business reviews, escalation paths, and metric dashboards that surface risk and drive accountability in real time, and you stand in for the senior manager independently in business reviews and cross-functional forums with full ownership.

This role requires independent judgment, a high tolerance for ambiguity, and the ability to find a path forward where solutions are not predefined, driving cross-functional alignment without pushing decisions upward. You communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to executive, operational, and legal audiences, and you use data and business intelligence to look around corners, spotting and mitigating risk before it surfaces. If you are motivated by solving complex regulatory problems at scale and building the compliance infrastructure to match, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Translate the compliance vision into functional programs. Integrate them into annual and multi-year planning and shape the budgets that fund them, weighing near-term compliance needs against long-term infrastructure investment.
- Work independently in an ambiguous, high-stakes regulatory environment, finding paths forward where no solution is predefined and driving alignment without pushing decisions upward.
- Own compliance programs end to end, taking problem definitions through pilot to full rollout, and build the resulting standards into daily operations so field teams sustain them on their own.
- Build the metrics and review system that holds the program accountable, covering KPIs, business reviews, escalation paths, and dashboards that give leaders real-time visibility into performance, milestones, and regulatory standing.
- Report program status, risks, and escalations clearly to director and vice-president audiences across operations, legal, finance, and technology, and stand in for the senior manager in business reviews and cross-functional forums.
- Oversee third-party contractors, consultants, and inspection vendors, holding them to program milestones and quality standards through structured audits.
- Travel up to 25 to 50% of the time.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
- 5+ years of program or project Management experience
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in environmental compliance and permitting, waste management, contractual, regulatory, and liability assessments, environmental permit evaluations and applications, EIAs and water discharge requirements
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Master's degree in environmental engineering, environmental science, environmental management, or a related field
- Professional credential where applicable, for example a Professional Engineer (PE), a Qualified Environmental Professional (QEP), a Certified Hazardous Materials Manager (CHMM), a Certified Energy Manager (CEM), or an equivalent professional environmental certification
- Experience with ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 management system design, implementation, or certification

title: Risk Specialist I, EAP
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Worldwide Environmental Assurance and Protection (EAP) team is responsible for ensuring that Amazon's global operation is the benchmark for environmental excellence across all similar industries. EAP transforms environmental regulatory compliance into a zero-defect process through simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions that protect the business, our communities, and the environment.

The Risk Specialist I drives regulated waste compliance across the 2-4 sites they support. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. They conduct site inspections, maintain hazardous waste accumulation and manifesting records, and surface gaps through regular program controls.

The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

This role requires sound independent judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to run the right mechanisms and manage competing priorities to meet compliance objectives in a dynamic, high-pace operations environment. If you are motivated by solving regulatory compliance problems in the field, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the execution and delivery of regulated waste compliance projects and activities, including developing standard operating procedures, workflows, and inspection routines, to mitigate identified risks across the sites you support.
- Apply risk management methods such as waste compliance audits and site inspections to monitor compliance thresholds, test controls, and take corrective action when findings arise.
- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.
- Identify process improvement opportunities and work with process owners to improve conformance, reduce risk, and increase operational efficiency.
- Prepare clear and concise documentation, including status reports, audit results, metrics, and project communications, so the right information reaches the right audience at the right time.
- Travel expected up to 50% of the time.

A day in the life
Your morning might begin by reviewing incoming risk-related requests and prioritizing your project tasks. You will spend time conducting audits or risk assessments, updating documentation, and coordinating with compliance operations and partner teams. Throughout the day, you will track project milestones, resolve roadblocks, and communicate progress to stakeholders. You will also look for ways to streamline existing processes and ensure your risk area stays aligned with current regulations and team objectives.

About the team
Our team is dedicated to protecting Amazon's customers and business by proactively managing risk across a broad range of areas, from regulatory compliance to operational resilience. We work closely with legal, operations, and business partners to deliver practical risk solutions and build a strong culture of compliance. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and creative problem-solving, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can grow and make an impact.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field
- 2+ years of experience in environmental compliance, regulated waste management, or workplace risk investigations
- Experience interpreting and applying environmental regulations (RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules)
- Experience collecting and analyzing data to identify compliance gaps and drive corrective actions

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- 4+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
- Experience managing a regulated waste program across multiple sites, including hazardous waste accumulation, manifesting, and disposal
- Hazardous waste certification such as RCRA or DOT (49 CFR) training, or 40-hour HAZWOPER
- Experience conducting site audits or inspections and tracking findings to closure
- Master's degree in Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) or related field

title: Staff Pharmacist , Amazon Pharmacy
descriptionHtml:
Innovation is at the core of what we do. We believe that by removing and reducing the barriers that
prevent people from taking their medications, we can help customers conveniently get the
medications they need, when they need them and take them as prescribed. We have provided
customers with the ability to find transparent and simple pricing, receive 24/7 customer service
support, and have their meds delivered to their doorsteps while creating programs and products
that embody our mission and position ourselves in becoming the world’s safest and fastest online
pharmacy.

We are looking for a Staff Pharmacist to join us on our journey to make it drastically easier for
customers to find, choose, afford, and engage with the services, products, and professionals they
need to get and stay healthy!


#everydaybetter


Key job responsibilities
• Perform clinical data review, prescription verification, and virtual patient consultations in
compliance with state and federal regulations
• Manage end-to-end prescription fulfillment process, including dispensing medications
using automated systems (Parata Max2) and manual fill
• Package and prepare prescriptions for shipment or site injection, including handling of
specialized medications (refrigerated and bulk items)
• Maintain strict quality standards and safety protocols while meeting Critical Pull Times
(CPT) and production targets
• Split time effectively between prescription verification and fulfillment duties based on
operational needs and customer centric volume
• Perform thorough DUR (Drug Utilization Review) and ensure accurate documentation in
pharmacy systems
• Monitor, receive, and manage pharmacy inventory effectively and compliantly
• Work collaboratively with pharmacy technicians and other pharmacists to maintain
efficient workflow
• Demonstrate strong attention to detail and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced
environment
• Support operational excellence initiatives and continuous improvement efforts
• Identify and report quality or safety concerns promptly while maintaining compliance with
all regulatory requirements
• Complete daily operational tasks including processing returns, medication rejects,
therapeutic substitutions, and canister approvals

Physical Requirements:
During Peak/high demand, shifts last up to 12 hours (standard full-time shifts are 8-10 hours)
• Standing, bending, reaching above the head, kneeling, crouching and/or stretching
• Lifting and moving products up to 49 lbs in weight
• Manual dexterity of hands and wrists
• Walking throughout the Amazon building for various reasons such as injections and inventory receive

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Science, or Doctor of Pharmacy in PharmD, or Doctor of Pharmacy
- Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal/state regulations concerning patient care
- Can demonstrate proficiency with basic computer functions and pharmacy systems
- Can have an active and unrestricted pharmacist license in your state of employment (additional licenses may be required)

Preferred qualifications

- Exemplary interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
- Demonstrated ability to work as an effective team member
- Demonstrated organization skills and attention to detail
- Experience working under pressure in a fast-paced work environment while consistently meeting standards for productivity and quality
