title: Capacity Intelligence Analyst, Network Strategy & Performance
descriptionHtml:
As a Capacity Intelligence Analyst within the Network Strategy & Performance team, you will support and execute labor planning for Amazon's Customer Service network, including outsourced (Global Outsourcing) sites. You will work at the intersection of data and operations — translating demand signals into accurate staffing plans that protect customer experience while contributing to cost efficiency.

You will operate independently within your workstream, navigating ambiguity with analytical rigor and sound judgment. You will build effective working relationships with CS Operations, Global Outsourcing (GO) Vendor Management, CS Finance, Service Delivery, and Planning Intelligence teams. You will present your analysis and recommendations independently to senior stakeholders, contribute to planning decisions through well-reasoned, data-backed arguments, and actively participate in the team's AI-driven transformation agenda.

This role participates in weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews and contributes directly to outsourcing and staffing decisions across the CS network.

Key job responsibilities
- Support the development, maintenance, and execution of labor capacity plans for internal and outsourced sites, covering short-term (4-week), operational (monthly/quarterly), and long-term (3-year) planning horizons. Build toward full ownership of assigned planning workstreams.
- Proactively identify and flag capacity risks by mapping dependencies across internal sites and Global Outsourcing vendor partners. Communicate risks and proposed mitigation plans to stakeholders with clarity and specificity. Coordinate with CS Operations and GO Vendor Management teams to ensure staffing plans are aligned with service level targets and outsourcing strategy.
- Support quarterly submissions to CS Finance, contributing to accurate Year-to-Go (YTG) labor cost projections and revisions versus OP targets.
- Independently apply AI tools (e.g., AgentZ, Kiro) to improve planning workflows without prompting, identifying opportunities to increase the speed, quality, and scale of your planning outputs. Develop side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your planning workstream, and contribute concrete use cases to the team's AI adoption agenda.
- Develop structured frameworks to address recurring planning problems within your scope, reducing rework and improving the consistency of planning outputs over time.
- Present analysis and planning recommendations to senior stakeholder audiences independently, adapting your communication style for technical and non-technical, operational and strategic stakeholders. Write clear, concise, and compelling narratives for QBRs, MBRs, and planning reviews. Documents must meet Amazon's standard formatting guidelines, with conclusions that tie to the organization's working-backwards framework.
- Communicate planning analysis in a way that is accessible to senior, non-expert audiences, anticipating likely objections to your recommendations and addressing them proactively.

Core Competencies
- AI Fluency: Independently applies AI tools to improve planning workflows without prompting. Develops side-of-desk automation for repetitive tasks within your own workstream. Coaches at least one peer on AI tool usage. Contributes to the team's AI adoption agenda with concrete use cases demonstrating measurable productivity improvement.
- Critical Thinking: Independently diagnoses complex planning problems. Challenges assumptions — including your own — with data. Develops structured frameworks to address recurring problems within your scope. Anticipates the most likely objections to a recommendation and addresses them proactively.
- Executive Presence: Presents analysis and recommendations to senior audiences independently. Adapts communication style for different stakeholders — technical and non-technical, operational and strategic. Handles pushback constructively without becoming defensive or capitulating without reason.
- Problem Solving: Navigates ambiguous problems with limited guidance. Develops multiple solution options with explicit trade-off analysis. Drives problems to resolution end-to-end — does not hand off and forget. Learns from misses and applies those learnings to the next problem.
- Boundaryless: Builds effective working relationships with key partner teams — Service Delivery, CS Finance, and GO Vendor Management. Proactively identifies and resolves cross-team dependencies before they become blockers. Represents Network Strategy & Performance in partner forums with credibility.


About the team
The Network Strategy & Performance (NSP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support.

We analyze historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers.

The Network Strategy & Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking an experienced Capacity Intelligence Analyst to join this team and contribute to how Amazon plans, staffs, and optimizes its Customer Service network.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience with Excel
- Experience with SQL
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in a quantitative field or Business Administration.
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
- Experience building automation solutions using Python, R, or similar tools, or demonstrated experience with standard ERP or open-source planning tools.
- Experience presenting analytical recommendations to manager or director-level audiences.

title: Senior Seller Consultant, EU Targeted Recruitment team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a smart and ambitious Seller Consultant to join its China team. The objective of the Sales consultant is to deliver new business growth and maximize revenue generation across Amazon's suite of products for merchants. Recruiting and launching sellers on Amazon's global marketplaces. You will analyze traffic and sales data to identify opportunities to help sellers succeed on the marketplaces.
Your superior communication, organizational and technical skills will enable you to operate in a fast-moving and sometimes ambiguous environment, where you will have the autonomy to take full control and responsibility for achieving our business objectives.
Specific Responsibilities include:

Develop a category recruitment strategy by analyzing the competitive landscape and defining new products' value proposition.
Identify, recruit and support sellers of various types (SMEs to large retailers) to execute on growth plans.
Review and monitor performance and sales of Amazon's partners in order to provide them with consulting advice to grow their business.
Feed back to other teams within Amazon worldwide lessons learned during project implementation and post-live support phases.
Coordinate and lead project with cross function teams and deliver result with stakeholders



Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
Senior Seller Consultant (EU)

1. Sales Execution & Seller Conversion

Receive qualified leads and drive end-to-end sales conversion. Identify key decision-makers within target companies, deliver tailored pitches based on category and seller profile, build trusted relationships with stakeholders across multiple business functions, and convert high-quality brand owners to launch and sell on the platform.

2. New Seller Onboarding & Activation

Guide newly launched sellers through their critical first 90 days on the platform. Help sellers optimize their product listings, build compelling content, generate early customer reviews, activate advertising and run promotional campaigns to build initial sales momentum and establish a strong market entry.

3. Seller Growth & Brand Development

Conduct regular business reviews with sellers to understand their performance, identify growth opportunities and recommend actionable next steps. Help sellers strengthen their brand presence on the platform, improve product visibility and adopt advanced marketing and branding tools aligned with their business goals and growth stage.

4. Category Knowledge & Market Insight

Develop strong knowledge of relevant product categories to deliver informed and credible seller conversations. Stay current on category trends, competitive landscape and seasonal dynamics. Share learnings with the broader team and contribute to building reusable category knowledge and best practices.

5. Relationship Management & Account Growth

Build and maintain long-term relationships with a portfolio of brand owners throughout their lifecycle on the platform. Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor, coordinating engagement across procurement, e-commerce, marketing and executive contacts within the seller's organization. Drive seller satisfaction and long-term retention.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3+ years of sales or marketing work (like e-commerce, retail technology, SaaS) or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of inside sales experience
- Knowledge of procurement and source to pay methods at small and medium businesses
- Experience influencing at all levels within an organization, particularly at the executive level
- Experience exceeding sales targets using a consultative, solutions-focused approach or equivalent

title: Junior Verification Engineer

title: Process Assistant, RSR+
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Amazon Process Assistant (Full-time)

Since opening our virtual doors in 1995, we’ve been pushing the boundaries of ‘possible’ further and further. Our entire business works hard to delight our customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, fluid and intentional. That can be described in one of our core Leadership Principles, which is Bias for Action. This means that our teams band together, roll up their sleeves, and aren’t content with just standing still. We’re aiming to become the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is an exciting organization within Amazon dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces.

Process Assistants are part of the Last Mile operations in RSR and play a crucial role in this rapidly growing team. Process Assistants are responsible for daily management of department duties including: allocating labor, leading meetings, assigning job duties, providing work direction and communicating with internal and external suppliers.

Responsibilities:
• Track and report ATS/labor hours
• Occasionally assist with production duties, train associates and verify SOP (standard operating procedure) compliance
• Ensure successful area performance through tracking and reporting metrics
• Independently assess all aspects of associate work performance and provide timely and detailed feedback
• Participate in Operational Excellence initiatives
• Maintain a full understanding of workflow and daily production goals
• Review and update SOP’s as required
• Ensure work areas remain clean and are properly equipped
• Identify and address safety hazards within the work area, and participate in safety initiatives
• Coach associates on ways to work safely at all times
• Ensure all job injuries are reported timely in accordance with established policies and procedures
• Provide vacation coverage for Area Managers

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent

descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

You will work closely with Amazon LEO's various sub-teams and engage third party suppliers to drive product definition, design, optimization, implementation, and test. Amazon strongly believes in Ownership and you will have the opportunity to own your designs from concept through production. You will own or contribute to the following:

- Complete board bring-up and perform test campaigns for different modules and subsystems
- Support the transition of the designs to production with the contract manufacturer

The Gateway team is responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, validation, qualification, and new product introduction to manufacturing for all satellite and ground gateway assemblies. These systems will meet performance requirements defined by the RF/modem team as well as environmental and reliability requirements defined by the mechanical team. To this end, the gateway team collaborates closely with all the partner teams including silicon, power, mechanical, thermal, modem, RF/Coms system, and SW teams.

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
- 5+ years of hardware engineering experience
- 3+ years of experience in using schematic tool (Mentor Graphics Xpedition, Cadence OrCad, or Altium Designer)

title: Sr. Associate - Quality Analyst, Global Solutions & Risk Compliance (GSRC)
descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities
Your job responsibilities as a Sr. Compliance Associate-Quality Analyst may include:
• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.
• Identifies anomalies through audits (SOP defects, Process gaps etc.).
• Uses knowledge and identifies defect/s & preliminary root causes, explains the rationale
• Proposes solutions on quality/productivity and work on milestones with managers
• Expertise in research – finding specific information (eg: products, regulations etc) in a timely manner.
• Prepares key insight trends and share reports on regular basis.
• Provide feedbacks to the associates and close loop on audit observations.
• Respond to stakeholders with guidance and flags any updates to Lead/Manager

About the team
Amazon is an E-commerce and Cloud Computing company with headquarters in Seattle, Washington. Since 1995, Amazon has focused on being “the world’s most customer centric company.” Our customers are worldwide, and include not just consumers, but also our sellers and vendors (selling partners). World-class retail brands and individual sellers increase their sales and reach new customers by leveraging the power of the Amazon e-commerce platform. To meet our selling partners’ needs, our smart, diverse, customer-obsessed employees are constantly innovating and building on new ideas.
The Operational Risk Compliance (ORC) organization exists to keep our customers and partners safe, protect associates, and ensure legal and regulatory compliance. We coordinate the aspects of product transactions that are regulated (distribution, shipping, sale, and import/export). Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) is the operational arm of the ORC organization. This involves analyzing product import documentation and flagging hazardous risks. We are also responsible for keeping Amazon customers safe and informed by coordinating actions around worldwide program teams to classify products and ensure Amazon’s product listings follow regulatory and legal compliance guidelines. These actions include removing products from the site and from our warehouses, and contacting customers with pertinent sustainability information. The ORC team partners with GSRC supports regulatory compliance requirements for Amazon’s worldwide programs such as Dangerous Goods, Chemical Safety Compliance, Global Trade Services, Transport Risk Compliance, Sustainability, Extended Producer Responsibility and Food Safety. GSRC has offices across India, China, Poland, Romania, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica and supports compliance related needs for worldwide Amazon marketplaces.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
- 2+ year work experience in Business Process Outsourcing in any of the following domains: accounting, regulatory compliance, IT services, quality assurance
- Business Process Outsourcing, Operations processes; Database management is an added advantage

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in trade compliance, import/export operations, customs regulations, cross-border logistics, or regulatory compliance processes related to global trade operations is preferred
- Knowledge of consumer product compliance processes and regulations
- Experience in regulatory compliance management with government agencies
- Experience as a quality auditor in retail chain management / FMCG company / Corporate role
- Experience in designing and implementing custom reporting systems using automation tools
- Experience with data analysis in a variety of quantitative fields and experience building data and decision support systems
- Knowledge of database query technologies (SQL)

descriptionHtml:

The Propulsion team is seeking a Manufacturing Functional Technician to join the team to support production manufacturing of future flight hardware.
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will work within the Amazon Leo Propulsion Manufacturing Team supporting the build and integration of electric propulsion subsystems, including feed systems, thrusters, cathodes, PCBAs, tanks, and the integrated propulsion system.
This technician will be knowledgeable across multiple manufacturing process paths, perform troubleshooting activities, support training programs, and lead process improvement initiatives within their scope. The ideal candidate brings hands-on manufacturing experience with flight hardware and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Perform manufacturing, assembly, and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems per engineering documentation and SOPs
• Troubleshoot manufacturing issues — observing, receiving, and obtaining information from all relevant sources to assist in debug and root cause analysis
• Perform inspections with an understanding of what is critical to quality
• Provide mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers with feedback including tooling, consumables, debug, and process observations
• Perform tasks including assembling first article builds, hardware inspections, and documenting discrepancies
• May own or maintain internal team SOPs, documenting improvements and process changes
• Help Identify training needs for the team and support training programs within the department
• Assist in the development of new hires and peers across the department
• Support process improvement initiatives applicable to your project scope
• Demonstrate and may create best practices for manufacturing processes
• Role model site safety standards and operations protocol
• Successfully meet productivity and quality standards
• Attempt to resolve team work blockers and general team needs
• Utilize MES and SAP systems for production tracking, traceability, and work order documentation
• Attend all relevant technical trainings offered by the organization

A day in the life
The Propulsion Manufacturing Functional Technician will perform a variety of hardware manufacturing and integration tasks across propulsion subsystems to ensure hardware meets production requirements for flight. They will work closely with engineering teams to provide feedback on processes and identify improvements.
This technician is expected to be knowledgeable across multiple process paths, support peers and new hires, and lead process improvements within their scope. They will utilize MES and SAP systems for daily production tracking and traceability and will actively support the team in resolving work blockers and general operational needs.
A successful candidate thrives in a fast-paced, start-up-like environment and can apply their technical expertise and commitment to quality to positively impact team metrics and organization goals. To be successful they will need to be highly motivated and detail oriented while showing the highest standards of execution.

About the team
The Amazon Leo Propulsion Team is responsible for the design and development of the propulsion system which provides maneuvering capability to the spacecraft. The Propulsion Team is made up of a variety of sub-teams which are responsible for various aspects of the development process, such as mechanical design, systems engineering, subject matter experts, manufacturing, and test. This integrated team structure allows direct communication and rapid process feedback while also promoting close collaboration across the team.

- 2+ years relevant aerospace/automotive manufacturing experience or equivalent industry experience
- 2+ years of hands-on work experience with electro-mechanical assemblies, final integration and/or harness integration experience
- 2+ year’s experience in a fast-paced production environment with flight hardware
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with precision torque, measurement and inspection devices (i.e., automated and manual torque wrenches, calipers, micrometers, profilometers, optical inspection devices, multi-meters, etc.)
- Proficiency in reading, interpreting, and working from engineering documentation and/or drawings
- Ability to work effectively in a team environment

- Aircraft & Powerplant certification/license, automotive certifications, or other technical certifications/Associate's degree
- Experience working with FOD, ESD sensitive hardware and clean room requirements
- Experience working with MES software packages (SAP, SFC transactions, traceability)

title: Lead, Regulatory Affairs, AMER, Amazon Leo Regulatory
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. This is a unique opportunity to work in the development of a global broadband satellite communication system and make a difference in bridging the digital divide.

The Lead, Regulatory Affairs, Americas (AMER) supports the development and execution of regulatory strategies aligned with business and service availability priorities, and identifies potential regulatory risks that may impact Amazon Leo’s ability to deploy services throughout the region. This role is primarily focused on South America, with potential engagement across the broader Americas as needed. The candidate will work on strategies and mechanisms to mitigate those risks, and engage and maintain liaison with national and regional telecommunications organizations. The Lead, Regulatory Affairs, AMER will contribute to shaping regulations affecting non-geostationary satellite orbit (NGSO) systems, telecommunications service providers, the access to and use of Ka-band band and other frequencies for satellite services, including emerging direct-to-device (D2D) spectrum bands, and other relevant regulations, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. The ideal candidate will be responsible for educating regulators on satellite and spectrum regulations, telecommunications services, and other issues involved with deploying and maintaining a global satellite broadband service. The ideal candidate will have experience shaping regulatory frameworks for satellite communications systems -- to include space stations, earth stations/gateway stations, customer/user equipment, spectrum, the provision of services (wholesale and retail models), and the regulatory obligations applicable to satellite operators and telecommunications service providers, be familiar with regulatory agencies in the AMER, and be able to assess and, if necessary, recommend improvements to regulatory frameworks in order to optimize Amazon Leo service to customers. The Lead, Regulatory Affairs, AMER will engage cross-functionally with Public Policy, Legal, Business, Public Relations, Engineering and Operations professionals, and collaborate closely with Amazon Leo Regulatory team members supporting Global Licensing, Engineering, Global Service Compliance, Technical Program Management, and Law Enforcement Response and Intercept.

This position may require access to information, technology, or hardware that is subject to export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) and the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). Employment in this position is contingent upon obtaining any required export licenses or other approvals from the United States government. As such, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain any necessary export licenses or approvals based on their nationality, citizenship, and any other factors considered by the applicable export control regulations.

Key job responsibilities
• Contribute to shaping national and regional regulations affecting NGSO communications systems, telecommunications service providers, the access to and use of Ka-band band and other frequencies for satellite services, and other relevant regulations, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
• Identify potential regulatory risks that may impact Amazon Leo’s ability to deploy services, and propose strategies to mitigate those risks.
• Support alignment with Amazon Leo business, technical, and customer objectives to execute on regulatory strategies in countries throughout AMER and enable Amazon Leo services.
• Engage with national and regional telecommunications organizations, while maintaining liaison with regulators, relevant industry actors, and trade associations in the region.


A day in the life
In this role, you will contribute to shaping national and regional regulations affecting NGSO systems, telecommunications service providers, the access to and use of Ka-band band and other frequencies for satellite services, and other relevant regulations, in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. You will support efforts to enable and protect Amazon Leo’s use of radio frequency spectrum and authorization to provide telecommunications services at home and abroad, helping to define and advance the regulatory agenda to allow Amazon Leo service. You will collaborate with trade associations, government agencies, multilateral organizations, and other operators to shape rules and regulations in the best interest of our customers, and work in close collaboration with Amazon Leo business, technical and operations teams to optimize for customer experience, as well as with Amazon’s Public Policy, Public Relations, and Legal teams to enhance the overall regulatory strategy in priority countries. You will work closely with other regulatory country and domain leads and other Amazon Leo teams to ensure alignment on a country and regional basis, anticipating bottlenecks, and communicating risks clearly to leaders. You will take initiative to drive decisions within your scope, escalate effectively, remove blockers, and will deliver results across the AMER region.

You will report to the Senior Lead, Global Regulatory Affairs for Amazon Leo and work in close collaboration with other team members within the Regulatory team and across Amazon Leo to ensure timely service delivery at scale.


About the team
The Regulatory team enables and protects Amazon Leo’s use of radio frequency spectrum and satellite orbits worldwide, defining and leading the Amazon Leo regulatory agenda to benefit our customers. We operate globally, engaging with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU), regional/sub-regional organizations, regulatory authorities, and governments. We obtain the required ITU filings and licenses for Amazon Leo operations, coordinate spectrum use with satellite and terrestrial operators, and shape/promote space safety and sustainability. We advocate for rules and regulations in the best interest of our customers at the national, regional, and ITU treaty level, working with governments, trade associations, and operators. We work with the design, operational, and business teams to promote alignment between business objectives, the Amazon Leo Program of Record, and regulatory requirements and delivery. We partner with the Legal, Public Policy and Public Relations teams to execute the regulatory strategy.

Basic qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 5+ years of regulatory frameworks and policy analysis methodologies experience
- Bachelor's degree in relevant discipline (e.g., telecommunications, international relations, or engineering)
- 5+ years of experience in shaping national, regional, and international regulations for the provision of communications services
- Experience with satellite and/or telecommunications networks, and familiarity with the regulatory obligations applicable to telecommunications service providers
- Demonstrated ability to manage complex regulatory issues and drive them to resolution
- Strong analytical, problem solving and communication skills

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in working directly with government officials and regulatory bodies
- Experience in ownership of projects and communicating timelines and executing independently
- Ability to interpret technical analysis, and assess impact on operations and business requirements.
- Knowledge of domestic regulatory frameworks applicable to satellite systems in countries throughout the region and experience in ITU regulations related to satellite communications systems
- Knowledge of the regulatory obligations applicable to telecommunications service providers across areas including but not limited to: network security and resilience, foreign ownership, universal service, law enforcement response and intercept, consumer protection, regulatory and spectrum fees, quality of service standards, revenue reporting, and other compliance and reporting requirements
- Proficiency in Spanish and Portuguese, with experience engaging regulators and stakeholders in those languages

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an experienced, highly technical, customer-focused Principal Product Manager – Technical to lead the development of high scale programmatic reporting solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in helping advertisers measure, analyze, and optimize their campaigns across Amazon Ads, and supporting high volume partners with that same mission. AI is changing how advertising is planned, analyzed and optimized, and the foundation of this opportunity is data. By delivering advertising reporting and actionable insights, our team empowers global advertisers to connect their campaign investments with real customer outcomes. By delivering that data programmatically through a thousand metrics and dimensions at high scale, we deliver the fundamental data powering AI agents, machine learning models, analytics engines and dashboards across the world. You will collaborate closely with engineering, solution architects, and go-to-market teams to build robust, programmatic data products. Your responsibilities will include working backward from the customer and their engineering teams to identify needs, analyzing data and dogfooding our own products while partnering with our teams to build high scale, consistent and low latency data delivery engines at industry leading scale.

Amazon is investing heavily in building a world class advertising business and we are at the forefront of that explosive growth. We are highly motivated and collaborative with an entrepreneurial spirit and agile bias for action. With a broad mandate to experiment and innovate, we are growing at an unprecedented rate with a seemingly endless range of new opportunities. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data at massive scale to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience while opening doors to GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations. As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. This specialist executes the organization's environmental compliance plans at the site level, tracks waste compliance obligations to closure, and partners with site and operations teams to meet compliance milestones. The ideal candidate brings working knowledge of regulated waste requirements, including RCRA, DOT, and applicable state hazardous waste rules. They communicate technical compliance requirements clearly to site leaders, operations partners, and legal stakeholders, and use data to find gaps, prioritize fixes, and improve conformance across their sites.

- Collaborate with site teams, compliance operations, and operations partners to understand business needs, clarify waste compliance requirements, and drive productive discussions that build consensus.

title: Product Manager, NAS Ship Cost Optimization, NAS Ship Cost Optimization
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the Earth’s most customer-centric company. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. This Product managers will be responsible for driving optimization efforts across various organizations and processes to improve shipping costs at Amazon. This includes defining the right set of metrics and processes, establishing ambitious goals and driving towards them, working with technology and operations partners to design, develop and deploy intelligent processes and improvements.

The North American Stores (NAS) organization is focused on continuously optimizing its P&L to drive long-term profitability. One of the most significant levers? Outbound fulfillment costs. The NAS Ship Cost Optimization (SCO) team tackles this head-on—leveraging technology for scale and launching innovative products that optimize costs systematically and with measurable impact.

This team has delivered over $1 billion+ in cumulative bottom-line improvements over the past four years by reducing packaging waste, correcting dimensional defects, optimizing regional fulfillment, and building Gen-AI products that reimagine how Amazon collaborates with selling partners. In 2026, the team is targeting significant savings through initiatives spanning cube reduction, AI-powered vendor outreach, regionalization strategies, sortability defect reduction, and improved placement—against a total addressable opportunity of $1.5B+.

As a Sr Product Manager on this team, you will own products and initiatives that directly improve the profitability of one of Amazon's largest businesses. You will develop a deep understanding of the inputs driving ship costs—placement, regional fulfillment, sortability, ship method choices, and dimensions—and translate that knowledge into products, policies, and partnerships that deliver hundreds of millions in savings. You will work across partner teams spanning Supply Chain Technology, Operations, Transportation, Finance, and Category Management, and you will leverage AI and automation to build the next generation of cost optimization products.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems, communicates with precision, and thrives at the intersection of data, product strategy, and cross-organizational influence.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and drive the end-to-end product roadmap for one or more SCO initiatives (e.g., Cube Reduction, CRISP Gen-AI service, regional fulfillment strategies, or Sortability Overrides), from opportunity sizing through execution and measurement.
- Develop deep subject matter expertise in the inputs that drive outbound ship costs—placement, regional fulfillment, sortability tier economics, dimensional accuracy, and ship method choices—to identify high-impact opportunities others miss.
- Build and scale AI-powered products such as CRISP (Cube Reduction, Improving Sizing and Product Design), a Gen-AI LLM service that delivers automated packaging and product redesign recommendations to 20,000+ selling partners.
- Influence and align cross-functional stakeholders across VP-level organizations including Supply Chain Technology (SCOT), Transportation, Fulfillment Tech, Finance, Category teams, and Retail Business Services (RBS) to secure resources, resolve dependencies, and drive shared goals.
- Design and run controlled experiments to validate hypotheses, which enable product feature decisions and deliver results at scale.
- Define success metrics and tracking mechanisms (e.g., monthly flash reporting, ASIN-level cost attribution, vendor response rates) that create transparency and accountability for initiatives targeting $200MM+ in annual savings.
- Partner with Science and Engineering teams to improve targeting methodologies (dynamic ship cost impact models, out-of-stock probability signals, ASIN similarity algorithms) and automate manual workflows.
- Represent the team in leadership forums, crafting data-driven narratives that communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs to senior leaders with clarity and confidence.

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing product metrics and triaging customer feedback to decide where to focus. Mid-morning, you are in a design review with your engineering and design partners, working through tradeoffs on a feature approaching launch. After lunch, you draft a working-backwards document for a new initiative, pulling in input from finance and marketing stakeholders. Later in the afternoon, you sit in on a customer research session to pressure-test assumptions before finalizing roadmap priorities. You close the day by updating your team on progress and aligning on next steps.

About the team
The NAS Ship Cost Optimization team is a small, high-impact product team that punches well above its weight. Over the past four years, the team has delivered $1B+ in cumulative bottom-line improvements to the Stores P&L by building innovative products—including the Gen-AI powered CRISP service—and championing cost-smart policies across the fulfillment network.

The team operates with strong leadership visibility at all levels, given the scale of results delivered and the innovative, AI-forward approach to problem solving. You will join a closely knit group that Thinks Big, earns trust through results, and works collaboratively across some of Amazon's most complex operational systems.

If you want to own products that move a multi-billion dollar P&L—and do it by combining analytical rigor, creative product thinking, technology-driven scale, and genuine cross-functional partnership—this is the team.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets
- Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
- Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in Logistics, Distribution or Fulfillment processes
- Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale
- Knowledge of product experimentation (A/B testing)
- Proficiency with tools such as Amazon QuickSuite, Kiro, or MCP (or equivalent BI and developer productivity tools).
- Experience working in a vendor- or seller-facing environment where external partner engagement is a core part of the product strategy.

title: Principal Product Manager, Driver Safety Technology, Global Road Safety Technology
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about using technology to save lives and prevent injuries? Do you want to lead the invention and construction of safety solutions that will protect hundreds of thousands of third-party drivers across Amazon's vast middle mile and delivery networks? Amazon is building disruptive safety technology products with the vision of creating the safest middle mile and last mile delivery operations in the world. We are studying the safety needs of line haul and delivery drivers and building innovative, market-leading solutions that will fundamentally transform how we protect drivers on the road every day.

You will be both an entrepreneur and an operator who will plan and scale safety technology across the driver network. You will define the driver safety experience, partner with Tech, Engineering, Operations, Safety, Legal, and Compliance teams to design solutions that make for safer on road operations. You will thrive in ambiguity, building and communicating a clear approach and ensuring that we are delivering strong safety outcomes with each technology deployment that impacts on road operations. You will be expected to regularly display the following abilities: 1) High ownership and accountability for driver safety outcomes with the ability to plan and deliver on critical safety goals 2) Ability to navigate ambiguity with flexibility and decisiveness while balancing safety improvements with operational priorities 3) Skills to work across diverse stakeholders teams to communicate, convince and deliver for the goal and 4) Ability to think big on a vision for transformative driver safety technology while being rooted in constant execution and measurable safety improvements.

This is a highly visible and inherently critical role with room to innovate and solve key road safety challenges at scale. Strong experience designing and launching impactful products in a complex and cross-functional environment is necessary.



Key job responsibilities
· Develop a thorough understanding of safety challenges facing middle mile truck drivers and last mile delivery drivers, including vehicle safety, road safety, route optimization for driver protection, fatigue management, and incident prevention while monitoring new developments in driver safety technology and the regulatory landscape.

· Define and own the driver safety product roadmap and strategy – develop the vision for implementing next-generation safety solutions including vehicle telematics, driver assistance systems, in-vehicle safety technology, predictive safety analytics, and real-time risk mitigation tools for drivers across all regions and operations.

· Write and present compelling business cases (backed by strong research and driver safety data analysis) for safety technology investments in partnership with all stakeholder teams

· Partner with Tech, Operations, Engineering, Safety, Compliance, and Legal teams to design customer backward safety experiences that protect drivers in Amazon's delivery network.

· Own end-to-end product development from requirements to launch – write business requirement specifications, monitor project execution, and ensure delivery is to the appropriate levels of quality and safety standards.

· Monitor and report on driver safety metrics and KPIs to senior leadership across Amazon, as related to the safety products being developed and deployed – track driver incident rates, near-miss events, safety technology adoption, and demonstrate measurable improvements in driver safety across middle mile and last mile operations.

· Drive adoption of safety features across the third-party driver network – ensure that safety solutions are effectively planned, implemented and utilized by drivers across thousands of line haul routes and delivery routes

· Ensure compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT), Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA), Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), and other regulatory requirements while staying ahead of evolving driver safety regulations

· Manage complex, multi-stakeholder programs with compressed timelines – be tenacious and find creative approaches to meet deadlines and delivery the product roadmap.

· Create clear, effective written communication to present decision points or data-based arguments that enable delivering on driver safety goals. Communicate to diverse audiences ranging from technical teams to senior leadership.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- 10+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner

Preferred qualifications

- Experience owning technology products

descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience

title: Data Engineer, Global Procurement Technology, Global Procurement Tech
descriptionHtml:
Data is at the heart of procurement. Do you want to make that data AI-ready — powering not just insight but autonomous decision-making and action at a global scale? As a Data Engineer on the Global Procurement Technology team, you will build the data foundation that drives AI transformation across Amazon's procurement organization. You will design and deliver data solutions end to end: creating supplier entity relationships, aggregating supplier data, enabling supplier performance and risk analysis, and providing supplier sourcing recommendations worldwide.

Your work will directly shape how procurement teams make decisions and how AI applications consume and act on trusted supplier data. You will partner with software engineers, scientists, business intelligence engineers, and business stakeholders to turn complex, multi-source datasets into reliable data products. If you enjoy solving ambiguous data problems and want your solutions to influence procurement strategy globally, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models that support procurement analytics, supplier mapping, and the trusted supplier data repository.
- Create logical and physical data models across large datasets from multiple internal and external sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
- Build self-service data infrastructure and curated datasets that let business intelligence engineers, scientists, and business teams access reliable data on their own.
- Collaborate with software engineers, scientists, and product and program managers to turn business requirements into well-documented, high-performing data solutions.
- Evaluate generative AI tooling for data workflows where appropriate, contributing to the team's broader AI transformation efforts.

A day in the life
Your morning is your focused time. You might spend it building new solutions, improving existing systems, solving operational issues, or pairing with a nearby EU colleague or stakeholder to work through a technical question. In the afternoon, the overlap with North America opens up and the pace shifts. This is when most team meetings, design reviews, and joint problem-solving with your NA counterparts happen. You will join sprint ceremonies with your agile squad, walk through designs with peers, and align with product and program managers on priorities. The rhythm gives you dedicated heads-down hours each day balanced with regular cross-timezone collaboration.

About the team
Global Procurement Technology sits within Global Procurement Operations and builds the data and technology products that power Amazon's procurement processes worldwide. Our key products include the supplier mapping framework, the trusted supplier data repository, and the supplier management system. The team is an agile group of data engineers, software engineers, scientists, and product and program managers, with Principal Engineers in the broader organization providing technical guidance. You will have the chance to build skills across engineering disciplines, and the team's collaborative setup means you can grow by contributing to software, data, and AI work alike.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a data engineer or related specialty (e.g., software engineer, business intelligence engineer, data scientist) with a track record of manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large datasets
- Experience working on and delivering end to end projects independently
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
- Experience with SQL
- Experience with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Knowledge of professional software engineering & best practices for full software development life cycle, including coding standards, software architectures, code reviews, source control management, continuous deployments, testing, and operational excellence

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
- Experience building/operating highly available, distributed systems of data extraction, ingestion, and processing of large data sets
- Experience with big data technologies such as: Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR

The engineer will focus on backend processes to support both production and R&D activities. The position is on-site at our lab, located on the in Pasadena, CA. The ideal candidate will have had prior experience in the device packaging area. We are looking for candidates with strong engineering principles, resourcefulness and a data driven approach. - Design, build, and maintain backend process infrastructure to enhance efficiency, organization, and scalability. Implement standardized work practices and optimize workflows for streamlined operations.

title: Product Manager III, ASP Insights
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026

AWS is seeking a Senior Product Manager to define and drive the product strategy for the Partner analytics portfolio within AWS Specialist & Partner (ASP). This team builds the data products, reporting systems, and analytics experiences that help AWS's partner organization operate — from goal-setting and planning through execution tracking and business reviews. The work sits at the intersection of product management, data strategy, and partner operations, in an environment where AI-powered automation is increasingly how the team delivers value rather than a future-state aspiration.

The Senior PM owns the end-to-end product lifecycle for the team's analytics portfolio: defining what gets built, sequencing the roadmap, and partnering across field teams, programs, finance, and GTM to ship products that make partner-facing roles more effective. This means translating ambiguous operational problems into well-scoped products — dashboards, planning tools, self-service analytics, automated reporting — and increasingly, AI-assisted experiences that surface insights at the point of decision. The right candidate brings strong product management fundamentals, comfort navigating a complex stakeholder landscape, and the judgment to distinguish between problems that need a product and problems that need a process.

Key job responsibilities
1. Owns the product strategy, roadmap, and requirements for the partner analytics portfolio — reporting, data products, planning tools, and AI-powered analytics that serve partner-facing field roles across ASP. Determines what to build, defer, and deprecate.
2. Translates complex partner operations workflows into prioritized product requirements — goal cascades, territory planning, program tracking, business review content, adoption analytics — balancing stakeholder needs against technical feasibility and delivery timelines.
3. Establishes a shared product vision across the organization by engaging stakeholders and ensuring the roadmap reflects both customer needs and business priorities. Creates buy-in for that vision internally and with cross-functional partners.
4. Partners closely with BIE leads and data engineering to foster a collaborative, delivery-focused culture — shaping what the team builds while empowering builders to own how it gets built. Influences data architecture decisions, KPI definitions, and governance frameworks without owning them directly.
5. Identifies analytics and data products that help field roles execute more effectively — partner development, program tracking, business reviews, planning workflows — and translates those opportunities into scoped products that serve each role's workflow.
6. Drives cross-functional alignment across finance, GTM, programs, and field teams — building shared context on priorities, dependencies, and trade-offs so that the analytics portfolio reflects actual operational needs rather than a queue of ad-hoc requests.
7. Shapes the team's AI and agentic strategy — evaluating where LLM-powered agents, natural language interfaces, and intelligent automation can augment field productivity and surface insights at the point of decision. Drives those capabilities from concept through adoption.
8. Determines what to automate and what to deprecate — identifies manual, repetitive operational work that can be replaced by product (automated reporting, self-service analytics, intelligent alerting, AI-assisted planning) and sequences those capabilities into the roadmap based on impact and feasibility.
9. Defines and tracks product health metrics — adoption, engagement, stakeholder satisfaction, automation coverage, cycle time reduction — using them to prioritize the roadmap and demonstrate impact to leadership.
10. Owns communication with leadership and cross-org partner teams — writes narratives that frame product capability in terms of business outcomes, presents trade-offs clearly in business reviews, and builds the credibility to influence how the organization invests in analytics and AI.

A day in the life
You will start your morning reviewing product metrics and customer feedback to identify emerging patterns. From there, you might refine a working-backwards document with your engineering and design partners, then join a roadmap review where you present trade-off recommendations to leadership. Afternoons could involve usability testing sessions, sprint planning with developers, or stakeholder syncs to align on priorities across teams. title: Support Engineer Apprentice (24 Fixed Term Contract)
descriptionHtml:
Are you enthusiastic about technology and eager to understand how software works behind the scenes? Do you enjoy solving problems, communicating with people, and getting to the bottom of an issue? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as an Apprentice Support Engineer.

In this role, you'll be part of a support engineering team focused on software products, supporting a wide variety of internal and external customers. Working alongside experienced support engineers, you'll learn how to diagnose, investigate, and resolve software-related issues that affect how customers use our platforms – keeping the things people rely on running smoothly.

Throughout your apprenticeship you'll grow from handling the fundamentals to confidently owning complex problems - developing the technical know-how to find a root cause and the communication skills to explain it clearly to anyone, whatever their background. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to dig in and act from day one.

A day in the life can involve:

- Investigating and resolving software incident tickets raised by customers and the first-line support team
- Communicating clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues, as well as directly with customers, to understand issues and explain solutions
- Escalating complex bugs or suspected system defects to the engineering team with detailed steps to reproduce the problem
- Learning to deep-dive into software issues - going beyond surface symptoms to understand root causes
- Contributing to internal documentation that helps the wider support team troubleshoot more effectively
- Supporting the first-line response team by sharing technical knowledge and helping to upskill colleagues
- Getting involved in wider IT projects across the business, gaining exposure to different areas of technology and new challenges

We're looking for people who are great communicators - you'll be speaking with non-technical first-line staff, developers, and customers, so explaining things clearly is critical. This role suits someone naturally curious, who asks the right questions and doesn't stop until they understand the full picture. You don't need prior technical experience, but you do need enthusiasm, a bias for action, and a genuine curiosity about how things work.

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprentice you’ll have the opportunity to learn by doing, putting newfound knowledge into practice every day. Our first-class coaching, tailored development opportunities, and challenging, rewarding work will empower you to reach new heights. If you’re a curious, ambitious learner eager to grow, this is your chance to unlock your full potential and build the future you envision.

descriptionHtml:
You will own major features and services across two connected products that deliver specialist expertise to the AWS field:

ASA is available in SpecReq, AskAWSentral, Pathfinder, Slack, Kiro, and any MCP or A2A client. It answers routine technical questions directly and escalates complex (L300+) challenges to human specialists with a pre-researched solution packet, so specialists spend their time on the highest-value customer problems.

- Specialist Knowledge Vault (KV) – An AI-first knowledge service that uses purpose-built crawlers to index specialist content from Highspot, YouTube, Broadcast, GitHub, Workshop Studio, Alchemy, and more, which removes manual consolidation. KV lets 46 Technical Field Communities (TFCs) endorse golden content, add agent steering, build reusable playbooks, and flag outdated or incorrect content, so the agent answers with the specialist point of view built in.


This is an AI-first engineering role. As an SDE II, you will design, build, and operate significant parts of the platform on your own. You will also help raise the engineering bar for the team.

Key job responsibilities

- Build and maintain evaluation test sets, prompts, and guardrails. Use evaluation results to decide what ships, and help define the quality bar for agent responses.

- Design APIs and MCP/A2A integrations as clean, reusable interfaces that bring ASA and KV into the tools where field teams already work.

title: Software Development Engineer, Leo Antenna Team
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

The Leo Antenna team is looking for a Software Development Engineer who is excited to work at the intersection of large-scale data systems, Amazon Web Services cloud services, data analysis, and radio frequency hardware.

In this role, you will design and build Customer Terminal Fleet Health, the system that keeps a daily hardware health record for every customer terminal Leo operates and flags terminals whose hardware is starting to fail. You will turn telemetry from millions of satellite contacts a day into clear, trustworthy signals that tell engineers which terminals need attention and why. You do not need to come in as a radio frequency expert, but you should have a strong software engineering foundation, experience building data pipelines on Amazon Web Services, a high learning velocity, and the drive to understand phased array antennas, satellite links, and how hardware failures show up in telemetry.

This is an individual contributor software development role for someone who enjoys ambiguous technical problems, can learn across disciplines, and wants to build data systems that directly improve the reliability of a satellite network.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build data pipelines on AWS (Step Functions, Athena, Glue, Iceberg, Lambda, S3) that process daily telemetry for the full fleet of customer terminals.
Define and own the data model for fleet health: daily per-terminal aggregates, per-satellite views, and the history engineers use to investigate a single terminal.
Partner with RF and antenna engineers to understand signal quality, temperature, reboot, and link metrics well enough to separate hardware failures from network, weather, and satellite effects.
Develop and validate the rules and models that flag failing hardware, and measure how well they work against terminals returned for repair.
Build infrastructure as code with AWS CDK, with deployment pipelines, monitoring, alarms, and integration tests that keep the system reliable.
Build dashboards and tools that let engineering and operations teams explore fleet health, compare groups of terminals, and track the effect of software and hardware changes.
Apply strong security and data-handling practices to sensitive customer and device data, including least-privilege access, encryption, and privacy controls.
Collaborate with data platform and customer terminal software teams to onboard new data sources and improve the telemetry the system depends on.
Write high-quality, maintainable code and documentation that other engineers and teams across Leo can build on.

A day in the life
You may start the day reviewing the overnight fleet health run, checking that every data source arrived and looking at which terminals were newly flagged. You might then sit down with antenna and radio frequency engineers on a group of terminals whose signal quality dropped, digging through the data together to decide whether it points to failing hardware, a software release, or something outside the terminal.

Later, you may meet with the data platform and customer terminal software teams to onboard a new telemetry source, then write the infrastructure and pipeline code that brings it into the daily run with tests and alarms in place. You might finish the day with field operations, comparing the watch list against recent hardware returns to see which failures the system flagged early, which it missed, and what each returned terminal can teach the rules.

Across all of it, your work helps engineers spot failing hardware before customers notice and measure the effect of software and hardware changes across the fleet. This role requires curiosity, technical depth, and the ability to move between data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and hardware context. You will not just write code; you will help define how Leo understands the health of every terminal in its fleet.

About the team
The Leo Customer Terminal Software Team supports the devices that connect customers to the Leo satellite network. We provide embedded application software and the underlying Linux system software for these terminals. We work hand in hand with hardware, product, and operations teams to deliver a great experience for our customers. As Leo moves toward full-scale production and global deployment, this is a compelling time to join and help shape how millions of people get online for the first time.

descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, safety-oriented and driven people. The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners who work tirelessly behind the scenes to keep our network running — maintaining and optimizing the equipment, systems, and infrastructure that make the Amazon customer experience possible.

The RME Manager is the site engineering lead for all reliability, maintenance, and engineering matters at MEX3. This role owns equipment availability, maintenance planning, budget management, and vendor management across the Fulfillment Center, and is responsible for leading the site maintenance team and building a strong culture of safety. The RME Manager ensures all statutory compliance requirements are met to provide a safe working environment for every occupant of the building, delivers a high level of equipment availability to the General Manager, and partners with the International RME and Central Engineering teams to plan for future growth. The role operates under the International RME framework (AMS — Amazon Maintenance System) and includes taking part in network-wide improvement initiatives and implementing standards created elsewhere in the network.

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of repairing material handling equipment (MHE), automated conveyor systems, or related mechanical/controls equipment experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 1+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience
- 2+ years of experience with automated systems or mechanical/electrical equipment in an industrial or manufacturing environment, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program, or 4+ years of maintenance-related military service (E-3+) experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling or production equipment experience
- High school or equivalent diploma
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience
- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience working with AI-enabled diagnostic tools, predictive maintenance systems, or smart sensors in an industrial environment
